<COL FF0000FF>Morning Dawn</COL>.

forms.name: Twin Bolts
forms.text:
Dual Blades that discharge the
thunderous might of the Astalos
with each flashing slice.

forms.name: Twin High Bolts
forms.text:
The Twin Bolts's final form.
The wielder commands the
fury of a wyvern's lightning.

forms.name: Twin Wyvern Bolts
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twin Bolts</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Daggers
forms.text:
The claws on this ancient
weapon can slice the peak
right off of a mountain.

forms.name: Colossus's Daggers
forms.text:
The Giant's Daggers's final form.
Once a part of an elaborate
ritual to appease the gods.

forms.name: Behemoth's Daggers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Daggers</COL>.

forms.name: Smoldering Cities
forms.text:
Flames sprout from the wielder's
fists with every slice. Wounds
are cauterized instantly.

forms.name: Smoldering Kingdoms
forms.text:
The ruiner stands upon the
rubble with the Smoldering
Cities's final form in hand.

forms.name: Smoldering World
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Smoldering Cities</COL>.

forms.name: Fledderklauen
forms.text:
Two blades, two eldritch
eyes. When they meet prey,
a horrible death ensues.

forms.name: Hungerklauen
forms.text:
The Fledderklauen's final
form. Its eyes see a world
of nothing but despair.

forms.name: Aasklauen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fledderklauen</COL>.

forms.name: Zakun Twins
forms.text:
Dual Blades just like Seregios
talons. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Terrible Twins
forms.text:
The Zakun Twins's final
form. These sharp talons have
unmatched cutting power.

forms.name: Chaotic Twins
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zakun Twins</COL>.

forms.name: Monarch
forms.text:
Holding these blades is like
holding the pillars that
bind heaven and earth.

forms.name: Kirin Bolts
forms.text:
You'll feel like the thundergod
himself wielding two bolts of
lightning.

forms.name: Wunderkirins
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Monarch</COL>.

forms.name: Twin Nails
forms.text:
Painful training is required
to wield that which turns
your arms into fire and ice.

forms.name: Fire and Ice
forms.text:
The Twin Nails's final form,
the blades somber remains
of two love-struck knights.

forms.name: Blizzard and Blaze
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twin Nails</COL>.

forms.name: Chasm Blades
forms.text:
Remains from a forgotten time
when darkness shrouded the
land in hopelessness.

forms.name: Abyss Blades
forms.text:
Blood spilled from the final
form of the Chasm Blades
overflows from the depths.

forms.name: Castor Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chasm Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Qornu Waga
forms.text:
Dual Blades with a creepy
insect design. So creepy, they
even freak monsters out.

forms.name: Ro Waga
forms.text:
The Qornu Waga's final form
makes the most of their insect
origins. Gross...

forms.name: Gila Ro Waga
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Qornu Waga</COL>.

forms.name: White Dango
forms.text:
On vacation? Think about
picking up a pair of these
weaponized sweets!

forms.name: Sublime Dango
forms.text:
White Dango made as strong
and as tasty as they're going
to get.

forms.name: Heavenly Dango
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>White Dango</COL>.

forms.name: Addled Beers
forms.text:
A swig or two of this whilst
out hunting is an express ticket
to the land of good decisions.

forms.name: Potent Lagers
forms.text:
The Addled Beers's final form.
Hoppy and flavorful, they're a
fine way to unwind.

forms.name: Boozy Beers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Addled Beers</COL>.

forms.name: Wycademy Blades
forms.text:
A symbol of the values that
have come to exemplify the
Wycademy as an institution.

forms.name: Historia Edges
forms.text:
The Wycademy Blades's final
evolution. Nothing can stop the
search for history.

forms.name: Historia Recorders
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wycademy Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Black Twin Daggers
forms.text:
Darker than the deepest
seas, they're easy to use and
incite fear into their prey.

forms.name: Chrono Twin Daggers
forms.text:
The Black Twin Daggers's
final form. Appoints the
user as an envoy from hell.

forms.name: Fatalis Dual Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Twin Daggers</COL>.

forms.name: Heroic Twins
forms.text:
A legendary pair of blades
brought back to life with
Wyverian materials.

forms.name: Legendary Twins
forms.text:
Wyverian legends meet modern
forging to make the Heroic
Twins's final form.

forms.name: Legendary Duals
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Heroic Twins</COL>.

forms.name: Gelid Mind
forms.text:
An immortal soul trapped in ice,
waiting to destroy the prey that
will become its new vessel.

forms.name: Gelid Soul
forms.text:
The Gelid Mind's final form,
taking myriad sacrifices
to rekindle its power.

forms.name: Gelid Heart
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gelid Mind</COL>.

forms.name: Whirlitwists
forms.text:
Blades made from the hardest
Seltas parts. Feels like
getting punched, not sliced.

forms.name: Whirlitricks
forms.text:
The Whirlitwists's final form.
Their strike is a massive impact
that splits flesh.

forms.name: Spiratwists
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Whirlitwists</COL>.

forms.name: Cleaving Jaws
forms.text:
Dual Blades cleverly
sharpened on both edges
to cleanly excise flesh.

forms.name: Breaching Jaws
forms.text:
The Cleaving Jaws's final
form. No need to bark with a
bite this ferocious!

forms.name: Shocking Jaws
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cleaving Jaws</COL>.

forms.name: Plesioth Cutlasses
forms.text:
Razor-sharp, Water element
Dual Blades that produce
fountains with each stroke.

forms.name: Plesioth Machetes
forms.text:
The Plesioth Cutlasses's final
form. The vortex-like attacks
imitate a water spout.

forms.name: Plesioth Parangs
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plesioth Cutlasses</COL>.

forms.name: Shaka Scarecrows
forms.text:
A pair of scarecrows made to look
like Shakalaka. Hunters use them
to scare off flying wyverns.

forms.name: Chum Scarecrows
forms.text:
The Shaka Scarecrows's final
form. Dragons don't pose a
threat with these two.

forms.name: Chum-Chum Scarecrows
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shaka Scarecrows</COL>.

forms.name: Giaprey Claws
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from Giaprey
parts with a snazzy, vibrant look.
They also hit pretty hard.

forms.name: High Giaprey Claws
forms.text:
Final form of the Giaprey Claws.
They rend the atmosphere itself to
create a blast of freezing cold.

forms.name: White Death
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giaprey Claws</COL>.

forms.name: Felyne Claws
forms.text:
Claws modeled after an old
proverb about a cornered
Felyne scratching a Wyvern.

forms.name: Raging Claws
forms.text:
The Felyne Claws's final
form, said to turn you into
a Felyne if used too much.

forms.name: Raging Paws
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Felyne Claws</COL>.

forms.name: Pink Maracas
forms.text:
Dual Blades with high attack power.
Their inertial force makes them
bone-crushingly effective.

forms.name: Funky Maracas
forms.text:
The Pink Maracas's final form.
Just one blow causes an incredible
amount of damage.

forms.name: Gorgeous Maracas
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pink Maracas</COL>.

forms.name: Blizzarioths
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from claws, tusks,
and Barioth breath. Anything they
touch is frozen solid.

forms.name: Mountain Blizzarioths
forms.text:
The Blizzarioths's final form.
Their attacks are known for raining
down like an inescapable blizzard.

forms.name: Raider's Icecarvers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blizzarioths</COL>.

forms.name: Guild Knight Sabers
forms.text:
Swords wielded by elite Guild
Knights. Their Sharpness frightens
even the gods themselves.

forms.name: Master Sabers
forms.text:
The Guild Knight Sabers's
final form. So holy they need
royal approval to use.

forms.name: Holy Guild Knight
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guild Knight Sabers</COL>.

forms.name: Suzuka Takamaru
forms.text:
The twin forelimbs of a Rajang.
When they lash out in lightning
gold, the target's life expires.

forms.name: Suzuka Otakemaru
forms.text:
The Suzuka Takamaru's final
form, fists that can tear
through both land and sea.

forms.name: Suzuka Akurou
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Suzuka Takamaru</COL>.

forms.name: Wrath & Rancor
forms.text:
Weapons that embody the Deviljho,
nature's perfect predator. The
heated blades seem almost alive...

forms.name: Wrathful Predation
forms.text:
Nobody alive can quell the
power found in the final
form of the Wrath & Rancor.

forms.name: Nero's Wrath
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wrath & Rancor</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Bashers
Diablos Mashers
forms.text:
The Diablos Bashers's final form.
They crush the foe like a tyrant
crushing his people beneath his feet.

forms.name: Diablos Smashers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Bashers</COL>.

forms.name: Research Spikes
forms.text:
Shaped like a ship's wheel, these
were created to commemorate the
maiden flight of the Soaratorium.

forms.name: Discovery Spikes
forms.text:
The final form of the Research
Spikes. A wise person knows how
to sail rough seas as well as calm.

forms.name: Authority Navigators
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Spikes</COL>.

forms.name: Pirate Edges J
forms.text:
The swords used by the master
of the seven seas. The golden
skull steals men's souls...

forms.name: Buccaneer Edges J
forms.text:
The Pirate Edges J's final
form. It harbors countless
souls, but thirsts for more.

forms.name: Pirate King Edges J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pirate Edges J</COL>.

forms.name: Exploding Blades
forms.text:
Named after the Fire Dragon
Slayer Secret Art. Capable
of tearing dragons asunder.

forms.name: True Exploding Blades
forms.text:
Exploding Blades's final form,
evolved to protect those
held dear.

forms.name: Blazing Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Exploding Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Baki Combat Jutsu
forms.text:
An ever-evolving fighting style
honed by facing the toughest
opponents ever known.

forms.name: Baki Combat Jutsu X
forms.text:
Baki Combat Jutsu's final
form. The result of evolving
through countless battles.

forms.name: Baki Combat Jutsu XX
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Baki Combat Jutsu</COL>.

forms.name: Fan Club Fans
forms.text:
A pair of righteous blades to
cheer on MH fans everywhere.
Use for relief or entertainment!

forms.name: Fan Club Deluxe Fans
forms.text:
The Fan Club Fans's final form.
The perfect accessory for rooting
on hunters everywhere.

forms.name: Fan Club Super Fans
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fan Club Fans</COL>.

forms.name: Felyne and Melynx
forms.text:
Dolls popular with hunters
now turned into weapons.
Subject to 1yr waiting list.

forms.name: Felyne and Melynx DX
forms.text:
The Felyne and Melynx's
final form. Cute and cuddly
to the core.

forms.name: Felyne and Melynx++
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Felyne and Melynx</COL>.

forms.name: Light Sword Cypher
forms.text:
An assassin's blade that is
as quick as lightning and as
unrelenting as death itself.

forms.name: Light Sword Cypher X
forms.text:
The Light Sword Cypher's final
form, trusted only in the hands
of Special A-Class Striders.

forms.name: Light Sword Cypher XX
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Light Sword Cypher</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Blades
forms.text:
Dual Blades with the power
of the black god. The bearer
carries the sin of deicide.

forms.name: Akantor Shadow Claws
forms.text:
The murderer of gods grows
yet stronger as the Akantor
Blades's final form.

forms.name: Akantor Exterminator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Ruinblades
forms.text:
Embodiment of the white god's
seventh power: direction. Even
the moon cannot escape this wrath.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skyrippers
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Ruinblades's final
form. Their inescapable power
extends past our atmosphere.

forms.name: Ukanlos Worldsplitters
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Ruinblades</COL>.

forms.name: Stormwind Fans
forms.text:
Anybody unlucky to face the
gales of these fans are torn
into thousands of pieces.

forms.name: Heavenwind Fans
forms.text:
The Stormwind Fans's final
form. Cleanse the land of evil
with purifying gales.

forms.name: Taixu Fans
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stormwind Fans</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Blades
forms.text:
Shines with the silvery hue of the
Argent Comet. Hits like a meteor
shower, faster than you can blink.

forms.name: Dragonstar Hersul
forms.text:
The Silverwing Blades's final form.
"Fear me, the solar storm; my
blades rain down like meteor hail."

forms.name: Magnastar Rig
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades from the Soaratorium
for hunters breaking new ground.
They are as light as feathers.

forms.name: Sage Daggers
forms.text:
Final form of the Elder Daggers.
They tear your quarry to pieces
with unbelievable swiftness.

forms.name: Philosopher Daggers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Daggers</COL>.

forms.name: Luzio Saurel
forms.text:
A fishy set of Dual Blades carried
by d'Artanyan. Their cutting ability
is second to meowne!

forms.name: Rufio Kingfish
forms.text:
The final form of the Luzio Saurel.
You won't be a fish out of water
on the battlefield with these blades.

forms.name: Establi Mako
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Luzio Saurel</COL>.

forms.name: Cercatore Talea
forms.text:
Favored weapons of the manager
of the Hunters' Pub -- back when she
was still hunting, of course.

forms.name: Sucher Azalee
forms.text:
Final form of the Cercatore Talea.
Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor
Rathian stops these hunters.

forms.name: Chercher Ultime
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cercatore Talea</COL>.

forms.name: Ace Blades
forms.text:
The Ace Commander's Dual Blades
of choice. They lend a certain
dashing, if a bit sinister, air.

forms.name: Loyal Ace Blades
forms.text:
The final form of the Ace Blades.
A strong and just heart can
overcome any hardship.

forms.name: The Commander
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ace Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Jinrai Works
forms.text:
Dual Blades from a distant
land. The left builds charge
and the right directs it.

forms.name: Gorai Works
forms.text:
Jinrai Works's final form.
Turns enemies to dust,
leaving only a dazzling arc.

forms.name: Dengeki Daggers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of
the <COL FF0000FF>Jinrai Works</COL>.

forms.name: Apostel/Sorcière
forms.text:
Dual Blades whose Affinity
changes when their wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Inferno/Paradis
forms.text:
The Apostel/Sorcière's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who respect to the heavens.

forms.name: Shangri-La/Hades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Apostel/Sorcière</COL>.

forms.name: Flaming Pair
forms.text:
Twin blades with the power to
subjugate dragons. The swords work
together to amplify their power.

forms.name: Crimson Lotus Blades
forms.text:
The final form of the Flaming Pair,
their power has been focused
and amplified even further.

forms.name: Eternal Lotus Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flaming Pair</COL>.

forms.name: Goldblades
forms.text:
Golden relics of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of Order, the
force that brings light to the world.

forms.name: Inscribed Ma'at
forms.text:
The Goldblades's final form.
Wielded by the daughter of the sun,
they illuminate the path of justice.

forms.name: Ma'at Shu
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldblades</COL>.

forms.name: Ebonblood Twindrakes
forms.text:
Red and shadow melded into a
dragon-felling menace to be
wielded by the worthy.

forms.name: Twinbane Blades
forms.text:
The Ebonblood Twindrakes's final
form. Pain like a blood-red eruption.
Despair like the blackest night.

forms.name: Twinbane Twilight
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ebonblood Twindrakes</COL>.

forms.name: Ultimus Celestials
forms.text:
A most evil pair. They have passed
through many hands via an
inescapable chain of death.

forms.name: Ultimus Elysium
forms.text:
The Ultimus Celestials's final form.
An old Fatalis's power blooms within,
as they devour each wielder in turn.

forms.name: Ultimus Apocalypse
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ultimus Celestials</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Redhelm parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Redhelm Daggers
forms.text:
The Crimson Daggers's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Redhelm Arzuros.

forms.name: Redhelm Marvels
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Daggers</COL>!

forms.name: Blackhare Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Snowbaron parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Snowbaron Dual Blades
forms.text:
The Blackhare Daggers's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Snowbaron Lagombi.

forms.name: Blackhare Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blackhare Daggers</COL>!

forms.name: Pincher Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Daggers
forms.text:
The Pincher Daggers's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Gigant Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pincher Daggers</COL>!

forms.name: Royal Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Daggers
forms.text:
The Royal Daggers's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Spines
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Daggers</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Daggers
forms.text:
The Nightfall Daggers's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Daybreak Claws
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Daggers</COL>!

forms.name: Hardened Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Daggers
forms.text:
The Hardened Daggers's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Deadeye Ruin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hardened Daggers</COL>!

forms.name: Raiden Daggers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Daggers
forms.text:
The Raiden Daggers's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thunderking Daggers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raiden Daggers</COL>!

forms.name: Seize Slicers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Blood
forms.text:
The Seize Slicers's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Bloodlust
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seize Slicers</COL>!

forms.name: Enflamed Slicers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Charred Slicers
forms.text:
The Enflamed Slicers's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Scorched Slicers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Enflamed Slicers</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Dissectors
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Wild Dissectors
forms.text:
The Razor Dissectors's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Dissectors
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Dissectors</COL>!

forms.name: Impermanence
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Their Song
forms.text:
The Impermanence's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Her Dance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Impermanence</COL>!

forms.name: Twin Revolt
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from Boltreaver
parts. Wielding them fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Twin High Revolt
forms.text:
The Twin Revolt's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Vanagloria
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twin Revolt</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Blades
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding them
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Dividers
forms.text:
Final form of the Elderfrost Blades.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Executioners
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Blades</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Spines
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding
them fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Bonesplitters
forms.text:
The Massacre Spines' final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Mithridates
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Spines</COL>!

forms.name: Twin Chainsaws
forms.text:
Dual Blades once used to cut
metal in a workshop. They were
crafted with advanced techniques.

forms.name: Guillotines
forms.text:
The Twin Chainsaws's final
form, their rotating blades
able to fell even Wyverns.

forms.name: Final Chainsaws
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twin Chainsaws</COL>.

forms.name: Sworn Rapiers
forms.text:
Dual Blades used as ritual attire
by a certain town's guard. They
can pierce flying-wyvern armor.

forms.name: Holy Sabers
forms.text:
The Sworn Rapiers's final
form. In another time, only
captains could wield them.

forms.name: Sacred Espadas
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sworn Rapiers</COL>.

forms.name: Blazeblades
forms.text:
These blades burn a
beautiful crimson. Their fiery
edges never cool down.

forms.name: Infernal Furies
forms.text:
The Blazeblades's final form.
Their heat grows strong with
the wielder's emotion.

forms.name: Unquenchable Flames
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blazeblades</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Daggers
forms.text:
Daggers forged from an ebon
fossil. Ancient history flows
through their handles.

forms.name: Lustrous Permia
forms.text:
The Obsidian Daggers's
final form. The past lives
once more, sharp as ever.

forms.name: Ethereal Permia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Daggers</COL>.

forms.name: Roving Saws
forms.text:
The soul of a workshop,
these metal cutting blades
are used as weapons.

forms.name: Golem's Saws
forms.text:
The Roving Saws's final form.
The blades mercilessly cut
through anything.

forms.name: Golem's Maneaters
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Roving Saws</COL>.

forms.name: Type 51 Macerators
forms.text:
Dual Blades that smash and slice.
Heavy ends add speed to swings,
allowing the blades to cut deep.

forms.name: Deathsnarfs
forms.text:
The Type 51 Macerators's
final form, their heft retooled
for max brute strength.

forms.name: Uber Deathsnarfs
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 51 Macerators</COL>.

forms.name: Insecticutters
forms.text:
Dual Swords that use rare
materials and are difficult
to forge. Non-elemental.

forms.name: Insectirippers
forms.text:
The Insecticutters's final
form, featuring superb
Sharpness and hardness.

forms.name: Insectkriegers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Insecticutters</COL>.

forms.name: Insectiscythes
forms.text:
A pair of blades made for a
sole purpose: Sharpness.
Handle with care.

forms.name: Alated Insect
forms.text:
The Insectiscythes's final
form. Arduous to craft,
making them a rare sight.

forms.name: Entomotheos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Insectiscythes</COL>.

forms.name: Cool Cleavers
forms.text:
Dual Blades masterfully
forged from Zamtrios fangs
of equal, vicious voracity.

forms.name: Frozen Cleavers
forms.text:
The Cool Cleavers's final
form. A fearsome legacy of
the Frozen Seaway's lord.

forms.name: Névé Bite
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cool Cleavers</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Slicers
forms.text:
Blades coated in an explosive
slime. Foes are cut to ribbons
before being blown to bits.

forms.name: Explosive Slicers
forms.text:
The Dios Slicers's final
form. Their explosive power
is truly transcendental.

forms.name: Volatile Slicers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Slicers</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Blades
forms.text:
Dual Blades with the might of a
Brachydios. A fiery crimson trail
follows them when swung.

forms.name: Spectral Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Blades's final
form. The Brachydios's barbarity
is the source of their power.

forms.name: Spectral Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Talons
forms.text:
A cutting blade and ripping claw.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Serre Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Talons's final
form, tailored for warriors
who carve their own paths.

forms.name: Sedition Rippers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Talons</COL>.

forms.name: Tornado Hatchets
forms.text:
Twin axes with optimal balance and
good power. Experts wield them
in a whirling dervish of death.

forms.name: Typhoon
forms.text:
The Tornado Hatchets's final
form. Capable of clearing whole
forests with just one.

forms.name: Twister
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tornado Hatchets</COL>.

forms.name: Rex Slicers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from Tigrex
materials. Can slice through
rock as if it was butter.

forms.name: Tigrex Claws
forms.text:
The Rex Slicers's final form.
Rivers of blood have been left
in their wake.

forms.name: Huge Tigrex Claws
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rex Slicers</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Fulgur
forms.text:
Dual Blades with the might of a
Zinogre. Only true courage can
awaken the fangs of the monarch.

forms.name: Despot's Blitz
forms.text:
Fangs fit to rule the world
taken shape as the final form
of the Usurper's Fulgur.

forms.name: Oppressor's Miracle
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Fulgur</COL>.

forms.name: Flamestorm
forms.text:
Dual Blades with the fragile
beauty of a butterfly and the
power to consume all in flames.

forms.name: Salamanders
forms.text:
The Flamestorm's final form.
A strange beauty burns within
their sparkling flames.

forms.name: Aesonique
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flamestorm</COL>.

forms.name: Rouge Flames
forms.text:
Crimson Dual Blades with a
deadly poison that sucks the
life out of their victims.

forms.name: Dual Chameleos
forms.text:
The Rouge Flames's final
form. Laced with a deadly
poison that'll stop your heart.

forms.name: Chameleos Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rouge Flames</COL>.

forms.name: Khezu Daggers
forms.text:
Daggers made with real
bloodlust. The lightning they
emanate terrifies prey.

forms.name: Khezu Skards
forms.text:
The Khezu Daggers's final
form. The more blood they
spill, the shinier they get.

forms.name: Blood Wind Skards
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Khezu Daggers</COL>.

forms.name: Twin Flames
forms.text:
Powerful swords with potent
elemental properties inherited
from fire wyverns.

forms.name: Wyvern Lovers
forms.text:
The Twin Flames's final
form. Capable of setting the
world aflame.

forms.name: Blazing Wyvern Lovers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twin Flames</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Strife
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from legendary
gold and silver wyverns. They
have incredible Fire properties.

forms.name: Wyvern Conciliation
forms.text:
The Wyvern Strife's final
form. Sure to inspire the
next generation of heroes.

forms.name: Wyvern Harmony
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Strife</COL>.

forms.name: Firestorm
forms.text:
Miraculous weapon that joins
the powers of Fire & Water.
It chooses its own user.

forms.name: Volcanic Storm
forms.text:
The Firestorm's final form. An
impossible combination that
produces impossible strength.

forms.name: Volcanic Deluge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Firestorm</COL>.

forms.name: Bladed Edges
forms.text:
An incredibly sharp weapon made
from Shogun claws. The six-edge
blades can tear apart any target.

forms.name: Limb Cutter
forms.text:
Cut your enemies to the knees
with ease with the Bladed
Edges's final form.

forms.name: Ceanataur Cutter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bladed Edges</COL>.

forms.name: Bladed Pincers
forms.text:
A silent and deadly weapon
made famous by a foreign
shogun's stealth forces.

forms.name: Feudal Shears
forms.text:
The Bladed Pincers's final
form, redefining what it
means to rend asunder.

forms.name: Ceanataur Shears
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bladed Pincers</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Gemini
forms.text:
Ebon Dual Blades, black as night.
Rumored to have been passed
down by a cadre of assassins.

forms.name: Night Wings
forms.text:
The Hidden Gemini's final
form, a legendary assassin's
preferred weapon.

forms.name: Avidya Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Gemini</COL>.

forms.name: Crab Horns
forms.text:
Daimyo Hermitaur materials
show a solid defense makes
a great offense, too.

forms.name: Lobster Piercers
forms.text:
The Crab Horns's final form,
refined to be as hard as can
possibly be.

forms.name: Lobster Crushers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crab Horns</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Pair
forms.text:
Swords made from a Royal Ludroth.
They spray arcs of water, which
helps to wash away the blood.

forms.name: Double Droth
forms.text:
The Ludroth Pair's final
form. It holds enough water
to forge mighty rivers.

forms.name: Double Droth Flood
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Pair</COL>.

forms.name: Twin Acrus
forms.text:
Eye-catching Dual Blades. They
release lightning that makes
them shine even brighter.

forms.name: Levin Acrus
forms.text:
The Twin Acrus's final form.
Its thunder rocks across
the heavens themselves.

forms.name: Solid Levin Acrus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twin Acrus</COL>.

forms.name: Snow Slicers
forms.text:
Swords named after Snow and Dew,
sisters who perished in the Tundra.
They bring heartbreak to all.

forms.name: Snow Sisters
forms.text:
The final form of the Snow
Slicers. Contains the prayers
of those who mourn.

forms.name: Snow Ravines
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Snow Slicers</COL>.

forms.name: Maulagombs
forms.text:
Traditional folk swords.
While ceremonial, they prove
their ample worth in battle.

forms.name: Brawlagombs
forms.text:
The Maulagombs's final form,
Once carried by a hero who
brought salvation to the land.

forms.name: Appallagombs
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Maulagombs</COL>.

forms.name: Dual Battleaxes
forms.text:
Dual Axes based on a highly
poisonous Sword. Simple, yet
highly effective weapons.

forms.name: Final Battleaxes
forms.text:
The Dual Battleaxes's final
form. Still simple, yet even
more effective.

forms.name: Double Tabarzin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dual Battleaxes</COL>.

forms.name: Snow Venom
forms.text:
"Impossible to use" Ioprey
materials make this Ice and
Poison combo a reality.

forms.name: Glacial Medusa
forms.text:
The Snow Venom's final form.
Its freezing strikes cause
painfully-slow deaths.

forms.name: Glacial Gorgoneion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Snow Venom</COL>.

forms.name: Whirlitorture
forms.text:
A unique shape that combines
Seltas Queen parts. Made to
thrust right through stone.

forms.name: Gyro Wedges
forms.text:
The Whirlitorture's final form.
Capable of piercing even the
toughest wyvern flesh.

forms.name: Gyramena
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Whirlitorture</COL>.

forms.name: Raven Tessen
forms.text:
Black fans made from Yian
Garuga. A single flutter cuts up
prey in the blink of an eye.

forms.name: Wolf Tessen
forms.text:
The Raven Tessen's final form.
Cool off foes by removing the
warmth from their body.

forms.name: Crow Tessen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raven Tessen</COL>.

forms.name: Wicked Tessen
forms.text:
Blades that cut with the sorrow
of the orphaned Garuga Princess,
who could not abate her tears.

forms.name: Garuga Gunsen
forms.text:
The Wicked Tessen's final
form. It rends the hearts
of those who see its dance.

forms.name: Occult Gunsen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wicked Tessen</COL>.

forms.name: Les Apôtres
forms.text:
Two blades, mantled in rainbow
light. Prey hunted with this
receive a beautiful death.

forms.name: Le Paradis
forms.text:
The Les Apôtres's final
form, brimming with heavenly
peace and contentment.

forms.name: Le Shangri-La
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Les Apôtres</COL>.

forms.name: Consummate Pair
forms.text:
Deviljho incarnate. These
pulsing blades shriek when
their thirst goes unsated.

forms.name: Doomfang "Envoys"
forms.text:
The Consummate Pair's final
form. Ever thirsty for fresh
blood to be bathed in.

forms.name: Guiltfang "Evilbringer"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Consummate Pair</COL>.

forms.name: Astral Gemini
forms.text:
Remains of a celestial being
that can rip through the
very cosmos.

forms.name: Ecstatic Gemini
forms.text:
The Astral Gemini's final
form. Rains death upon the
wild and euphoric alike.

forms.name: Euphoric Gemini
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astral Gemini</COL>.

forms.name: Worn Blades
forms.text:
Worn Dual Blades with unrealized
potential. They could perhaps
be restored...

forms.name: Weathered Blades
forms.text:
The Worn Blades's powerful
final form proves that oldies
can be goodies, rusted or not.

forms.name: Aged Blades
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Blades</COL>.

forms.name: Enduring Schism
forms.text:
The ultimate dragon slayers.
Could the crafting material be
a remnant of an ancient people?

forms.name: Enduring Sacrifice
forms.text:
The Enduring Schism's final
form. A final trump card to play
against impending doom.

forms.name: Enduring Surrender
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Enduring Schism</COL>.

forms.name: Hi Twin Daggers
forms.text:
Seemingly normal Dual
Blades, but sealed within is
the spirit of ancient times.

forms.name: Silhouette Sabers
forms.text:
The Hi Twin Daggers's final
form. Unleashes the power
of an ancient spirit.

forms.name: Dark Silhouette Sabers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hi Twin Daggers</COL>.

forms.name: Pure Yukumo Duo
forms.text:
A highly refined pair of
Dual Blades that won't fail
in the line of duty.

forms.name: Divine Yukumo Duo
forms.text:
The Pure Yukumo Duo's final
form, made of nothing less
than pure perfection.

forms.name: Patriotic Yukumo Duo
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pure Yukumo Duo</COL>.

forms.name: Spicy Dango
forms.text:
Chew these dumplings with
extreme caution. One bite's
enough to burn.

forms.name: Red Hot Dango
forms.text:
Spicy Dango at their most
fiery. Don't bite into one
without water nearby!

forms.name: Blistering Hot Dango
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spicy Dango</COL>.

forms.name: Tengu Dango
forms.text:
The flavor on these bad boys
is so strong, they might as
well be poison.

forms.name: Devil Dango
forms.text:
Tengu Dango's final form.
Taste so bad, even dragons
won't go near them.

forms.name: Demon Dango
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tengu Dango</COL>.

forms.name: Stewbry Stirfoils
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from cookware.
Just the thing for flipping a
flying-wyvern pancake!

forms.name: Deepshake Frybakers
forms.text:
The Stewbry Stirfoils's final
form, able to make a meal of
any monster.

forms.name: Three Star Master Set
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stewbry Stirfoils</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Twins
forms.text:
Dual Blades whose mystic, golden
firelight dances through battle,
turning each partner to ash.

forms.name: Lightbreak Flameblades
forms.text:
Final form of the Lightbreak Twins.
Their golden flame-wreathed dance
recalls the very fires of creation.

forms.name: Lightbreak Firewracks
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Twins</COL>.

forms.name: Ignis Noire
forms.text:
Weapons carved from an Agnaktor's
fiery shell. The hardened lava is still
blistering hot.

forms.name: Agnaktor Inferno
forms.text:
The final form of the Ignis Noire.
Tempered to increase its durability,
its very touch burns prey to cinders.

forms.name: Scoria Agnaktor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ignis Noire</COL>.

forms.name: Verdant Slashers
forms.text:
Dual Blades made from the fins of a
Plesioth. The webbing contains
both water and sleep elements.

forms.name: Alluvion Slashers
forms.text:
Final form of the Verdant Slashers.
The twin elements contained in the
blades consign any foe to oblivion.

forms.name: Torporfall Slashers
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verdant Slashers</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Hammer
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Hammer
for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Hammer
forms.text:
The Petrified Hammer's final
form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Hammer
forms.text:
The trusty weapon of an old
hunter before Hammers were
"in." Looks rather crude...

forms.name: Iron Devil
forms.text:
The Iron Hammer's final form,
strikes with demonic strength
and hellish fury.

forms.name: Iron Giant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Hammer
forms.text:
Hammer made from superior
quality bone. Boorish, it
proves its material's power.

forms.name: Hard Bone Hammer
forms.text:
The Bone Hammer's final form.
Made from top quality bone
materials for unparalleled power.

forms.name: Bone Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Bludgeon
forms.text:
A crude Hammer fashioned from
a massive bone. Its strength
becomes apparent with use.

forms.name: Heavy Bone Bludgeon
forms.text:
The Bone Bludgeon's final
form. Still crude, but it is
greatly improved otherwise.

forms.name: Huge Bone Bludgeon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Bludgeon</COL>.

forms.name: Bull Head Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from Bullfango
parts. The beast's merciless charges
make hunters tremble in fear.

forms.name: Bull Tusk Hammer
forms.text:
The Bull Head Hammer's final
form. Strikes with the force
of a charging Bullfango.

forms.name: Wild Bull Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bull Head Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Mallet
forms.text:
A wooden Hammer with a variety
of uses. Uses only select Yukumo
lumber in its construction.

forms.name: Yukumo Impact
forms.text:
The Yukumo Mallet's final
form. By focusing on its rigidity,
it is now as strong as steel.

forms.name: Hot Spring Impact
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Mallet</COL>.

forms.name: War Hammer
forms.text:
An iron Hammer with a sharpened
tip, its simple design belies
the sheer power of its blows.

forms.name: War Mace
forms.text:
The War Hammer's final form. Its
tip has been further sharpened
to boost its killing potential.

forms.name: War Ender
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>War Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Cyclo-Hammer
forms.text:
Crafted from superior bone,
this Hammer boasts improved
Attack. The standard-bearer.

forms.name: Atlas Hammer
forms.text:
The Cyclo-Hammer's final form.
Improved to the point where it's
now the apex of bone Hammers.

forms.name: Atlas Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cyclo-Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Skullcrusher
forms.text:
Inlaid with numerous fangs,
this Hammer could crush
a wyvern's skull to dust.

forms.name: Skullblaster
forms.text:
The Skullcrusher's final form.
Covered in fangs and claws,
it resembles a wild beast.

forms.name: Skullsploder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skullcrusher</COL>.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Pick
forms.text:
This limited edition Yian
Kut-Ku item has been popular
since it went on the market.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Thwap
forms.text:
The final form of the fabled
Kut-Ku Pick. Only for those
cuckoo for Kut-Ku items.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Kaboom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kut-Ku Pick</COL>.

forms.name: Cactus Creamer
forms.text:
A large Hammer thought up at
the workshop during some
downtime. Very spiky!

forms.name: Green Monster
forms.text:
The Cactus Creamer's final
form. Made with good intentions,
but took a strange turn.

forms.name: Toxic Cactus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cactus Creamer</COL>.

forms.name: Black Frying Pan
forms.text:
Used by the iron men of the
kitchen. Nothing can escape
this chef's dungeon!

forms.name: True Black Frying Pan
forms.text:
The Black Frying Pan's final
form. Capable of turning multiple
ingredients into a piece of art.

forms.name: Obsidian Frying Pan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Frying Pan</COL>.

forms.name: Pumpking
forms.text:
Terrifying yet amusing, a Hammer
with a face impossible to hate. It
is said to even ward off evil spirits.

forms.name: Jack-'o-lantern King
forms.text:
The Pumpking's final form. Once
used by a jolly king to purify
and befriend evil spirits.

forms.name: Magic Pumpking
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pumpking</COL>.

forms.name: Airship Hammer
forms.text:
Travel to new and greater heights
with this weapon that satisfies
both airship and Hammer lovers!

forms.name: Zeppelin Hammer
forms.text:
The Airship Hammer's final
form. Much care was put into the
airship model and its efficacy.

forms.name: Flight Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Airship Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Gaiarch
forms.text:
A Hammer overflowing with
history, imbued with the
soul of an ancient wyvern.

forms.name: Great Gaiarch
forms.text:
The Gaiarch's final form. It
resided inside a wyvern that had
been sealed away in the earth.

forms.name: Mother Gaiarch
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gaiarch</COL>.

forms.name: White Kitty Stamp
forms.text:
Hammer made to resemble the
head of a Felyne. A popular
weapon with Felyne fans.

forms.name: White Kitty Hammer
forms.text:
The White Kitty Stamp's final
form is constantly sold out, and
is so cute even wyverns adore it.

forms.name: White Kitty Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>White Kitty Stamp</COL>.

forms.name: Red Bludgeon
forms.text:
A superb article made from the
head of a Rathalos. Only the
bravest can wield it.

forms.name: Huracan Hammer
forms.text:
The Red Bludgeon's final
form features many upgrades
and cannot be tamed.

forms.name: Rathalos Bludgeon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Bludgeon</COL>.

forms.name: Purity Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer passed down from a
princess who brought peace to
the land by dispelling evil.

forms.name: Sinter Hammer
forms.text:
The Purity Hammer's final
form serves as a guiding light
for a world lost in darkness.

forms.name: Enlightenment Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Purity Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Emerald Beater
forms.text:
A powerful Hammer resembling
an Astalos's crest. Only for those
that refuse to fear the Astalos.

forms.name: Astalos Smasher
forms.text:
The Emerald Beater's final
form. It ruthlessly beats down
any that oppose it.

forms.name: Astalos Striker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Emerald Beater</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer said to have been used
by a mighty warrior. Its punch
can smash through solid rock.

forms.name: Colossus's Hammer
forms.text:
The final form of the Giant's
Hammer. Used by a hero that
slayed an evil god.

forms.name: Behemoth's Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Scorching Isshata
forms.text:
A Hammer featuring a head
of extreme heat that knows
no bounds.

forms.name: Glavenus's Uruga
forms.text:
The Scorching Isshata's final
form, it calls upon the Glavenus
to fell its foes in one fiery blow.

forms.name: Glavenus's Uruga Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scorching Isshata</COL>.

forms.name: Wuchtblick
forms.text:
An ominous Hammer adorned
with a menacing skull. The
hidden eye shall never open.

forms.name: Grimmblick
forms.text:
The final form of Wuchtblick.
It casts a shadow that will
plunge the world into nothingness.

forms.name: Ächtungsblick
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wuchtblick</COL>.

forms.name: Matraca Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer fashioned from Seregios
scales. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Argyl Hammer
forms.text:
The Matraca Hammer's final
form. The sign of a revolutionary
as its strength seeks change.

forms.name: Argyl Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Matraca Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Genie's Expanse
forms.text:
A demonic hammer resembling a
Chameleos head. The poison tank
releases toxin with each strike.

forms.name: Diamalto's Dream
forms.text:
The final form of the Genie's
Expanse. Combines powerful
poison with crippling strikes.

forms.name: Diamgolgo's Phantasm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Genie's Expanse</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Hammer
forms.text:
This Hammer exists to beat back
the ignorant souls that can't
be redeemed even through death.

forms.name: Wicked Hammer
forms.text:
The Skeletal Hammer's final
form. Designed to cleanse the
lands of the ignorant.

forms.name: Sadalmelik Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Teddybear
forms.text:
A stuffed animal popular
among ladies living in
Guild towns. Cuddle time?

forms.name: Sleepy Bear
forms.text:
The Teddybear's final form. Has
helped countless girls across
the land drift off to dreamland.

forms.name: Dreamy Bear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teddybear</COL>.

forms.name: Egg Hammer
forms.text:
This Hammer smashes the notion
that hammers need to be hard. It's
a mystery why it never breaks.

forms.name: Garga Hammer
forms.text:
The unbreakable Egg Hammer's
final form. Surely it will break
eventually...

forms.name: Gargegg Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Egg Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Graceful Death
forms.text:
A weapon resembling the hand
of a vengeful spirit. It grips the
souls of those it has reaped.

forms.name: Yadora Morte
forms.text:
The Graceful Death's final
form. Even more evil, it seals
its user's fate immediately.

forms.name: Dark Morte
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Graceful Death</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Hammer
forms.text:
The result of blood and sweat
shed in the arena. Only for those
who've overcome many trials.

forms.name: Shihan Hammer
forms.text:
The Black Belt Hammer's final
form. It contains the memories
of many passionate battles.

forms.name: Grandmaster Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Black Hammer
forms.text:
Giant Hammer with a dark
power. The despair within
eats at its user.

forms.name: Onyx Hammer
forms.text:
The Black Hammer's final form.
Possessed by an evil force that
can crush the wielder's soul.

forms.name: Fatalis Buster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Fist of Fury
forms.text:
Sticks and stones may break
bones, but a giant bone fist
breaks bodies...painfully.

forms.name: Ancient Blow
forms.text:
The final form of Fist of
Fury, not even time itself can
diminish this mighty fist.

forms.name: Foolhardy Stone Fist
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fist of Fury</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Striker
forms.text:
A giant, powerful Hammer
that is one impressive
hunk of metal.

forms.name: Iron Impact
forms.text:
The Iron Striker's final form.
Quite heavy due to the amount
of extra-hard metal put into it.

forms.name: Iron Repellant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Striker</COL>.

forms.name: Accelerated Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer outfitted with a
boost mechanism to produce
uncharacteristic force.

forms.name: Boosted Hammer
forms.text:
The boost mechanism of the
Accelerated Hammer has been
enhanced for amazing power.

forms.name: Supersonic Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Accelerated Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Meaty Smash
forms.text:
A unique design with Zamtrios
fangs stowed inside.
Once they flash, it's over.

forms.name: Meaty Crush
forms.text:
The Meaty Smash's final form.
Its sharpened tip provides a
brutish piercing attack.

forms.name: Meaty Demolisher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Meaty Smash</COL>.

forms.name: Jail Hammer
forms.text:
Hammer which uses the
Thunderbug's shock attack to
paralyze your prey.

forms.name: Prison Hammer
forms.text:
The Jail Hammer's final form.
One hit will silence your prey
for eternity.

forms.name: Binder Mace
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Jail Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Carapace Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer resembling
Barroth head armor. Strong
enough to crush steel.

forms.name: Barroth Hammer
forms.text:
The Carapace Hammer's final form.
Its overwhelming destructive power
can smash anything to smithereens.

forms.name: Barroth Momentum
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Carapace Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Gigaton Hammer
forms.text:
Heavyweight Hammer made with
the solid shell of a dragon.
One hit can shatter rock.

forms.name: Titan Hammer
forms.text:
The Gigaton Hammer's final form.
The size and weight come from the
super-hard steel for easy squishing.

forms.name: Great Titan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gigaton Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Cluster Hammer
forms.text:
Supple Nerscylla materials
facilitate a mechanism that
ejects spikes on the draw.

forms.name: Nerscrapper
forms.text:
The Cluster Hammer's final form.
The trick is to get thorns to stick in
the body after smashing the shell.

forms.name: Shadow Nerdirge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cluster Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Enormous Ham
forms.text:
An enormous, succulent
ham. A crispy exterior
with a juicy interior.

forms.name: Ham of Hams
forms.text:
The Enormous Ham's final
form erupts with juice upon
each hit, igniting the appetite.

forms.name: Hamageddon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Enormous Ham</COL>.

forms.name: Basarios Blow
forms.text:
A hammer crafted using the
hardest part of an adolescent
Basarios's face plating.

forms.name: Basarios Bash
forms.text:
The Basarios Blow's final form.
The precisely crafted dragon face
plating looks scarier then ever.

forms.name: Basarios Blast
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Basarios Blow</COL>.

forms.name: Shell Hammer
forms.text:
Hammer made using poisonous
Basarios Shell. Occasionally
poisons its prey.

forms.name: Graviton Hammer
forms.text:
The Shell Hammer's final form.
A poisonous hammer so heavy it
can break space and time.

forms.name: Crater Maker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shell Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Mane Malice
forms.text:
Sleeping lion or leering
demon? Your heart decides
this Hammer's countenance.

forms.name: Mane Malice Rajang
forms.text:
The Mane Malice's final form.
This Hammer is perfect for fierce
warriors in search of war.

forms.name: Mane Master Rajang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mane Malice</COL>.

forms.name: Devil's Due
forms.text:
This Hammer, oozing with a
Deviljho's power, hungers
for living sacrifices.

forms.name: Devil's Crush
forms.text:
The final form of Devil's Due.
This hammer uses a Deviljho's
life force to wreak havoc.

forms.name: Nero's Chaos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Devil's Due</COL>.

forms.name: Portsmark
forms.text:
A proud hallmark of one who lives
in service of the port. Ships with
one of these survive all storms.

forms.name: Port Talisman
forms.text:
The Portsmark's final form. It
has protected ships from storms
of all kinds at sea.

forms.name: Tanzia Memories
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Portsmark</COL>.

forms.name: Arluq Whammer
forms.text:
A large Hammer that adorned the
Arluq as it set out on the Caravan.
It can overcome any difficulty.

forms.name: Swinging Scarluq
forms.text:
The Arluq Whammer's final
form, it is ready to ship out
and bravely take on dragons.

forms.name: Eternal Arluq
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arluq Whammer</COL>.

forms.name: Pride of Harth
forms.text:
A Hammer made by the blacksmith
using special techniques, the skill
required is plain to see.

forms.name: Joy of Harth
forms.text:
The Pride of Harth's final form.
It is a difficult weapon to make,
even for veteran blacksmiths.

forms.name: Skill of Harth
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pride of Harth</COL>.

forms.name: Expert Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer only for use by master
hunters. For some reason, the
words "Good Job" are carved in it.

forms.name: Warrior's Hammer
forms.text:
The final form of the Expert
Hammer. Only mighty warriors
have the right to wield it.

forms.name: Unrivaled Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expert Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Research Hammer
forms.text:
A sturdy and heavy globe put
together by the Soaratorium egg-
heads, who love looking at the stars.

forms.name: Discovery Hammer
forms.text:
The Research Hammer's final form.
Compared to the infinity of space,
humanity's problems are naught.

forms.name: Authority Globus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Crystal Hammer
forms.text:
A lavish article that makes generous
use of valuable crystal. Beauty
and destructive power combined.

forms.name: Crystal Nova
forms.text:
The Crystal Hammer's final form.
Polished for the strongest hunters,
its brightness will never fade.

forms.name: Crystal Galaxia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crystal Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Thunder Works
forms.text:
A splendid foreign Hammer.
A blow from its charged head
can turn any man to ashes.

forms.name: Giga Thunder Works
forms.text:
The Thunder Works's final
form. Its thunderous blows
smite all that oppose it.

forms.name: Dengeki Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunder Works</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Visage
forms.text:
A Hammer that breaks the
mold with its pedigree.
Looks like a living thing.

forms.name: Demon Incarnate
forms.text:
The Demon Visage's final
form. Its name causes even the
greatest empires to tremble.

forms.name: Demon Grief
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Visage</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Trampler
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's fifth power: its legs.
Let the trampling begin.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skysmasher
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Trampler's final
form. The white god's fifth power
strikes foes down from above.

forms.name: Ukanlos Earthsmasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Trampler</COL>.

forms.name: Incubus Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer that radiates with the
light of the sun due to it having
descended from the heavens.

forms.name: Imminent Dawn
forms.text:
The Incubus Hammer's final
form. This gift from the gods
is ready to save mankind.

forms.name: Heaven Render
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Incubus Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from Alatreon
talons, it protects dragons
and destroys humans.

forms.name: Alatreon Metamorph
forms.text:
The Alatreon Hammer's final
form, it corrupts the weak-willed,
forever erasing their humanity.

forms.name: Altheos Morphexo
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Hammer
forms.text:
Shines with the silvery hue of the
Argent Comet. As dense as an iron
star, its impact is merciless.

forms.name: Dragonstar Nox
Magnastar Maknox
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer from the Soaratorium for
hunters breaking new ground. Crush
your prey with its awesome power.

forms.name: Sage Hammer
forms.text:
The Elder Hammer's final form.
One swing levels the area with
the force of a giant.

forms.name: Philosopher Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Memento Volare
forms.text:
This limited-run Hammer designed
by airship engineers celebrates the
Soaratorium's launch. Hip hip hooray!

forms.name: Volare Select
forms.text:
The Memento Volare's final form.
You thought the first one was
exclusive? Then get a load of this!

forms.name: Bon Voyage
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Memento Volare</COL>.

forms.name: Grinsen/Froncement
forms.text:
A Hammer whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Segen/Malédiction
forms.text:
The Grinsen/Froncement's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would defeat hatred.

forms.name: Vergehen/Naissance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grinsen/Froncement</COL>.

forms.name: Dragon Destroyer
forms.text:
A Lao-Shan Lung claw that puts the
force of a dragon in your hand,
making dragon hunting much easier.

forms.name: Dragonbreaker
forms.text:
The Dragon Destroyer's final form.
Lao-Shan Lung's iron Hammer has
finally unleased its true potential.

forms.name: Dark Punisher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragon Destroyer</COL>.

forms.name: Goldhammer
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a feminine
force that birthed the world.

forms.name: Inscribed Hathor
forms.text:
The Goldhammer's final form.
Created by the bringer of life and
heaven's mistress, Hathor.

forms.name: Ba'alat Gebal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldhammer</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Smasher
forms.text:
Giant hammer forged from the dark
power of the crimson dragon. Only
for those who've bested that evil.

forms.name: Fatalis Finisher
forms.text:
The Fatalis Smasher's devastating
final form. Its destructive power
buries all around it.

forms.name: Fatalis Destroyer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Smasher</COL>.

forms.name: Old Fatalis Buster
forms.text:
A white Hammer embodying the
power of an old Fatalis.
Meant only for the worthy.

forms.name: Old Fatalis Breaker
forms.text:
The Old Fatalis Buster's final form.
Those possessed by its power
find themselves on the path to ruin.

forms.name: Old Fatalis Ruiner
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Old Fatalis Buster</COL>.

forms.name: Pincher Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Hammer
forms.text:
The Pincher Hammer's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Gigahammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pincher Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Hammer
forms.text:
The Nightfall Hammer's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Daybreak Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Geode Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystalbeard Hammer
forms.text:
The Geode Hammer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Geode Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Hardened Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Hammer
forms.text:
The Hardened Hammer's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Deadeye Trouble
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hardened Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Tomb Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Hammer
forms.text:
The Tomb Hammer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Dreadking Mace
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tomb Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Raiden Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Hammer
forms.text:
The Raiden Hammer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thundergod Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raiden Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Seize Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Hammer
forms.text:
The Seize Hammer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Beater
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seize Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Magma Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Hellblade Hammer
forms.text:
The Magma Hammer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Lavaflow Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magma Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Smasher
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Breakneck Smasher
forms.text:
The Razor Smasher's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Smasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Smasher</COL>!

forms.name: Last Bastion
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stardust Hammer
forms.text:
The Last Bastion's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Diviner's Soulrock
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Last Bastion</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Beater
forms.text:
A Hammer made from
Boltreaver parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Boltreaver Arges
forms.text:
The Zephra Beater's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Boltreaver Zilarge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Beater</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from Elderfrost
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Mauler
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Hammer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Grandslam
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Hammer</COL>!

forms.name: Frozen Core
forms.text:
A Hammer with a frozen core
inside. So cold, just touching it
can freeze unprotected hands.

forms.name: Cocytus
forms.text:
The Frozen Core's final form.
So cold that merely striking a
lake is enough to freeze it over.

forms.name: Pykrete Punisher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Frozen Core</COL>.

forms.name: Great Nova
forms.text:
Made of the hardest of
crystals. Absurdly priced,
it is offered by the Guild.

forms.name: Super Nova
forms.text:
The final form of Great Nova.
Made from various ores and
shines like a brilliant star.

forms.name: Hyper Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Great Nova</COL>.

forms.name: Gun Hammer
forms.text:
A testament to modern tech.
Powder in a revolving magazine
explodes on impact.

forms.name: Deadeye Revolver
forms.text:
The Gun Hammer's final form.
Perfect for the man in search of
freedom who bows to no one.

forms.name: Burst Revolver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gun Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from a beautiful
fossil. Its black top shines
brightly as it reflects light.

forms.name: Relic Hammer
forms.text:
The Obsidian Hammer's final
form. It houses an ancient power
that gives it added strength.

forms.name: Ethereal Sideros
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Striped Striker
forms.text:
Hammer made from Tigrex
materials. One blow is
enough to shatter the earth.

forms.name: Tigrex Hammer
forms.text:
The Striped Striker's final form.
Its roar rings throughout the
land as it strikes down foes.

forms.name: Huge Tigrex Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Striped Striker</COL>.

forms.name: Brazenclout
forms.text:
A Hammer made from an Uragaan
jaw, it is one of the toughest and
hardest hammers out there.

forms.name: Gigas Hammer
forms.text:
The Brazenclout's final form,
it's a heavy hammer that requires
superhuman strength to wield.

forms.name: Grongigas Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Brazenclout</COL>.

forms.name: Type 42 Shellbuster
forms.text:
A Nibelsnarf Hammer capable of
smashing through shell.

forms.name: Fraghammer Mk.II
forms.text:
The Type 42 Shellbuster's final
form. A hidden power within
bursts forth with violent force.

forms.name: Super Fraghammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 42 Shellbuster</COL>.

forms.name: Devil Masher
forms.text:
Recall the old man who first
hunted with a Hammer; his
pupil outdid him with this.

forms.name: Iron Devil's Soul
forms.text:
The Devil Masher's final form,
it is said to have been used by a
warrior defied after his death.

forms.name: Iron Giant's Soul
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Devil Masher</COL>.

forms.name: Anvil Hammer
forms.text:
An armory anvil reforged
into a Hammer. It retains
its Sharpness well.

forms.name: Onslaught
forms.text:
The Anvil Hammer's final
form. Its heavy weight crushes
foes without mercy or remorse.

forms.name: Devastation
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Anvil Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Nitro Boost Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer with an even better
boost mechanism. Makes each
blow a brutal collision.

forms.name: Overclocker
forms.text:
The Nitro Boost Hammer's final
form. It forfeits some features
to boost speed and power.

forms.name: Logicbreaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nitro Boost Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Binding Bludgeon
forms.text:
A Hammer crafted from a shell
soaked in Volvidon fluids. It spits
out a paralytic agent on impact.

forms.name: Armored Gogue
forms.text:
The Binding Bludgeon's final
form. Its paralytic agent is
even more concentrated.

forms.name: Armored Megagogue
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Binding Bludgeon</COL>.

forms.name: War Stamp
forms.text:
Devoid of elemental powers,
but capable of destruction.
Can crush wyvern skull.

forms.name: War Basher
forms.text:
The War Stamp's final form.
It destroys giant boulders with
ease, making it loved by warriors.

forms.name: Final Battle
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>War Stamp</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer with a countenance as
hard and ruthless as a Rajang's.
Even gods flee from it.

forms.name: Demonlord Sledge
forms.text:
The final form of the Demonlord
Hammer. Much like the Rajang, it
fears nothing when enraged.

forms.name: Demonlord Maul
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Shot Crusher
forms.text:
A proper Gun Hammer, it is safer
and has even more features, so
it is loved by hunters everywhere.

forms.name: Burning Crusher
forms.text:
