The Shot Crusher's final form.
Advances in technology greatly
increase its damage and firepower.

forms.name: Steel Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shot Crusher</COL>.

forms.name: Spiked Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer featuring reinforced
steel spikes that shoot out at
foes during Charged Attacks.

forms.name: Spiked Glory
forms.text:
The Spiked Hammer's final
form features even sharper
spikes to impale its prey.

forms.name: Spiked Triumph
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiked Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Vortex Hammer
forms.text:
An electric Hammer inspired
by the whirlpools Lagiacrus
use to destroy prey.

forms.name: High Vortex Hammer
forms.text:
The Vortex Hammer's final
form, its electric current has
been boosted for extra damage.

forms.name: Giga Vortex Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vortex Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Vortical Hammer
forms.text:
An electric Hammer that
resembles a giant whirlpool
and devours all life.

forms.name: Vortastrophe
forms.text:
The Vortical Hammer's final
form. Its electric blows hit with
enough force to smash one's soul.

forms.name: Apocalyptex
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vortical Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Lobstrosity
forms.text:
A Hammer made from a lobster
shell. It possesses slight Water
Elemental capabilities.

forms.name: King Lobstrosity
forms.text:
The Lobstrosity's final form.
Its beautiful and lustrous shell
proves it is the King of Lobsters.

forms.name: Royal Lobstrosity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lobstrosity</COL>.

forms.name: Calamitous Portent
forms.text:
An eerie Hammer that features
a pair of intertwined Remobra.
It emits a sense of foreboding.

forms.name: Catastrophic Portent
forms.text:
The Calamitous Portent's final
form. It brings disaster along
with every swing.

forms.name: Cataclysmic Portent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Calamitous Portent</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Tailhammer
forms.text:
A Hammer patterned after a
Brachydios's tail. Explosive slime
fills the air with each swing.

forms.name: Brachy Tailhammer
forms.text:
The Dios Tailhammer's final
form. With even more slime, it
adds limitless explosive force.

forms.name: Explosive Tailhammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Tailhammer</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer containing the essence
of a Brachydios. Its explosive
might makes the heavens tremble.

forms.name: Novagio Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Hammer's final
form. It is capable of destroying
entire civilizations.

forms.name: Novagio Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer brimming with rage.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Qadar Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Hammer's final
form. Wielded by the one who
will lead the rebellion.

forms.name: Sedition Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Jupiter's Sphere
forms.text:
A Hammer fashioned after the tail
of a Duramboros. One good swing
can fell even a massive tree.

forms.name: Duramboros Fellmace
forms.text:
The final form of Jupiter's
Sphere. Striking the ground raises
enough dust to blot out the sun.

forms.name: Duramboros Fellmaul
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Jupiter's Sphere</COL>.

forms.name: Conehead Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made of Blango parts.
The cold it gives off with every
swing can freeze the soul.

forms.name: Great Cone
forms.text:
The Conehead Hammer's final
form. Not even mountain creatures
can bear its icy blast.

forms.name: Giant Cone
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Conehead Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Ceanataur Head Axe
forms.text:
Made from tough-to-work-with
Shogun head pieces. It's
designed for ease of use.

forms.name: Big Blue Chopper
forms.text:
The Ceanataur Head Axe's final
form. A powerful bone Hammer, it
can smash any target it faces.

forms.name: Ceanataur Chopper
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ceanataur Head Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Bag o' Horrors
forms.text:
A smelly Hammer covered in
Khezu hide. It's best not to
look inside the bag...

forms.name: Bag o' Thunder
forms.text:
The Bag o' Horrors's final form
has a Khezu power generator.
Its contents are still a mystery.

forms.name: Bag o' Booms
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bag o' Horrors</COL>.

forms.name: Meaty Press
forms.text:
An upgrade that uses finer
materials. Heavy blows from
the added spikes cut deep.

forms.name: Pressure Cooker
forms.text:
The Meaty Press's final form.
Once it reveals its murderous
intent, none escape their fate.

forms.name: Morphing Brinicle
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Meaty Press</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Bone Mace
forms.text:
A Hammer covered in Ludroth
skin. The bone construction
makes it light and sturdy.

forms.name: Ludroth Bone Maul
forms.text:
The Ludroth Bone Mace's final
form. Armed to the teeth with
ferocious intent.

forms.name: Ludroth Sledgehammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Bone Mace</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Splashhammer
forms.text:
A Hammer of Ludroth sponge.
The water inside explodes
onto the target on impact.

forms.name: Ludroth Dousehammer
forms.text:
The Ludroth Splashhammer's
final form. Crushes foes
like a tsunami.

forms.name: Lorelei
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Splashhammer</COL>.

forms.name: Revenge Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from Konchu
shell. It's even harder
than a Yian Kut-Ku's beak.

forms.name: Vindication Hammer
forms.text:
The Revenge Hammer's final
form. Serve up some just desserts
with this fistful of hurt.

forms.name: Retribution Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Revenge Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Feather Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer made from a
Maccao tail. It combines
sturdiness with light weight.

forms.name: Plume Hammer
forms.text:
The Feather Hammer's final
form. Imitates the Great
Maccao's tail attack.

forms.name: Crest Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Feather Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Plesioth Head
forms.text:
A Hammer modeled after a
Plesioth's head. It smashes
through foes like a raging river.

forms.name: Plesioth Breaker
forms.text:
The Plesioth Head's final form.
It smashes foes to pieces like
a roaring tidal wave.

forms.name: Tidal Rampage
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plesioth Head</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Thunder
forms.text:
A Hammer modeled after a demonic
thunder god's face. One swing
can reduce untold lives to dust.

forms.name: Despot's Crackle
forms.text:
The final form of the Usurper's
Thunder. Forces the masses to
bow before the thunder god.

forms.name: Oppressor's Sway
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Thunder</COL>.

forms.name: Dragonhead Hammer
forms.text:
Large Bone Hammer with a
shell made from a wyvern's
skull. Beautiful and deadly.

forms.name: Ancient Relic
forms.text:
The Dragonhead Hammer's final
form. The bound skull is as
shocking as its power.

forms.name: Forgotten Remnant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragonhead Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Leonid Starcrusher
forms.text:
One hit from this mighty Hammer
can ignite air itself, as if the sun
had somehow fallen to the earth.

forms.name: Svarog Starsmasher
forms.text:
The Leonid Starcrusher's final
form. It can strike the ground with
the force of an exploding star.

forms.name: Shamash Starbuster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Leonid Starcrusher</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Breaker
forms.text:
An ebon Hammer, black as night.
Each swing bears the weight
of impending darkness.

forms.name: Night Eternal
forms.text:
The Hidden Breaker's final
form unleashes blows that trap
prey in eternal darkness.

forms.name: Avidya Breaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Breaker</COL>.

forms.name: Raven Torrent
forms.text:
The sharpened beak of a Yian
Garuga. The power of this
black Hammer is devastating.

forms.name: Wolf Torrent
forms.text:
The Raven Torrent's final form.
Features unequaled rigidity that
deals catastrophic damage.

forms.name: Crow Torrent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raven Torrent</COL>.

forms.name: Vile Torrent
forms.text:
The black Hammer swung by the
notorious Garuga Bandit. Smashes
through thick vault doors.

forms.name: Garuga Effusion
forms.text:
The Vile Torrent's final form.
Capable of smashing through
even the stoutest of fortresses.

forms.name: Occult Effusion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vile Torrent</COL>.

forms.name: Venom Monster
forms.text:
A monstrous Hammer
that utilizes a specially
concocted poison.

forms.name: Death Venom Hammer
forms.text:
The Venom Monster's final
form. Utilizes a more potent
toxin than its base form.

forms.name: Death Venom Basher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Venom Monster</COL>.

forms.name: Le Jugement
forms.text:
A Hammer whose head is pure
Shagaru Magala material. The
claw holding it never opens.

forms.name: La Naissance
forms.text:
The final form of Le Jugement.
Casts the wicked into a pit of
suffering for all eternity.

forms.name: La Terre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Le Jugement</COL>.

forms.name: Consummate Hammer
forms.text:
The Deviljho's hungry soul,
smitten with death and still
craving yet another meal.

forms.name: Doomhammer "Blood"
forms.text:
The Consummate Hammer's final
form. Its bloodlust strikes
down foes without restraint.

forms.name: Guilthammer "Troll"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Consummate Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Polaris Hammer
forms.text:
This Hammer exists to protect
the heavens from those that
would seek to do them harm.

forms.name: Cosmic Hammer
forms.text:
The Polaris Hammer's final form
draws upon the power of the
constellations to smite foes.

forms.name: Sirius Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Polaris Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Rusted Hammer
forms.text:
A rusted Hammer with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be polished...

forms.name: Tarnished Hammer
forms.text:
The Rusted Hammer's final
form. The rust is mostly gone,
but its true shape remains hidden.

forms.name: Breath Core Hammer
forms.text:
An ancient military Hammer,
restored. Its inner core of
dragon's breath still burns.

forms.name: Lava Core Hammer
forms.text:
The Breath Core Hammer's final
form. Its hellish core contains
the source of its fiendish power.

forms.name: Crust Core Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Breath Core Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra Cratermaker
forms.text:
A Hammer as imposing as
the Teostra. One swing can
reduce castles to rubble.

forms.name: Teostra Cratergouger
forms.text:
The Teostra Cratermaker's final
form. Whole Kingdoms have
been decimated in its path.

forms.name: Teostra del Torre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra Cratermaker</COL>.

forms.name: Worn Hammer
forms.text:
A worn Hammer with
unrealized potential. It could
perhaps be restored...

forms.name: Weathered Hammer
forms.text:
The Worn Hammer's final
form, it puts to rest questions
as to why it wasn't restored.

forms.name: Aged Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Pulsating Core
forms.text:
A Hammer from a lost
civilization that crushes targets
using powerful vibrations.

forms.name: Pulse Crusher Core
forms.text:
The Pulsating Core's final form
features ancient technology that
remains a mystery even today.

forms.name: Meteoric Core
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pulsating Core</COL>.

forms.name: Icesteel Hammer
forms.text:
A weapon made by fusing
Kushala Daora materials
with an ancient hammer.

forms.name: Daora's Colossus
forms.text:
The Icesteel Hammer's final
form. Unleashed a cold wave that
wiped out an entire civilization.

forms.name: Daora's Hyperborea
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icesteel Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Purehammer
forms.text:
Special construction methods
have made this wooden Hammer
able to smash through steel.

forms.name: Yukumo Hammerfist
forms.text:
The final form of the Yukumo
Purehammer. Soaking it in a hidden
spring gives it extra hardness.

forms.name: Yukumo Holy Hammer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Purehammer</COL>.

forms.name: One Star Silver Pot
forms.text:
A splendid cooking pot. The
soul of a chef, it turns the
ordinary into a delicacy.

forms.name: Two Star Silver Pot
forms.text:
The One Star Silver Pot's final
form. Food from this pot is fit for
royalty and deities.

forms.name: Five Star Silver Pot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>One Star Silver Pot</COL>.

forms.name: Anchor Hammer
forms.text:
Enormous anchor-like Hammer
packed with a sailor's
passion for the sea.

forms.name: Anchor Crusher
forms.text:
The Anchor Hammer's final
form. It's brimming with the
passion of a man of the sea.

forms.name: Deep-Sea Anchor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Anchor Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Black Kitty Stamp
forms.text:
Made to resemble a black cat
with a devious smile. A
rare, highly desired color.

forms.name: Black Kitty Hammer
forms.text:
The final form of the Black Kitty
Stamp. Legendary in certain
circles. Treat it with care.

forms.name: Black Kitty Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Kitty Stamp</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Hammer
forms.text:
A Hammer whose terrifying blasts
reshape the land and proclaim its
godlike power to all witnesses.

forms.name: Lightbreak Pulverizer
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Hammer's final form.
The god of destruction's whims blow
everything back into nothingness.

forms.name: Lightbreak Grinder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Hammer</COL>.

forms.name: Barroth Martello
forms.text:
A large Hammer resembling a
savage Barroth. It clears a
wide path for its wielder.

forms.name: Barroth Basher
forms.text:
The Barroth Martello's final form.
Its astonishing destructive power
can stop anything in its tracks.

forms.name: Barroth Grandbasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barroth Martello</COL>.

forms.name: Cluster Musterer
forms.text:
A souped-up model that adds
materials for more power.
One swing sows destruction.

forms.name: Master Musterer
forms.text:
The Cluster Musterer's final form.
Once prohibited due to its ability
to leave wounds that never heal.

forms.name: Buster Musterer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cluster Musterer</COL>.

forms.name: Archambra Fellmace
forms.text:
A Hammer of shocking weight
and might. A good, strong swing
could decimate all of creation.

forms.name: Archambra Resurgence
forms.text:
The Archambra Fellmace's final
form. Dimensional forces mitigate
its weight for better smashing.

forms.name: Archambra Immensity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Archambra Fellmace</COL>.

forms.name: Blacksmith
forms.text:
A metal hammer with overwhelming
destructive power. Impossible to
stop once in full swing.

forms.name: Juggernaut
forms.text:
The Blacksmith's final form.
A single swing's destructive power
envelops all in the vicinity.

forms.name: Anvil Splitter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blacksmith</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Horn
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Hunting
Horn for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Horn
forms.text:
The Petrified Horn's final form.
A product of the Wycademy's
tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Horn
forms.text:
A musical weapon made from
iron. Extremely simple in both
form and function.

forms.name: Wind Horn
forms.text:
The final form of the Iron Horn.
Despite its simple looks, it's
suited to more veteran hunters.

forms.name: Grand Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made of bone
for novice hunters. People
love its balanced feature set.

forms.name: Hardened Bone Horn
forms.text:
The Bone Horn's final form. It
increases its destructive force
as well as makes it easier to use.

forms.name: Heavy Bone Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Vicello Nulo
forms.text:
A cello-like weapon woven from
Bnahabra parts. Skillful players
make truly unique music with it.

forms.name: Vicello Unu
forms.text:
The Vicello Nulo's final form.
It uses insects to increase its
functionality and durability.

forms.name: Vicello Du
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vicello Nulo</COL>.

forms.name: Velociprey Balloon
forms.text:
Made of common Velociprey
parts. Basic and easy to
use, it's a popular model.

forms.name: Velociprey Horn
forms.text:
The Velociprey Balloon's final
form. It keeps the ease of use
in addition to the upgrades.

forms.name: Azure Velociprey Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Velociprey Balloon</COL>.

forms.name: Zurogong Primo
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from Arzuros
parts. Its dulcet tones echo out
across the mountains.

forms.name: Zurogong Secundo
forms.text:
The Zurogong Primo's final
form. Its sound reverberates
with the voice of the mountains.

forms.name: Zurogong Tertio
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zurogong Primo</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Flute
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn loved by Yukumo
hunters. The bird-like design is the
secret of its success.

forms.name: Yukumo Horn
forms.text:
The Yukumo Flute's final form.
The beauty of its carved wood is
only matched by that of its sound.

forms.name: Hot Spring Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Flute</COL>.

forms.name: Metal Bagpipe
forms.text:
A large Hunting Horn made mainly
of metal. Its sonorous tones give
courage to those that hear them.

forms.name: Great Bagpipe
forms.text:
The Metal Bagpipe's final form.
Its tones instill a sense of
valor in an army's warriors.

forms.name: Energetic Bagpipe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Metal Bagpipe</COL>.

forms.name: Kut-Ku's Song
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn that uses its
special power to stir the hearts
of those that hear its song.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Cantabile
forms.text:
The final form of Kut-Ku's
Song. Its mysterious sound can
attract people from far and wide.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Tempestoso
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kut-Ku's Song</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Block
forms.text:
Made to resemble a Tetsucabra,
the materials it uses enable its
tones to soothe savage souls.

forms.name: Vermillion Frog
forms.text:
The Demon Block's final form.
It sings loudly, welcoming
souls to the afterlife.

forms.name: Temple Block
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Block</COL>.

forms.name: Fool's Harp
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn that emits
refined tones. The lovely
melodies enchant listeners.

forms.name: Jester's Harp
forms.text:
The final form of the Fool's
Harp. It plays a melody that's
beautiful, yet cruel.

forms.name: Trickster's Harp
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fool's Harp</COL>.

forms.name: Handmade Frog
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made to
produce a tranquil frog song.
Makes you think of home.

forms.name: Handcrafted Frog
forms.text:
The Handmade Frog's final form
is capable of songs that move the
soul and bring wyverns to tears.

forms.name: Artisanal Frog
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Handmade Frog</COL>.

forms.name: Magia Charm
forms.text:
A musical weapon preferred by
female hunters. Its feminine tones
echo across the hunting ground.

forms.name: Magia Charmbell
forms.text:
Due to popular demand from ladies
everywhere, the Magia Charm has
been upgraded to its final form!

forms.name: Aria Rhota
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magia Charm</COL>.

forms.name: Swell Shell
forms.text:
A musical weapon made from a
conch shell. Plays both sea
shanties and jigs with aplomb.

forms.name: Vertex Shell
forms.text:
The Swell Shell's final form.
Its sound waves were amplified
to maximize attack.

forms.name: Turban Shell
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Swell Shell</COL>.

forms.name: Poison Fungasax
forms.text:
A Horn featuring poisonous
mushrooms. In both hunting and
music, improvisation is key.

forms.name: Toxic Fungasax
forms.text:
The Poison Fungasax's final form
features poison said to make
even wyverns swing to the beat.

forms.name: Mycotoxic Fungasax
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poison Fungasax</COL>.

forms.name: Bherna Chime
forms.text:
From dusk until dawn, this loud
and clear bell has connected the
lives of the village's people.

forms.name: Blissful Chime
forms.text:
The Bherna Chime's final form.
Signals the start of a ceremony
filled with singing and dancing.

forms.name: Divine Carillon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bherna Chime</COL>.

forms.name: Airship Horn
forms.text:
This Hunting Horn recreates
a sound heard in the clouds
surrounding an airship.

forms.name: Grand Airship Horn
forms.text:
The Airship Horn's final form.
Nothing beats a concert in the
sky with your friends!

forms.name: Resonant Airship Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Airship Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Valkyrie Chordmaker
forms.text:
A musical weapon made from
Rathian parts. It functions as
both a horn and a bell.

forms.name: Queen's Chordmaker
forms.text:
The Valkyrie Chordmaker's final
form. The queen's beautiful voice
evokes feelings of life itself.

forms.name: Queen's Harmonium
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Valkyrie Chordmaker</COL>.

forms.name: Poetic Bell
forms.text:
An elegant bell left by a famous
military strategist, its clear
tone beckons death.

forms.name: Summoning Bell
forms.text:
The Poetic Bell's final form,
its elegant sound cleanses
souls before they cross over.

forms.name: Sublime Bell
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poetic Bell</COL>.

forms.name: Emerald Flap
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from the
wing membrane of an Astalos.
It echoes with mighty thunder.

forms.name: Lightning Flap
forms.text:
The Emerald Flap's final form.
Its thunderous melody strikes
terror in the hearts of foes.

forms.name: Grünlicht Flap
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Emerald Flap</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Koto
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn once used by a
shrine maiden. It is said that its
melodies can soothe the gods.

forms.name: Colossus's Koto
forms.text:
The final form of the Giant's
Koto. Able to soothe even the
angriest of gods.

forms.name: Behemoth's Koto
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Koto</COL>.

forms.name: Hell Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn that invokes
the fiery wrath of the
dreaded Glavenus.

forms.name: Glavenus Horn
forms.text:
The Hell Horn's final form.
It calls upon the Glavenus
to incinerate its enemies.

forms.name: Glavenus Hornova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hell Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Kummerklang
forms.text:
A sinister Hunting Horn
capable of razing the earth
if played by a wicked soul.

forms.name: Gramklang
forms.text:
The Kummerklang's final form. It
plays a song of destruction that
chases away both hopes and fears.

forms.name: Trauerklang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kummerklang</COL>.

forms.name: Vadya Muse
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made of Seregios
talons. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Allysyl Muse
forms.text:
The spirit of rebellion
lives on in the final
form of the Vadya Muse.

forms.name: Allysyl Rebel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>Ultimate Form</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vadya Muse</COL>.

forms.name: Blessed Ocarina
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn with a whimsical
tone. Hearkens to designs from
the western desert kingdom.

forms.name: Cursed Ocarina
forms.text:
The Blessed Ocarina's final
form plays melodies that carry
dreamily across the seas.

forms.name: Genie's Ocarina
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blessed Ocarina</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Tiple
forms.text:
An instrument of the Flame
Emperor whose fine, crimson timbre
causes fire to dance forth.

forms.name: Teostra's Orphée
forms.text:
The final form of Teostra's
Tiple, it creates dancing flames
that turn people to ash.

forms.name: Teostra's Musica
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Tiple</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Melody
forms.text:
The prayers echo throughout this
haunting melody, as it offers a
steady constant in troubled times.

forms.name: Wicked Melody
forms.text:
The Skeletal Melody's final
form, it emits the fascinating
melody of a divine messenger.

forms.name: Spica Melody
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Melody</COL>.

forms.name: Azumand Wind
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn featuring a unique
construction. Its whorls extend in
the wind, spreading pollen about.

forms.name: Fern Fan
forms.text:
The Azumand Wind's final form.
By adjusting the blow hole, it keeps
its strength without losing tone.

forms.name: Fiddlehead Fan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Azumand Wind</COL>.

forms.name: Cornupion
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn that houses a
deadly neurotoxin. The spider
web's melody lures in its prey.

forms.name: Webbed Cornupion
forms.text:
The Cornupion's final form. It
can play the terrifying melodies
of a predator in search of food.

forms.name: Gossamer Cornupion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cornupion</COL>.

forms.name: Black Lute
forms.text:
A darker than dark Hunting
Horn. Anyone who hears this
Horn feels faint.

forms.name: Onyx Lute
forms.text:
The Black Lute's final form
houses an evil force within
it--the sound of despair.

forms.name: Fatalis Menace
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Lute</COL>.

forms.name: Heavy Bagpipe
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn with a daunting
number of parts. Tricky to use,
but the performance is worth it.

forms.name: Fortissimo
forms.text:
After multiple upgrades, the
Heavy Bagpipe's final form emits
a beautiful and delicate sound.

forms.name: Rinforzato
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Heavy Bagpipe</COL>.

forms.name: Kecha Whappa
forms.text:
A masterpiece that
harmoniously weds design,
function, and timbre.

forms.name: Kechachacha Whappa
forms.text:
The Kecha Whappa's final form
features a unique form and sound
that make it a work of art.

forms.name: Kechawacky Whappa
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kecha Whappa</COL>.

forms.name: War Drum
forms.text:
Crafted using Conga fur. Its
upbeat rhythms stir the soul
and put fire in the blood.

forms.name: Rout Drum
forms.text:
The War Drum's final form.
Its discordant clangor conceals
the power to change the world.

forms.name: Victory Drum
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>War Drum</COL>.

forms.name: Sandpipe
forms.text:
An Eastern weapon that resembles a
Barroth's crown. Despite the harsh
appearance, it makes lovely sounds.

forms.name: Sandcrier
forms.text:
The Sandpipe's final form. Wild
passions break through its
delicate shapes into its music.

forms.name: Sandscreecher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sandpipe</COL>.

forms.name: Basarios Rock
forms.text:
A prototype weapon made of
Basarios parts. Uses vibrating
strings to produce sound.

forms.name: Basarios Rock Mk.II
forms.text:
The Basarios Rock's final form.
Its new mechanism induces wild,
whirling frenzies in its listeners.

forms.name: Titan's Rock
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Basarios Rock</COL>.

forms.name: War Bongo
forms.text:
Drum and fife known for
upbeat rhythms. Its tone
recalls happy gatherings.

forms.name: War Conga
forms.text:
The War Bongo's final form. Without
missing a merry beat, it can end the
beat of your enemies' hearts.

forms.name: Conga Conga
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>War Bongo</COL>.

forms.name: Bariguiro
forms.text:
A musical weapon that rubs
Barioth tusk and plate together
to create a hellish symphony.

forms.name: Algiguiro
forms.text:
The Bariguiro's final form. Play it
once, and the ice and snow will
react, dancing beautifully.

forms.name: Frigiguiro
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bariguiro</COL>.

forms.name: Denden Daiko
forms.text:
A Rajang Hunting Horn that calls
storms with the first blast and
announces victory with the next.

forms.name: Denden Doomsounder
forms.text:
The Denden Daiko's final form
gives the order for thunderclouds
in the sky to shout in triumph.

forms.name: Denden Delugesong
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Denden Daiko</COL>.

forms.name: Research Horn
forms.text:
The Hunting Horn that played at the
Soaratorium's celebratory concert.
Its tone is bright and hopeful.

forms.name: Discovery Horn
forms.text:
The Research Horn's final form.
According to the sages, star song
will awaken one's curiosity.

forms.name: Authority Trumpeteer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Blitz Works
forms.text:
An odd Hunting Horn from a
foreign land. The mysterious
tones it emits shock the soul.

forms.name: Giga Blitz Works
forms.text:
The Blitz Works's final form.
Its melodies strike the
heart as sure as lightning.

forms.name: Dengeki Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blitz Works</COL>.

forms.name: Megaphone
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn designed for
the MH Fan Club cheer squad.
Hits you for major feels.

forms.name: Gigaphone
forms.text:
The Megaphone's final form.
The perfect choice for when
you really need to be heard.

forms.name: Teraphone
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Megaphone</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn with the power
of the black god. All who hear
it are shaken to the soul.

forms.name: Akantor Dark Melody
forms.text:
The Akantor Horn's final form.
It serves to summon the conqueror
of heaven and earth.

forms.name: Akantor Dirge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Horned Flute
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white god's
tenth power: songs with the power
to destroy the world.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skysinger
forms.text:
The final form of the Ukanlos
Horned Flute, its songs can
crack open the earth.

forms.name: Ukanlos Decaysinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Horned Flute</COL>.

forms.name: Autumn Lute
forms.text:
A musical weapon that's
melodies sweep through the land
like wind over wheat fields.

forms.name: Harvest Lute
forms.text:
The final form of the Autumn
Lute. It reaps souls like
the fall harvest.

forms.name: Equinox Lute
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Autumn Lute</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Horn
forms.text:
The Hunting Horn of the Argent
Comet. The voice of the dancing
stars inspires the will to fight.

forms.name: Dragonstar Halm
forms.text:
The Silverwing Horn's final form.
"Fear me, the star singer; my songs
snuff out the flame of life."

forms.name: Magnastar Edon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn from the Soaratorium
for hunters breaking new ground.
Its soft tones are healing.

forms.name: Sage Horn
forms.text:
The Elder Horn's final form is
stronger than before, and its
polished tone can purify anything.

forms.name: Philosopher Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Memento Mosca
forms.text:
This exclusive Hunting Horn was
specially produced to celebrate the
Soaratorium's launch. Hip hip hooray!

forms.name: Mosca Select
forms.text:
The Memento Mosca's final form
has a triumphant, pioneering tone to
celebrate the launch of the ship!

forms.name: Premium Suite
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Memento Mosca</COL>.

forms.name: Lache/Sanglot
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Freude/Tristesse
forms.text:
The Lache/Sanglot's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who overcome grief.

forms.name: Grimm/Joie
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lache/Sanglot</COL>.

forms.name: Goldhorn
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a black beast
that fends off the demon of illness.

forms.name: Inscribed Bastet
forms.text:
The Goldhorn's final form.
This hunting horn accompanied
the protector of bodies.

forms.name: Menat Sekhem
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldhorn</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Firelied
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made with the soul
of a crimson Fatalis. Its demoniac
cry is said to awaken pandemonium.

forms.name: Fatalis Firelute
forms.text:
The Fatalis Firelied's final form.
Those who hear its devilish sound
are drawn to chaos and madness.

forms.name: Fatalis Flame Aria
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Firelied</COL>.

forms.name: Old Fatalis Lied
forms.text:
One night long ago, the songs
from this weapon led hundreds
of listeners to their deaths.

forms.name: Old Fatalis Lute
forms.text:
The Old Fatalis Lied's final form.
Its wicked songs led a great nation
to ruin in a single night.

forms.name: Old Fatalis Aria
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Old Fatalis Lied</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Redhelm parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crimson Great Horn
forms.text:
The Crimson Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Redhelm Arzuros.

forms.name: Crimson Superb Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Royal Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Horn
forms.text:
The Royal Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Thornflute
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Pierce Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Drilltusk parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Drilltusk Horn
forms.text:
The Pierce Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Tetsucabra Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pierce Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Horn
forms.text:
The Nightfall Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Daybreak Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Geode Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystalbeard Horn
forms.text:
The Geode Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Geode Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Hardened Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Horn
forms.text:
The Hardened Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Catastrophone
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hardened Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Tomb Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Horn
forms.text:
The Tomb Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Firewaltz Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tomb Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Raiden Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Horn
forms.text:
The Raiden Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Stormking Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raiden Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Seize Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Horn
forms.text:
The Seize Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Gong
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seize Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Magma Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Hellblade Horn
forms.text:
The Magma Horn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Glavepyre Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magma Horn</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Lyre
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Nightlcoak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Traum
forms.text:
The Cloaked Lyre's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Albtraum
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Lyre</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Castanet
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Lunatic Castanet
forms.text:
The Razor Castanet's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Castanet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Castanet</COL>!

forms.name: Vagrant's Itinerary
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Madderdance
forms.text:
Vagrant's Itinerary's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Dans Obscura
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vagrant's Itinerary</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Glide
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Boltreaver parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Zephra Wingbeat
forms.text:
The Zephra Glide's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Zilvolt Glide
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Glide</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Lute
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Singer
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Lute's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Mythmaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Lute</COL>!

forms.name: Giaprey Balloon
forms.text:
Based on a Giaprey head.
Inflating its windpipe
mimics a Giaprey's call.

forms.name: Giaprey Horn
forms.text:
The Giaprey Balloon's final
form. Its notes frighten prey
like the cry of the Giaprey.

forms.name: Silver Giaprey Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giaprey Balloon</COL>.

forms.name: Hunter's Horn
forms.text:
A high-performance Hunting Horn
still suitable for beginners. A
popular choice among hunters.

forms.name: Native's Horn
forms.text:
The final form of the Hunter's
Horn. Those that hear its notes
awaken their natural instincts.

forms.name: Primal Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hunter's Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Horn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from a
fossil. Steeped in history,
it carries a vibrant tone.

forms.name: Relic Horn
forms.text:
The Obsidian Horn's final form.
In its music resides an ancient
power, evoking a lost age.

forms.name: Ethereal Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Warhorn
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn that shreds even
metal. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Maqam Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Warhorn's final
form. Its claws can shred the soul
as it sows seeds of rebellion.

forms.name: Sedition Caller
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Warhorn</COL>.

forms.name: Droth Drone
forms.text:
A weapon made of spongy Royal
Ludroth parts. A special amplifier
blasts its songs across the land.

forms.name: Droth Roar
forms.text:
The Droth Drone's final form.
An improved amplifier provides
for a more powerful roar.

forms.name: Echoing Droth Roar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Droth Drone</COL>.

forms.name: Poisoned Capri
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Gypceros parts; modeled
after its unique beak and crest.

forms.name: Crazed Melody
forms.text:
The Poisoned Capri's final
form. Its vacant eyes lure its
prey into the valley of death.

forms.name: Lunatic Melody
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poisoned Capri</COL>.

forms.name: Larinoth Ocarina
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn whose soothing
sounds come from its use of the
resonator organ of a Larinoth.

forms.name: Resonant Ocarina
forms.text:
The Larinoth Ocarina's final
form plays a melody that evokes
feelings of an ancient forest.

forms.name: Harmonious Ocarina
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Larinoth Ocarina</COL>.

forms.name: Agnakdion
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn with ridges made
from Agnaktor parts. Mountain tribes
use it to play their holiest songs.

forms.name: Brandoneon
forms.text:
The Agnakdion's final form. Its
bellows stoke the fires of Hell
as it brands the flesh of foes.

forms.name: Scaldertina
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Agnakdion</COL>.

forms.name: Gold Chordmaker
forms.text:
A golden chordmaker once owned
by an ancient king who offered
its songs to the gods.

forms.name: Lunar Chordmaker
forms.text:
The Gold Chordmaker's final
form. Its austere melody keeps
the people calm and obedient.

forms.name: Amas Chordmaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gold Chordmaker</COL>.

forms.name: Lagia Horn
forms.text:
A musical weapon modeled after a
Lagiacrus. Its thunder summons
storms across the seven seas.

forms.name: Lagia Thunderpeal
forms.text:
The Lagia Horn's final form,
it brings rough seas as thunder
echoes across the land.

forms.name: Lagia Cannonade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagia Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Harmonic
forms.text:
An ebon Hunting Horn, black as
night. Inaudible to most, but used
as a signal in the underworld.

forms.name: Cry in the Night
forms.text:
The Hidden Harmonic's final
form. The screams of demons in
the night go unheard by man.

forms.name: Avidya Harmonic
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Harmonic</COL>.

forms.name: Poli'ahu Pipe
forms.text:
An icy horn made from supple
Zamtrios materials. Its bitter
tones chill to the bone.

forms.name: Phenomenal Phlute
forms.text:
The Poli'ahu Pipe's final form.
It plays a chilling rondo that can
freeze its prey to the very core.

forms.name: Phantasmagorical Phlute
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poli'ahu Pipe</COL>.

forms.name: Type 63 Warmonica
forms.text:
A musical weapon of Guild design.
Its tones can direct movements
while in the midst of the hunt.

forms.name: Snarfonix
forms.text:
The Type 63 Warmonica's final
form, it has been upgraded for the
purpose of slaying wyverns.

forms.name: Soldier's Snarfonica
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 63 Warmonica</COL>.

forms.name: Sonic Glass
forms.text:
Giant insect wings layered
and formed into a Hunting
Horn. Buzz-like tone.

forms.name: Glass Queen
forms.text:
The Sonic Glass's final form.
Its deafening roar can drown out
the sound of a wyvern's wings.

forms.name: Glass Monarch
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sonic Glass</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Bell
forms.text:
A chic musical weapon made from
Brachydios parts. It drops foes
with block-rocking beats.

forms.name: Napalm Bell
forms.text:
The Dios Bell's final form. Its
explosive melodies can turn any
battlefield into a wasteland.

forms.name: Firestorm Bell
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Bell</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Chime
forms.text:
A solemn musical weapon designed
to play a requiem that brings
about the end of all creation.

forms.name: Timbral Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Chime's final
form. Its crazed melodies will
lead to the apocalypse.

forms.name: Timbral Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Chime</COL>.

forms.name: Danger Call
forms.text:
The motif, a Najarala
crushing a skull, awakens
both revulsion and rapture.

forms.name: Dangerous Haar
forms.text:
The Danger Call's final form.
Its vivid tones capture the
hearts of those that hear them.

forms.name: Baleful Haar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Danger Call</COL>.

forms.name: Hazardous Call
forms.text:
An even more conflicting
instrument whose tones seize
the heart, then crush it.

forms.name: Parahazard Call
forms.text:
The Hazardous Call's final form
emits rapturous melodies that
haunt prey even after death.

forms.name: Para Calamity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hazardous Call</COL>.

forms.name: Velocidrome Balloon
forms.text:
The Velocidrome's horn
gives this Hunting Horn
a tremendous power boost.

forms.name: Velocidrome Horn
forms.text:
The Velocidrome Balloon's
final form. Its crest can
intimidate its prey at will.

forms.name: Blue Velocidrome Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Velocidrome Balloon</COL>.

forms.name: Khezu Horn
forms.text:
Made to look like the mouth
of a Khezu. You don't want to
leave it out while you sleep.

forms.name: Khezu Flute
forms.text:
In a word, it's weird. There is no
other way to describe the sounds
this thing makes.

forms.name: Khezu Keen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Khezu Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Bull Grunt
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn that uses
Bullfango hide to give its
sound a wild edge.

forms.name: Wild Grunt
forms.text:
The Bull Grunt's final form. Its
call of the wild summons beasts
from their homes in the forest.

forms.name: Barbarian Grunt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bull Grunt</COL>.

forms.name: Kecha Thumpa
forms.text:
An instrument with a more
refined look and feel.
The timbre entrances prey.

forms.name: Kecha Clanga
Kecha Clanvira
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kecha Thumpa</COL>.

forms.name: Striped Dragonga
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn made from
Tigrex materials. The fierce
wyvern roar shakes the soul.

forms.name: Tigrex Horn
forms.text:
The Striped Dragonga's final
form. Its deafening roar will
shake the earth beneath you.

forms.name: Tigrex Roar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Striped Dragonga</COL>.

forms.name: Brazengaita
forms.text:
A musical weapon made of Uragaan
parts. The tones it produces are
sharp enough to cut steel.

forms.name: Gigas Gaita
forms.text:
The Brazengaita's final form.
Its tones can breathe life into
the starkest of landscapes.

forms.name: Archgigas Gaita
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Brazengaita</COL>.

forms.name: Mountain Crusher
forms.text:
Its tones share the power of
a Duramboros, able to uproot
trees and topple mountains.

forms.name: Mountain Echo
forms.text:
The Mountain Crusher's final
form. Its low rumbling signals
the beginning of the end.

forms.name: Peak Performance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mountain Crusher</COL>.

forms.name: Shell Castanet
forms.text:
Blowing causes the claw to
strike the shell. Features
peculiar note characteristics.

forms.name: Colored Castanet
forms.text:
The Shell Castanet's final
form. It's capable of more
powerful sounds and attacks.

forms.name: Twinshell Castanet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shell Castanet</COL>.

forms.name: Vicello Nulo (G)
forms.text:
A cello-like weapon woven from
Bnahabra parts. Houses a paralytic
agent that can immobilize foes.

forms.name: Vicello Unu (G)
forms.text:
The Vicello Nulo (G)'s final
form. Hitting it hard causes it to
excrete its paralytic agent.

forms.name: Vicello Du (G)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vicello Nulo (G)</COL>.

forms.name: Vicello Nulo (R)
forms.text:
A cello-like weapon milled from
Bnahabra kills. Its trills will
chill monster spines and frills.

forms.name: Vicello Unu (R)
forms.text:
The Vicello Nulo (R)'s final
form. Crimson flames rise up
from its strings to burn foes.

forms.name: Vicello Du (R)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vicello Nulo (R)</COL>.

forms.name: Vicello Nulo (W)
forms.text:
A cello-like weapon woven from
Bnahabra parts. The cold body
produces chilling tones.

forms.name: Vicello Unu (W)
forms.text:
The Vicello Nulo (W)'s final
form. Send a chill up a
monster's spine, then break it.

forms.name: Vicello Du (W)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vicello Nulo (W)</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Growl
forms.text:
A guitar-like Hunting Horn filled
with a monarch's wrath. Playing it
releases his fighting spirit.

forms.name: Despot's Thunderclap
forms.text:
The final form of the Usurper's
Growl, the monarch's roar strikes
down those who oppose him.

forms.name: Oppressor's Boon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Growl</COL>.

forms.name: Lava Alphorn
forms.text:
Fire-elemental Horn. Was
used by ancient people to
calm an erupting volcano.

forms.name: Volcano Alphorn
forms.text:
The Lava Alphorn's final
form. It soothes even the
mountain gods themselves.

forms.name: Magma Alphorn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lava Alphorn</COL>.

forms.name: Raven Shamisen
forms.text:
Weapon created from Yian
Garuga tail. The 3 strings
twang in nostalgic tones.

forms.name: Wolf Shamisen
forms.text:
Life is filled with vicissitudes.
The Raven Shamisen's final
form is fraught with sorrow.

forms.name: Crow Shamisen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raven Shamisen</COL>.

forms.name: Vile Shamisen
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn upon which the
wandering Garuga Sage played his
sad, ephemeral song.

forms.name: Garuga Shamisen
forms.text:
The Vile Shamisen's final
form plays a sad song of the
Garuga Sage's endless journey.

forms.name: Occult Shamisen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vile Shamisen</COL>.

forms.name: Dodotto Horn
forms.text:
A traditional instrument that
is used by tribes that live in
the snowy mountain lands.

forms.name: White Dodotto Horn
forms.text:
The Dodotto Horn's final
form, within its melodies lie
the soul of the snow god.

forms.name: Grand Dodotto Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dodotto Horn</COL>.

forms.name: La Sépulture
forms.text:
A sacred Hunting Horn that
could return a worthy hunter
from the brink of death.

forms.name: La Joie
forms.text:
The final form of La Sépulture, it
turns despair into hope, playing
a stirring song of life and survival.

forms.name: Le Grégorien
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>La Sépulture</COL>.

forms.name: Polaris Wraith
forms.text:
The prayers of this musical weapon
grant the wishes of the stars and
bring tranquility to the cosmos.

forms.name: Cosmic Wraith
forms.text:
The Polaris Wraith's final form.
It plays the sounds of the cosmos
to heal anguish and bring delight.

forms.name: Lodestar Wraith
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Polaris Wraith</COL>.

forms.name: Worn Horn
forms.text:
A worn Hunting Horn with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be restored...

forms.name: Weathered Horn
forms.text:
The final form of the Worn Horn,
it shows the destructive power
of rust and the passage of time.

forms.name: Aged Horn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Avenir's Music Box
forms.text:
A musical device they say once
foretold the future. Modern tech
has given it new life as a weapon.

forms.name: Eternal Music Box
forms.text:
The final form of Avenir's Music
Box, its true sound has been
restored, but to what end...?

forms.name: Perpetual Music Box
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Avenir's Music Box</COL>.

forms.name: Daora's Taus
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn fashioned after
a beast of steel; its cold
tones bewitch prey.

forms.name: Daora's Baphophone
forms.text:
The final form of Daora's Taus.
Capable of stealing the souls of
its prey with a chilling melody.

forms.name: Daora's Diabassoon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daora's Taus</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Pureflute
forms.text:
The pure form of the Yukumo
Flute, the pure superiority of its
sound is clear to all who hear it.

forms.name: Yukumo Spirit Flute
forms.text:
The Yukumo Pureflute's final
form. Hearing its melody leaves
creatures with bated breath.

forms.name: Yukumo Aura Flute
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Pureflute</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Timbre
forms.text:
A shining Hunting Horn whose
fiery strains rouse the gods from
sleep and herald our demise.

forms.name: Lightbreak Seismograph
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Timbre's final form.
Legend says it will sing the song
that ends the world.

forms.name: Lightbreak Claque
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Timbre</COL>.

forms.name: Volcanic Rock
forms.text:
A blue Hunting Horn made of
valuable Basarios materials
with a sob-inducing tone.

forms.name: Volcanic Gig
forms.text:
The Volcanic Rock's final form.
Some people have been known to
faint upon hearing it.

forms.name: Conflagrig
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Volcanic Rock</COL>.

forms.name: Sandsinger
forms.text:
A musical weapon made of Barroth
parts. Its sad songs tell of grand
battles in desolate wastelands.

forms.name: Sandsoother
forms.text:
The Sandsinger's final form. Its
strong tone makes the very
air tremble, overwhelmed.

forms.name: Sandrigal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sandsinger</COL>.

forms.name: Glass Royale
forms.text:
A Hunting Horn used by a queen
to steal and seal a holy song.
She was turned into a bug.

forms.name: Queen's Flute
forms.text:
The Glass Royale's final form
channels the soul-rending grief of
the transformed queen.

forms.name: Queen's Flute II
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Glass Royale</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Lance
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Lance
for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Lance
forms.text:
The Petrified Lance's
final form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Lance
forms.text:
A Lance for newcomers
made with lots of attention
to minute details.

forms.name: Millennial Lance
forms.text:
The Iron Lance's final
form comes with crystals
that give it more oomph.

forms.name: New Millennium
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Lance
forms.text:
A bone Lance that stands up
to snuff. Fans love its
wild decorative bits.

forms.name: Hard Bone Lance
forms.text:
The Bone Lance's supreme
form reigns as the king of
savage weaponry.

forms.name: Heavy Bone Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Longhorn Spear
forms.text:
A straightforward Lance
that's light, sturdy, and
easy to maintain.

forms.name: Longtusk Spear
forms.text:
The Longhorn Spear's final
form. Long and sturdy,
poking it is plain ol' fun.

forms.name: Longfang Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Longhorn Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Spiked Spear
forms.text:
A lightweight weapon that is
easy to craft and easier to
use, giving it many fans.

forms.name: Spiked Javelin
forms.text:
The Spiked Spear's final form.
Striking at an enemy's vitals
with it feels all too natural.

forms.name: Merciless Spike
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiked Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Ploshasta
forms.text:
A Lance made of Rhenoplos
parts that's balanced
and handles well.

forms.name: Rhenohasta
forms.text:
The Ploshasta's final
form is well balanced to
handle every situation.

forms.name: Rhenoplos Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ploshasta</COL>.

forms.name: Wild Boar Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from parts of a
savage boar. It fills the bearer
with vigor and focused power.

forms.name: Bulldrome Spear
forms.text:
The Wild Boar Lance's final
form. The boar soul inside
is restless during a hunt.

forms.name: Bulldrome Tuskspear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wild Boar Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made of sturdy wood
that finds use all around
Yukumo Village.

forms.name: Yukumo Stinger
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the
Yukumo Lance makes stabbing
all the more intuitive.

forms.name: Hot Spring Stinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Claw Lance
forms.text:
More than adequate as a beginner's
Lance. Dazzles others with the
vivid white and red color scheme.

forms.name: Red Lord Lance
forms.text:
The Bone Claw Lance's final
form. Its obscene red shade
darkens with use.

forms.name: Red Crab Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Claw Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Blue Crater
forms.text:
A Lance whose ore holds
ancient memories. Impressive
in its natural greatness.

forms.name: Doom Crown
forms.text:
The Blue Crater's final
form. Trying to stop this is
like stopping time: futile.

forms.name: Eterno Crown
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blue Crater</COL>.

forms.name: Frontrider Lance
forms.text:
The Lance upon which a
foreign general raised his
banner in ancient battles.

forms.name: Warcry Lance
forms.text:
The Frontrider Lance's final
form can handle multiple
attackers with ease.

forms.name: Decisive Battle Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Frontrider Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Native Spear
forms.text:
A poison Lance that's seen
use since ancient times.
Still beloved to this day.

forms.name: Primal Spear
forms.text:
The Native Spear's final
form transcends the designs
of past and present.

forms.name: Primeval Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Native Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Vacuum Striker
forms.text:
A Spear held by a legendary
female hunter who was often
called "The Janitor."

forms.name: Hyper Vacuum
forms.text:
"The Janitor" is the nickname
awaiting those who take up the
Vacuum Striker's final form.

forms.name: Mysophobic Scream
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vacuum Striker</COL>.

forms.name: Fragrance
forms.text:
A Lance modeled after a
flower bud. Looks beautiful
and gives off a fragrant odor.

forms.name: Classy Fragrance
forms.text:
The Fragrance's final
form is perfumed to the
point of excess, really.

forms.name: Elegant Fragrance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fragrance</COL>.

forms.name: Plegis Needle
forms.text:
A Lance that makes creative use
of paralytic mushrooms. Toxins
seep into foes with each thrust.

forms.name: Mighty Plegis
forms.text:
The Plegis Needle's final
form can knock monsters
paralyzingly senseless.

forms.name: Mycetic Stupor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plegis Needle</COL>.

forms.name: Fondue Lance
forms.text:
An all-too-delectable Lance
defined by its flowing fount
of delicious cheese.

forms.name: Gruyère Lance
forms.text:
The Fondue Lance's final
form. Far, far too tasty to
deserve a life of combat.

forms.name: Raclette Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fondue Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Blimp Lance
forms.text:
For the traveler inside every
true hunter. Produces gusts
of majestic wind.

forms.name: Aeroprio
forms.text:
The Blimp Lance's final
form. Nothing stops this
cruiser! All aboard!

forms.name: Zeppelin Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blimp Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Paladin Lance
forms.text:
A Lance given to a battle-
hardened knight. Notable for
its large shield.

forms.name: Rampart
forms.text:
The Paladin Lance's final
form. Well-balanced and
true to the chivalric code.

forms.name: Watchtower
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Paladin Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Incessant Raven
forms.text:
A black Lance made from Yian
Garuga parts. The tapered
point will break any defense.

forms.name: Incessant Wolf
forms.text:
The Incessant Raven's final
iteration. Every swing shaves
away at the prey's life energy.

forms.name: Incessant Crow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Incessant Raven</COL>.

forms.name: Acrus Lance
forms.text:
A fearsome Lance made from
Lagiacrus materials. Jolts its
prey with electricity.

forms.name: High Acrus Lance
forms.text:
Each attack from the Acrus
Lance's final form carries the
sea god's unbridled fury.

forms.name: Exacrus Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Acrus Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Hana mo Hana Nare
forms.text:
Like flower petals in the
wind, this Lance reminds all
of life's ephemeral nature.

forms.name: Kimi ga Kiru
forms.text:
The Hana mo Hana Nare's
final form. Beautifully
dispenses with life.

forms.name: Kimi ga Kiru Kasa
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hana mo Hana Nare</COL>.

forms.name: Verdant Tail
forms.text:
A Lance forged from an Astalos
tail. Thin, but thin's all
you need to carry thunder.

forms.name: Lightning Spear
forms.text:
The Verdant Tail's final
upgrade. You can't beat 100%
lightning. Just don't try.

forms.name: Verdant Lightning
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verdant Tail</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Jouster
forms.text:
A Lance once used by
a maiden, embodying the
dignity of the mountain gods.

forms.name: Colossus's Jouster
forms.text:
The Giant's Jouster's final
form. Once part of a trap
maidens set to fell a god.

forms.name: Behemoth's Jouster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Jouster</COL>.

forms.name: Svarog Blazer
forms.text:
A deadly Lance clad in dark
flames that thoroughly
dismembers opposition.

forms.name: Glavenus Granat
forms.text:
The Svarog Blazer's final
form leaves gaping holes
of chaos in its enemies.

forms.name: Glavenus Grandnova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Svarog Blazer</COL>.

forms.name: Eiferschild
forms.text:
An ogreish shield to bind the
soul, and a black trident to
ferry it to the netherworld.

forms.name: Fieberschild
forms.text:
The Eiferschild's final
incarnation craves any and
all souls it can find.

forms.name: Zornesschild
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eiferschild</COL>.

forms.name: Harbah Lance
forms.text:
A Lance assembled from Seregios
blades. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Turbulent Lance
forms.text:
The Harbah Lance's final
form. Its sharpness grants
it a menacing air.

forms.name: Rebellion Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Harbah Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Thunderspear
forms.text:
A Lance that unleashes thunder.
"And with the thunder, the
world is returned to dust."

forms.name: Thunderlance
forms.text:
The Thunderspear's final
form is nothing short of
a portable thundercloud.

forms.name: Naar Thunderlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunderspear</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Lance
forms.text:
Devilish horns adorn this
truly hellish Lance that's sure
to deliver abundant chaos.

forms.name: Infernal Lance
forms.text:
The Skeletal Lance's final
form sears with enmity as
its wielder heralds ruin.

forms.name: Algedi Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Sharq Byte
forms.text:
Resembles the most famous of
beach menaces. May elicit
gunfire from wary friends.

forms.name: Sharq Attaq
forms.text:
The Sharq Byte's final form.
Swim with caution when
this Lance is out.

forms.name: Sharq Assawlt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sharq Byte</COL>.

forms.name: Alacrantze
forms.text:
Its resemblance to scorpions
isn't skin deep; even pricks
from this are poisonous.

forms.name: Scorpion Lance
forms.text:
The Alacrantze's final
form packs poison that can
knock out large dragons.

forms.name: Hadrurus Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alacrantze</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that recalls the
blood and sweat of training,
bringing fond memories.

forms.name: Shihan Lance
forms.text:
The Black Belt Lance's final
form. A testament to your
progress as a hunter.

forms.name: Grandmaster Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Black Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that holds a dark
power within. The despair
within eats at its user.

forms.name: Chrono Lance
forms.text:
The Black Lance's final
form. Nothing short of a
harbinger of destruction.

forms.name: Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Squire Spear
forms.text:
Made from quality ore, its
medieval aesthetic makes
it feel positively knightly.

forms.name: Knight Spear
forms.text:
The Squire Spear's final
upgrade could hold court
with the best knights.

forms.name: Chivalric Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Squire Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Barbaroi Tusk
forms.text:
Improved Bone Lance.
Treasured by the hunters
of the hinterlands.

forms.name: Ogre Tusk
forms.text:
The Barbaroi Tusk's final
form. Why have extra frills
if they'll just get dirty?

forms.name: Great Ogre Tusk
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barbaroi Tusk</COL>.

forms.name: Expelger
forms.text:
An unusual Lance with a new,
advanced action that ejects
four blades when drawn.

forms.name: Expelgorer
forms.text:
The Expelger's final
upgrade can trap prey in
in an unrelenting grasp.

forms.name: Expelgasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expelger</COL>.

forms.name: Aqua Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made with quality
Piscine parts, known to boost
elemental properties.

forms.name: Stream Spear
forms.text:
The Aqua Spear's final form
shoots water that tears
at a cellular level.

forms.name: Oceanic Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aqua Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Shock Lance
forms.text:
The discharge from the
Thunderbug in this lance
is a real knockout.

forms.name: Paralyzer
forms.text:
The Shock Lance's final form
has a discharge that completely
immobilizes its prey.

forms.name: Trident
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shock Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Rugged Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that's as solid as a
Barroth. Better for sweeping
than for thrusting.

forms.name: Barroth Carver
forms.text:
The Rugged Lance's final form.
Crafted to be so hard that
nothing can break it.

forms.name: Barroth Borer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rugged Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Venom Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from poisonous
Basarios parts. Injects
venom into enemies.

forms.name: Basarios Venom Spear
forms.text:
The Venom Lance's final form
has poison capable of stopping
any beating heart.

forms.name: Basalt Venom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Venom Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Guardian Lance
forms.text:
A fine, dignified Lance
that's on par with those
doled out by the royal guard.

forms.name: Aged Holy Lance
forms.text:
The Guardian Lance's final
form. When in use, other
hunters give it a wide berth.

forms.name: Holy Protector Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guardian Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Tusk Lance
forms.text:
An icy Lance made from a
Barioth tusk. Cold enough
to freeze vapor in the air.

forms.name: Sabertooth
forms.text:
The Tusk Lance's final form
rules the cold and strikes
faster than frostbite.

forms.name: Ivory Ice
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tusk Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Gravios Spear
forms.text:
A Lance crowned with the name
Gravios. Handle it poorly and
you may fall foul of its venom.

forms.name: Gravios Venom Spear
forms.text:
The Gravios Spear's final form.
Can be thrust through armor,
bone, even souls.

forms.name: Gravios Toxic Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gravios Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Lance
forms.text:
A golden Lance made of
beautiful Rajang horn. Its
thrust releases lightning.

forms.name: Great Demon Lance
forms.text:
The lightning the Demon
Lance's final form shoots
can bring forth disaster.

forms.name: Demonlance Rajang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Grief Lance
forms.text:
A dragon-slayer Lance filled with
the force of a Deviljho, giving it
fearsome destructive power.

forms.name: Fiendish Tower
forms.text:
So strong is the Grief Lance's
final form that it even
crushes dragon bones.

forms.name: Nero's Atrocity
