forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grief Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Expert Lance
forms.text:
Inscribed with "Well Done",
this Lance is given to the
top students in training.

forms.name: Warrior's Lance
forms.text:
The Expert Lance's final
form. Engraved with the
words, "Keep going."

forms.name: Unrivaled Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expert Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from the thick,
sharp horn of a Diablos,
the dignified desert king.

forms.name: Diablos Spear
forms.text:
The Diablos Lance's final form.
This majestic weapon's tip
eradicates any opposition.

forms.name: Cera Creos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Research Lance
forms.text:
The tip of this Wycademy-conceived
lance can be used as a pen, and the
shaft doubles as a ruler.

forms.name: Discovery Lance
forms.text:
The Research Lance's final form.
It is said that wisdom is a lance
that pierces through malice.

forms.name: Authority Crowbeak
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Brain Fox
forms.text:
A weapon crafted with the
latest technology. Incomplete,
it is merely used as a spear.

forms.name: Discovery Corps Lance
forms.text:
The Brain Fox's final form.
Adapted from a prototype,
its power is unequaled.

forms.name: Telltail
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Brain Fox</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Calamity
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's first power: prayer.
Strong enough to erase the land.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skysweeper
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Calamity's final
form. It once carved away
both the land and the sky.

forms.name: Ukanlos Cataclysm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Calamity</COL>.

forms.name: Ominous Cloud
forms.text:
The manifestation of a god
who judges all from on
high atop a pure white peak.

forms.name: Heavenly Insight
forms.text:
The Ominous Cloud's final
form can avert calamity with
just a single swing.

forms.name: Raging Heavens
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ominous Cloud</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Lance
forms.text:
A Lance fashioned after an
Alatreon's horns. Some say
it's a key to another world.

forms.name: Alatreon Gleam
forms.text:
The Alatreon Lance's final
form. Too godly for most
mortals to wield.

forms.name: Altheos Gloralis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Spear
forms.text:
The silver Spear of the Argent
Comet. It flashes like a ray of light
through anything in its path.

forms.name: Dragonstar Enk
forms.text:
The Silverwing Spear's final form.
"Fear me, the star-chiller; I strike
ruthlessly, and without warning."

forms.name: Magnastar Cenek
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Lance
forms.text:
A Lance from the Soaratorium for
hunters breaking new ground. Tough
enough to pierce even stone.

forms.name: Sage Lance
forms.text:
The Elder Lance's final form is
light and agile enough to
pierce the very heavens.

forms.name: Philosopher Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Memento Baroni
forms.text:
This limited-run Lance was specially
produced to commemorate the
Soaratorium's launch. Hip hip hooray!

forms.name: Baroni Select
forms.text:
The Memento Baroni's final form
marks the Soaratorium's voyage
into new lands. Full speed ahead!

forms.name: Zepellix
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Memento Baroni</COL>.

forms.name: Gorgonzolance
forms.text:
Melted blue cheese tops the
pride of culinary treats and
is a thrill to the palate.

forms.name: Hot Gorgonzolance
forms.text:
The Gorgonzolance's final form.
Guaranteeed to satisfy any
cheese-lover's appetite.

forms.name: Nutty Gorgonzolance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gorgonzolance</COL>.

forms.name: Ace Lance
forms.text:
Loved by the best lancers.
Complements black clothing by
looking dark and foreboding.

forms.name: Loyal Ace Lance
forms.text:
The Ace Lance's final form
can help overcome any adversity.

forms.name: The Lancer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ace Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Ehrlich/Faux
forms.text:
A demonic Lance whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Beschützer/Méchant
forms.text:
The Ehrlich/Faux's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would destroy evil.

forms.name: Luzifer/Sage
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ehrlich/Faux</COL>.

forms.name: Vermilion Rim
forms.text:
Only dragon slayers are allowed
to use this weapon, but those who
do, wipe out dragons easily.

forms.name: Draconic Rim
forms.text:
The Vermilion Rim's final form.
Hits with the ferocity of a
dragon's charge.

forms.name: Sealed Dragonlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vermilion Rim</COL>.

forms.name: Goldspear
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a guardian
who conquered the desert.

forms.name: Inscribed Selcis
forms.text:
The Goldspear's final form
was brought into being by
a goddess of healing.

forms.name: Serket-Hetit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldspear</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Lance
forms.text:
A Dragon Lance that dispels
darkness. Pulsates when a
dragon is near.

forms.name: True Ruiner Lance
forms.text:
The Ruiner Lance's final form
is capable of piercing through
its prey's heart and soul.

forms.name: True Obliterator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Lance</COL>.

forms.name: O. Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
A ghostly Lance with an old
Fatalis's gleam. It races across
the earth like a divine ray.

forms.name: True O. Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
The O. Fatalis Lance's final form
could even pierce through the
realm of the gods.

forms.name: Eternal O. Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>O. Fatalis Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Stonefist Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Greatlance
forms.text:
The Stonefist Lance's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Giantlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stonefist Lance</COL>!

forms.name: Dreadqueen Thorn
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Rose
forms.text:
The Dreadqueen Thorn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Barb
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dreadqueen Thorn</COL>!

forms.name: Gale Stinger
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Radiant Shower
forms.text:
The Gale Stinger's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Dawn Wind Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gale Stinger</COL>!

forms.name: Incessant Calamity
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Lance
forms.text:
The Incessant Calamity's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Deadeye Calamity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Incessant Calamity</COL>!

forms.name: Groad Tail
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Tail
forms.text:
The Groad Tail's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Schwarz Tail
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Groad Tail</COL>!

forms.name: Thunderlord Tenrai
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Growl
forms.text:
The Thunderlord Tenrai's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thunderlord Roar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunderlord Tenrai</COL>!

forms.name: Rudra Stinger
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Lance
forms.text:
The Rudra Stinger's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Elan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rudra Stinger</COL>!

forms.name: Svarog Boomer
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Hellblade Granat
forms.text:
The Svarog Boomer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Hellblade Granat Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Svarog Boomer</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Coloris
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Dormir
forms.text:
The Cloaked Coloris's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Sommeil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Coloris</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Stinger
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thoughtless Stinger
forms.text:
The Razor Stinger's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Stinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Stinger</COL>!

forms.name: Hika Rakuyo
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Okimi Tsubame
forms.text:
The Hika Rakuyo's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Okimi Kaisei
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hika Rakuyo</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Tail
forms.text:
A Lance made from Boltreaver
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Zephra Scourge
forms.text:
The Zephra Tail's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Zilvolt Tail
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Tail</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Stomper
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Spear's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Stampede
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Lance</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Pike
forms.text:
The Massacre Lance's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Tsautsau
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Lance</COL>!

forms.name: Drill Lance
forms.text:
A mechanical Lance once used to
mine ore. Its rotator mechanism
can release electricity.

forms.name: Gigadrill Lance
forms.text:
The Drill Lance's final
form can turn prey into
living lightning rods.

forms.name: Exadrill Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Drill Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Naag Serpentblade
forms.text:
Poisoned Lance made from
Remobras material. Made to
cause pain and suffering.

forms.name: Devta Serpentblade
forms.text:
The Naag Serpentblade's
final form. Laced with a
cripplingly painful poison.

forms.name: OuroborosSerpntblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Naag Serpentblade</COL>.

forms.name: Lava Cone
forms.text:
A hellishly hot Lance made
to resemble the volcano
from whence it came.

forms.name: Magma Pike
forms.text:
The Lava Cone's final
form seethes with heat,
ready to burn it all down.

forms.name: Volcanic Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lava Cone</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Lance
forms.text:
A Lance forged from an ebon
fossil. Polished enough to
shine even in the abyss.

forms.name: Obsidian Partisan
forms.text:
The Obsidian Lance's
final form. Strikes from its
obsidian tip are lethal.

forms.name: Ethereal Partisan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Cross Coloris
forms.text:
A Lance so beautiful that
it's almost a privilege to
be impaled by it.

forms.name: Duke Dormir
forms.text:
The Cross Coloris's final
form. Its noble beauty has
an otherworldly gleam.

forms.name: Archduke Pesadormir
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cross Coloris</COL>.

forms.name: Incessant Evil
forms.text:
One of countless cruel Lances
used by the Garuga Army to
terrorize neighboring lands.

forms.name: Garuga Incessance
forms.text:
The Incessant Evil's final
form. Used to forge paths
most foul and wicked.

forms.name: Occult Incessance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Incessant Evil</COL>.

forms.name: Twistcrawl
forms.text:
A Lance becoiled by the
Najarala. Versatile, it
enhances Attack and Defense.

forms.name: Writhing Crawler
forms.text:
The Twistcrawl's final
form. Painful scales enter
the body with each thrust.

forms.name: Spinning Crawler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twistcrawl</COL>.

forms.name: Twisting Crawler
forms.text:
An unassailable Lance with
many sharp blades and
solid Attack and Defense.

forms.name: Paratwist Crawler
forms.text:
The Twisting Crawler's final
form stuns prey like a Kelbi
caught in torchlight.

forms.name: Paragyred Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twisting Crawler</COL>.

forms.name: Boros Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made from the firm
horns of a Duramboros. It can
fell a tree with a single blow.

forms.name: Temblor Illboros
forms.text:
The Boros Spear's final
form combines the majesty
and harshness of nature.

forms.name: Vertex Strongboros
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Boros Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Estoc
forms.text:
A jeweled Lance that's just
as useful in real world
combat as it is pretty.

forms.name: Valhalla
forms.text:
The Estoc's final upgrade
is engineered to make
resistance futile.

forms.name: Einherjar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Estoc</COL>.

forms.name: Babel Spear
forms.text:
A golden Lance as stately as
its tower namesake, with both
good offense and defense.

forms.name: Elder Babel Spear
forms.text:
True to its name, the Babel
Spear's final form is
wholly blasphemous.

forms.name: Lost Babel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Babel Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Growling Wyvern
forms.text:
A Spear so formidable its
owner can fend disaster
off singlehandedly.

forms.name: Roaring Wyvern
forms.text:
The strength of the Growling
Wyvern's final form is limited
only by the wielder's limits.

forms.name: Raging Wyvern
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Growling Wyvern</COL>.

forms.name: Tiger Stinger
forms.text:
A weapon that's as strong as
it looks. Can pierce anything
that gets in its way.

forms.name: Tigrex Lance
forms.text:
The Tiger Stinger's final
form is made only to stab
really, REALLY well.

forms.name: Great Tigrex Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tiger Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Thane Lance
forms.text:
A large Lance forged of hard
ore. Traditionally used as
an official knightly weapon.

forms.name: Knight Lance
forms.text:
A quality knight deserves
nothing less than the Thane
Lance's final form.

forms.name: Cavalry Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thane Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Doris Spear
forms.text:
Lagiacrus's lightning in Lance
form. Those it touches are
reduced to sea foam.

forms.name: Stormy Doris
forms.text:
The Doris Spear's final
form wields dominion over
both sea and sky.

forms.name: Perfect Storm Doris
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Doris Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Steel Knight's Pike
forms.text:
Lance of the Iron Knights,
mercenaries said to seek
the secrets of dragon riding.

forms.name: Grayburg Javelin
forms.text:
Wielders of the final form of
the Steel Knight's Pike cast
the shadow of a wyvern.

forms.name: Steel Grayburg
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Steel Knight's Pike</COL>.

forms.name: Dragon Rider Spear
forms.text:
Used by a mercenary leader
who disappeared searching for
wyverns. Nothing is sharper.

forms.name: Dragoon's Gáe Bulg
forms.text:
The Dragon Rider Spear's
final form. Made for dragon
tamers of the modern age.

forms.name: Pure Gáe Bulg
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragon Rider Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Stinger
forms.text:
An ebon Lance, black as night.
Its bloodlust blots out the sky,
enmeshing all in gloom.

forms.name: Night Rains Black
forms.text:
The Hidden Stinger's final
form puts any monster out
of its misery fast.

forms.name: Avidya Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Rockabye Spear
forms.text:
A Lance built top to bottom
with components tailored
to inflict Sleep.

forms.name: Requiem Spear
forms.text:
The Rockabye Spear's final
form. Releases chemicals that
can put its prey to sleep.

forms.name: Nightmare Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rockabye Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Type 43 Dragonlance
forms.text:
Anti-air weaponry converted
into the sleek form of a
slim, compact Lance.

forms.name: Drakenwerfer
forms.text:
The Type 43 Dragonlance's
final form. It's almost artful
how well it performs.

forms.name: Dragon's Howl
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 43 Dragonlance</COL>.

forms.name: Giant Tusk
forms.text:
Made of high-density bone
and little else. The quality
of the material used is key.

forms.name: Brutal Tusk
forms.text:
The Giant Tusk's final
form. Extra sharp for
the smoothest stabs.

forms.name: Slaughter Tusk
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant Tusk</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that carves its fury into
foes. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Hadad Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Lance's final
form. Waving it is akin to a
bold declaration of war.

forms.name: Sedition Stabber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Barbarian Tusk
forms.text:
Spear popular among the
roughest and rowdiest hunters.
Also called a "Skull Lance."

forms.name: Barbarian Fang
forms.text:
The Barbarian Tusk's final
form. For when a messy,
brutal stab is in order.

forms.name: Barbarian Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barbarian Tusk</COL>.

forms.name: Ceanataur Stinger
forms.text:
Offensive Lance with great
Sharpness. Made from the
hard shell of a Shogun.

forms.name: Ceanataur Piercer
forms.text:
The Ceanataur Stinger's
final form effortlessly
pinpoints a foe's vitals.

forms.name: Master Piercer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ceanataur Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Volvi Stroke
Volvi Sweep
forms.text:
The Volvi Stroke's final
form has flexibility that
makes kills extra quick.

forms.name: Volvi Swindler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Volvi Stroke</COL>.

forms.name: Spiral Heat
forms.text:
A Lance made from the beak
of an Agnaktor. Capable of
piercing solid rock.

forms.name: Agnaktor Firelance
forms.text:
Swirls of fire quickly turn
all to ash with the Spiral
Heat's final form.

forms.name: Vaskignator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiral Heat</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Coming
forms.text:
A Lance embodying a fierce king.
Erases foes from existence with
lightning-filled thrusts.

forms.name: Despot's Cacophony
forms.text:
Banish the unworthy to hell
with the final form of
the Usurper's Coming.

forms.name: Oppressor's Genesis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Coming</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Bone Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made of Ludroth bone.
Its drill-like shape enhances
the weapon's piercing power.

forms.name: Ludroth Impaler
forms.text:
Penetrate flesh deeply using
the spiral on the Ludroth
Bone Spear's final form.

forms.name: Ludroth Foampaler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Bone Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Spiral Lance
forms.text:
A water-filled Lance made of
Royal Ludroth bone. Shoots
pressurized water into prey.

forms.name: Spiral Splash
forms.text:
The Spiral Lance's final
form shoots water that
drills deep into flesh.

forms.name: Spiral Vortex
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiral Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Dark Lance
forms.text:
A black Lance fashioned from
rigid Neopteron parts. The
horn contains a stun agent.

forms.name: Dark Spear
forms.text:
The Dark Lance's final
form. Its paralyzing agents
wreak all sorts of havoc.

forms.name: Dark Chainer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made with Rajang horn.
Its angry, golden glow darts at
targets with lightning force.

forms.name: Demonlord Rajang
forms.text:
The twisted end on the
final Demonlord Spear form
ravages its targets.

forms.name: Demonlord Impaler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Expelgouger
forms.text:
The four blades that eject
on draw are designed to
eviscerate, not pierce.

forms.name: Rexpelgouger
forms.text:
The Expelgouger's final form.
Once pierced by its wicked
spear tip, there is no escape.

forms.name: Shuraba Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expelgouger</COL>.

forms.name: Carnivicious
forms.text:
A Lance made of a sharpened
Zamtrios tail. Slips into
prey, then rips it apart.

forms.name: Carnivile
forms.text:
The Carnivicious's final
form. Freezes and stabs,
leaving lasting scars.

forms.name: Carnicidal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Carnivicious</COL>.

forms.name: Omnivicious
forms.text:
An advanced Lance with a
sharper, stronger tip that
pierces right through foes.

forms.name: Omnivoracious
forms.text:
The Omnivicious's final
form. Getting stabbed by it
means freezing from within.

forms.name: The Destructor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Omnivicious</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Stinger
forms.text:
A Lance filled with the spirit
of a Brachydios. It pummels foes
senseless with explosive blows.

forms.name: Bombastic Stinger
forms.text:
The Dios Stinger's final
form takes after the Brachy
in myriad, explosive ways.

forms.name: La Bomba Stinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Lance
forms.text:
An explosive Lance filled with a
Brachydios's heat. Those who
master it shall rule the world.

forms.name: Albrach Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Lance's final
form. Upgrading more would
be downright apocalyptic.

forms.name: Albrach Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Red Tail
forms.text:
A Lance forged from a Rathalos
tail. Scorching flames erupt
from the thin body.

forms.name: Spear of Prominence
forms.text:
The Red Tail's final form
brings the fires of hell
right to your doorstep.

forms.name: Red Prominence
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Tail</COL>.

forms.name: Silver Prominence
forms.text:
A skyscraping silver Lance that
annihilates foes with rapid-fire
strikes and hellish flames.

forms.name: Sol Prominence
forms.text:
The Silver Prominence's
final upgrade can burn
a path to the heavens.

forms.name: Immaculate Soul
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silver Prominence</COL>.

forms.name: L'Égide
forms.text:
The shield's third eye finds
weakness, and the iridescent
Lance exploits it.

forms.name: Le Sage
forms.text:
The light from L'Égide's
final form showers the world
with both fear and courage.

forms.name: Le Paladin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>L'Égide</COL>.

forms.name: Astral Capricorn
forms.text:
A Lance bathed in the anger
of the comets as they shoot
across the celestial plains.

forms.name: Furious Capricorn
forms.text:
The Astral Capricorn's final
form points lost, angry souls
back towards righteousness.

forms.name: Violent Capricorn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astral Capricorn</COL>.

forms.name: Rusted Lance
forms.text:
A rusted Lance with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be polished...

forms.name: Tarnished Lance
forms.text:
The Rusted Lance's final
form. Even now, it's hard to
make out what it once was.

forms.name: DUMMY
forms.text: DUMMY

forms.name: Undertaker
forms.text:
A mechanical spear of
ancient metal. No modern
smith can restore its tip.

forms.name: High Undertaker
forms.text:
The Undertaker's final
form. Despite its age, its
stabs are full of vigor.

forms.name: Neo Undertaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Undertaker</COL>.

forms.name: Icesteel Spear
forms.text:
Spear cold enough to freeze
the earth with one stab. Can
change life into permafrost.

forms.name: Daora's Fang
forms.text:
The Icesteel Spear's final
form. Time feels stopped for
those frozen by it.

forms.name: Daora's Regulus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icesteel Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Worn Spear
forms.text:
A worn Lance with unrealized
potential. It could perhaps
be restored...

forms.name: Weathered Spear
forms.text:
The Worn Spear's final
form, its potential fully
exhausted at this stage.

forms.name: Aged Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Skyscraper
forms.text:
An ancient Lance discovered
unused. It towers high, as
if to pierce the heavens.

forms.name: Skysunderer
forms.text:
The Skyscraper's final
form. Its towering form
threatens the heavens.

forms.name: Skyseverer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skyscraper</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Howl
forms.text:
A ferocious Lance that spits
hot fire. Genuine power
worthy of a king.

forms.name: Teostra's Roar
forms.text:
The Teostra's Howl's final
form sets the world aflame
to establish its dominion.

forms.name: Teostra's Fire
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Howl</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Purelance
forms.text:
The Yukumo Lance's true
form. Solid to hold, yet
impressively light.

forms.name: Godly Lance
forms.text:
The Yukumo Purelance's final
form is made from trees thought
to house spirits.

forms.name: Heavenly Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Purelance</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Lance
forms.text:
A Lance whose belligerent blaze
conquers the world with the
swiftness and finality of magma.

forms.name: Lightbreak Balefire
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Lance's final form
overpowers its prey like
a pyroclastic flow.

forms.name: Lightbreak Pyre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Spark Plug
forms.text:
A new blade-based Lance
fitted with a Great Thunderbug.
Capable of high-volt shots.

forms.name: Electrode
forms.text:
The Spark Plug's final form
has been amplified to give
it an even greater voltage.

forms.name: ThunderbugShockLance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spark Plug</COL>.

forms.name: Dark
forms.text:
An advanced Dark Lance.
Injects Neopteron sleep
agents with each attack.

forms.name: Darkness
forms.text:
The Dark's final form is
unstoppable and dripping with
sleep-inducing poison.

forms.name: Dark Din
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark</COL>.

forms.name: Noble Fragrance
forms.text:
Only the most delicate petals
are used to give this noble lance
the most luxurious fragrance.

forms.name: Noble Aroma
forms.text:
The Noble Fragrance's final form.
The delicate bouquet seeps
into the user's body and soul.

forms.name: Precious Scent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Noble Fragrance</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Gunlance
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Gunlance
for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Gunlance
forms.text:
The Petrified Gunlance's
final form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance that's inexpensive,
but durable. A good starter
weapon for any hunter.

forms.name: Eizenlitter
forms.text:
The Iron Gunlance's final
form. Even if left in eternal
rain, it'll never wear.

forms.name: Sol Bite Burst
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Gunlance
forms.text:
An introductory Gunlance for
beginning hunters. Its light
design is perfect for sparring.

forms.name: Wyvern Bone Gunlance
forms.text:
The Bone Gunlance's final form
is the gunlance beginners use in
their first test of courage.

forms.name: Traditional Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Fiore Nulo
forms.text:
What look like buds at the
end of the barrel are
actually sharp thorns.

forms.name: Fiore Unu
forms.text:
The Fiore Nulo's final
form blossoms beautifully
with every shot.

forms.name: Fiore Du
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fiore Nulo</COL>.

forms.name: Rogue Gunlance
forms.text:
Simple and easy to use. The
Maccao parts accent its
quiet majesty.

forms.name: Cultured Rogue
forms.text:
The Rogue Gunlance's final form
may have a regal appearance, but
it's devastatingly effective as well.

forms.name: Cultured Bandit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rogue Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Gunlance
forms.text:
A Yukumo favorite, this
Gunlance utilizes a mini-
malist design.

forms.name: Yukumo Burst
forms.text:
Yukumo artisanal values are
embodied in the Yukumo
Gunlance's final form.

forms.name: Hot Spring Burst
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Striker's Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance with desirable
firing and blocking power.
Reliable, sleek, popular.

forms.name: Imperial Guardlance
forms.text:
The final form of the
Striker's Gunlance values
stability above all else.

forms.name: Praetorian Guardlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Striker's Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Golem Gunlance
forms.text:
A heavy Gunlance made of
bones. Only full-fledged
Hunters can hope to lift it.

forms.name: Behemoth Gunlance
forms.text:
Legend has it that the final
form of the Golem Gunlance
was used by giants.

forms.name: Gargantua Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Golem Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Hard Hitter
forms.text:
A giant Gunlance made of
elastic hide and fine ore
with truly potent Poison.

forms.name: Big Slugger
forms.text:
The Hard Hitter's final
form shoots Poison that
makes for painful ends.

forms.name: Triple Crown
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hard Hitter</COL>.

forms.name: Red Devil Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made using the most
advanced forging techniques.
Even the recoil feels nice.

forms.name: Red Devil Smasher
forms.text:
The Red Devil Gunlance's final
form. Much more refined than
it looks.

forms.name: Red Devil Earthquake
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Devil Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Bamboo Birdsbane
forms.text:
A Gunlance forged in jest.
Its capabilities, however, are
no joke. (How does it even fire?)

forms.name: Bamboo Lionsbane
forms.text:
The Bamboo Birdsbane's final
form. Crafted by something
of a playful artisan.

forms.name: Bamboo Dragonsbane
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bamboo Birdsbane</COL>.

forms.name: Baa Baa Gunlance
forms.text:
The gentle brays of a Moofah
promptly transport one
into the dream world.

forms.name: Sleepyeye Gunlance
forms.text:
Fall into an eternal slumber
with the Baa Baa
Gunlance's final form.

forms.name: Dreamlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Baa Baa Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Kamak Gunlance
forms.text:
A fine work of art made
for Felynes bummed about
winter ending.

forms.name: Snowy Kamak
forms.text:
The final form of the
Kamak Gunlance. Glimmers
like fresh snow.

forms.name: Blizzard Kamak
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kamak Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made with incredible
detail. Bears the visage and
ferocity of the mighty Teostra.

forms.name: Firelord Roar
forms.text:
The Teostra Gunlance's final
form. Even the king of hell
fears its might.

forms.name: Firelord Champion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Princess Panoply
forms.text:
A Gunlance covered in the Queen's
green scales. It fires Poison and
stains the earth with enemy blood.

forms.name: Ortlinde
forms.text:
Turn battlefields into gardens
of death with the Princess
Panoply's final form.

forms.name: Great Ortlinde
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Princess Panoply</COL>.

forms.name: Red Rook
forms.text:
A Gunlance embodying a Rathalos.
Its twisted melody and fiery roar
sends foes dancing to the grave.

forms.name: Crimson Rook
forms.text:
The Red Rook's final form
spews fire hot enough to
truly make hell on earth.

forms.name: Burnt Chariot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Rook</COL>.

forms.name: Ukiyo no Yamiwo
forms.text:
A resplendent Gunlance.
Once possessed by a samurai,
it twinkles in the moonlight.

forms.name: Mizumori
forms.text:
The Ukiyo no Yamiwo's final
form shimmers morosely
within the mist.

forms.name: Harae no Toboshi
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukiyo no Yamiwo</COL>.

forms.name: Verdant Rook
forms.text:
A Gunlance that strikes with
the power of a lightning bolt.
Foes are burnt to a crisp.

forms.name: Dark Chariot
forms.text:
The Verdant Rook's final
form calls forth black
thunder with each shot.

forms.name: Zaram Chariot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verdant Rook</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Artillery
forms.text:
Gammoth legs form a base
for a Gunlance that can
pierce even mountains.

forms.name: Giant's Clasher
forms.text:
The Giant's Artillery's
final form recalls ancient
wars between gods and men.

forms.name: Giant's Gigaclasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Artillery</COL>.

forms.name: Burning Kabeira
forms.text:
This Gunlance, modeled after
the Glavenus's neck, contains
the very fires of hell.

forms.name: Glavenus Brewer
forms.text:
The Burning Kabeira's final
form scorches the battlefield
with hellish fury.

forms.name: Glavenus Brewanova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Burning Kabeira</COL>.

forms.name: Tyrannenarm
forms.text:
A weapon said to destroy
the very soul. The shield's
eye wills prey to submit.

forms.name: Verräterarm
forms.text:
The Tyrannenarm's final
form. Its piercing eye sees
directly into your soul.

forms.name: Hochmutsarm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tyrannenarm</COL>.

forms.name: Jaya Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance that stacks Seregios
blades. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Riotous Gunlance
forms.text:
Declare war on the gods and
be victorious with the Jaya
Gunlance's final form.

forms.name: Insubordinate Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Jaya Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Thunder Yell
forms.text:
An azure Gunlance made from
the horns of extremely
rare beasts.

forms.name: Lightning Roar
forms.text:
The Thunder Yell's final form.
By the grace of the gods,
your enemies will sleep forever.

forms.name: Thunderbolt Bellow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunder Yell</COL>.

forms.name: Venomous Cologne
forms.text:
A Gunlance with a built-in Poison
chamber that coats the blade
whenever a Whetstone is applied.

forms.name: Venomous Attar
forms.text:
The Venomous Cologne's final
form. It has been upgraded to
hold a more potent Poison.

forms.name: Venomous Perfume
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Venomous Cologne</COL>.

forms.name: Chasm Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from Nakarkos
materials. As devilish as the
beast itself.

forms.name: Abyss Gunlance
forms.text:
The Chasm Gunlance's final
form. Drags souls back into
the abyss.

forms.name: Rukbat Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chasm Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Cornpopper
forms.text:
A Gunlance born from a corny
dedication to farming. Despite the
appearance, it's got good pop.

forms.name: Mighty Cornpopper
forms.text:
The Cornpopper's final
form. Achieving a good
harvest is all in the mind!

forms.name: Crunchy Cornpopper
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cornpopper</COL>.

forms.name: Wycademy Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance that goes hand in
hand with Wycademy scholars'
"research."

forms.name: Academic Gunlance
forms.text:
The Wycademy Gunlance's final
form. Years of monster "research"
have gone into its development.

forms.name: Freiheit Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wycademy Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Black Smoke Gunlance
forms.text:
The black smoke rising out
of the barrel saps away the
surrounding light.

forms.name: Chrono Burst
forms.text:
The Black Smoke Gunlance's
final form. Blankets the world
in perpetual darkness.

forms.name: Fatalis Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Smoke Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: General's Arbalance
forms.text:
A Gunlance enhanced by a master
craftsman, but user-friendly
enough for anyone to wield.

forms.name: Admiral's Arbalance
forms.text:
The final form of the
General's Arbalance never
fails in times of crisis.

forms.name: Imperial Swornlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>General's Arbalance</COL>.

forms.name: Monsieur Gore
forms.text:
An ambitious work that implements
special valves. Horns cover the
barrel for truly sharp offense.

forms.name: Genteel Gore
forms.text:
The Monsieur Gore's final
form boasts marvelous
thrusting prowess.

forms.name: Seigneur Gore
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Monsieur Gore</COL>.

forms.name: Snow Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance created from strong
Giaprey parts. Fitted with limiters,
its true abilities remain secret.

forms.name: Snow Gunlance Mk. II
forms.text:
The Snow Gunlance's final form.
With limiters removed, it can freeze
prey solid with a single shot.

forms.name: Blizzard Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Snow Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Barroth Loader
forms.text:
A muddy Gunlance made from a
Barroth. Its rugged design allows
it to function in all conditions.

forms.name: Rugged Loader
forms.text:
The Barroth Loader's final form.
Its bombardment attacks are
launched with a feral roar.

forms.name: Barroth Reloader
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barroth Loader</COL>.

forms.name: Sleeper Blaster
forms.text:
A Gunlance with the fascinating
color of a night bird. One hit will
send you to nightmare-filled sleep.

forms.name: Sleeper Duke
forms.text:
The Sleeper Blaster's final form.
One savage hit will plunge your
prey into an eternal nightmare.

forms.name: Sleeper Archduke
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sleeper Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Shell Gunbird
forms.text:
Sturdy and light Nerscylla
parts layered in curves.
Feels right in one's hands.

forms.name: Solid Gunbird
forms.text:
The Shell Gunbird's final form.
Looks fragile, but its appearance
belies a supple strength.

forms.name: Shadow Nercusp
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shell Gunbird</COL>.

forms.name: Marine Fisher
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from Plesioth
parts. Multiple shells can be
fired from the sharp tip.

forms.name: Abyssal Fisher
forms.text:
The Marine Fisher's final form
practically shoots tsunamis
from its tip.

forms.name: Oceanic Trencher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Marine Fisher</COL>.

forms.name: Felyoshka
forms.text:
A Gunlance modeled on a popular
Felyne souvenir. A smaller doll
is hiding inside the large one!

forms.name: Felicitous Felyoshka
forms.text:
The Felyoshka's final form.
Supposedly improves prosperity.
Only one way to find out.

forms.name: Fortuitous Felyoshka
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Felyoshka</COL>.

forms.name: White Gunlance
forms.text:
Lava-proof Gravios materials
feature in the lance and
shield. Superb resistance.

forms.name: White Cannon
forms.text:
The White Gunlance's final form.
The smoke from its bombardment
will blot out the sun.

forms.name: Gravios Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>White Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Gunlance
forms.text:
A seemingly average Gunlance
whose parts are possessed by
immensely powerful demons.

forms.name: Great Demon Gunlance
forms.text:
The Demon Gunlance's final
form. Behold the demonic
madness it brings forth.

forms.name: Dragon Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Ravenous Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance with the ravenous soul
of a Deviljho. Though twisted, the
beast's form is still apparent.

forms.name: Insatiable Gunlance
forms.text:
The Ravenous Gunlance's final
form unleashes the Deviljho's
vicious thirst for blood.

forms.name: Nero's Greed
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ravenous Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Hero Gunlance
forms.text:
Like all good things in
life, this Gunlance's core
appeal remains timeless.

forms.name: Master Gunlance
forms.text:
The Hero Gunlance's final
form. The culmination of
generations of work.

forms.name: Legend Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hero Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance created from strong
Diablos parts. When it fires, you
know it's there.

forms.name: Diablos Cannon
forms.text:
The Diablos Gunlance's final form.
Embodies a tyrant's menace and
pierces both heaven and earth.

forms.name: Diablos Horncannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Research Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance put together by the
Soaratorium eggheads. It can be
used as a burner in experiments.

forms.name: Discovery Gunlance
forms.text:
The Research Gunlance's final form.
Dominate using your intelligence...
and superior firepower.

forms.name: Authority Gunsen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Platinum Trophy
forms.text:
A special Famitsu weapon. The
gleam of its blade illuminates
the way towards the future.

forms.name: Platinum Crown
forms.text:
The Platinum Trophy's final
form. Only the avant-garde
may claim this crown.

forms.name: Platinum Crown X
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Platinum Trophy</COL>.

forms.name: Volt Works
forms.text:
A forked Gunlance from a
foreign land. One swing rains
lightning down upon its foes.

forms.name: Voltaic Works
forms.text:
The Volt Works's final form.
Its attacks bear the wrathful
power of the heavens.

forms.name: Dengeki Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Volt Works</COL>.

forms.name: Pirate Gunlance J
forms.text:
The Gunlance of a pirate that
ruled the Seven Seas. The gold
skull shows unbridled ambition.

forms.name: Buccaneer Gunlance J
forms.text:
The Pirate Gunlance J's final
form. It guns down any who
stand in the way of ambition.

forms.name: Pirate King Gunlance J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pirate Gunlance J</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance that houses the
black god's soul; his dark
fire scorches the soul.

forms.name: Akantor Cannonlance
forms.text:
The Akantor Gunlance's final
form can wipe all from the
plane of existence.

forms.name: Akantor Soullance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Gunlance
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's eighth power: light.
Burns like divine fire.

forms.name: Ukanlos Cannonlance
forms.text:
The light given off from the
Ukanlos Gunlance's final
form heralds the end of days.

forms.name: Ukanlos Apocalance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Ominous Monsoon
forms.text:
A Gunlance sealed with godly
fury. Rain judgment upon
their pitiful life.

forms.name: Heavenly Dusk
forms.text:
The Ominous Monsoon's final
form. Wash away foes from the
land of the living.

forms.name: Celestial Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ominous Monsoon</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Gunlance
Dragonstar Benet
Magnastar Caist
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance from the Soaratorium
for hunters breaking new ground.
It flings ferocious flames.

forms.name: Sage Gunlance
forms.text:
The Elder Gunlance's final form.
The hardened barrel can shoot
fireballs like dragon breath.

forms.name: Philosopher Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Barbecue Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance featuring a handy
meat-grilling function. Its flames
will char your prey black.

forms.name: Sirloin Gunlance
forms.text:
The Barbecue Gunlance's final form.
So powerful it'll burn raw meat to
cinders in an instant.

forms.name: Tenderloin Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barbecue Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Ruhe/Tyrannie
forms.text:
A Gunlance whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Demut/Orgueil
forms.text:
The Ruhe/Tyrannie's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would defy the arrogant.

forms.name: Mauer/Guerre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruhe/Tyrannie</COL>.

forms.name: Gold Gunlance
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of the desert's
raging windstorms.

forms.name: Inscribed Setekh
forms.text:
The Gold Gunlance's final form.
Created by the bringer of storms
and guardian of the sands.

forms.name: Was-Ankh
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gold Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance which brings ruin
to the guilty. Shoots furiously
when faced with a dragon.

forms.name: True Ruiner Gunlance
forms.text:
The Ruiner Gunlance's final
form. Turns prey to ashes with
its tremendous firepower.

forms.name: Faithful Ruiner Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: O. Fatalis Gunlance
forms.text:
An old Fatalis Gunlance that
strikes fear in mortals as it
surveys the blood-filled abyss.

forms.name: True O. Fatalis Gunlance
forms.text:
The O. Fatalis Gunlance's final form.
Emits a roar of divine punishment
from its ominous blood-red barrel.

forms.name: Epic O. Fatalis Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>O. Fatalis Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Blackhare Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Snowbaron parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Snowbaron Gunlance
forms.text:
The Blackhare Gunlance's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Snowbaron Lagombi.

forms.name: Blackhare Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blackhare Gunlance</COL>!

forms.name: Pincher Cannon
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Cannon
forms.text:
The Pincher Cannon's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Gigacannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pincher Cannon</COL>!

forms.name: Royal Burst
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Burst
forms.text:
The Royal Burst's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Rathian Burst
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Burst</COL>!

forms.name: Pierce Cannon
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Drilltusk parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Drilltusk Cannon
forms.text:
The Pierce Cannon's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Tetsucabra Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pierce Cannon</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Burst
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Burst
forms.text:
The Nightfall Burst's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Daybreak Burst
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Burst</COL>!

forms.name: Geode Burst
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystalbeard Burst
forms.text:
The Geode Burst's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Burst
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Geode Burst</COL>!

forms.name: Hardened Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Imperial Deadeye
forms.text:
The Hardened Gunlance's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Imperial Cataclysm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hardened Gunlance</COL>!

forms.name: Tomb Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Regaling Chariot
forms.text:
The Tomb Gunlance's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Rathalos Verde
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tomb Gunlance</COL>!

forms.name: Raiden Cannon
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Cannon
forms.text:
The Raiden Cannon's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Raiden Rumbler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raiden Cannon</COL>!

forms.name: Seize Burst
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Burst
forms.text:
The Seize Burst's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seize Burst</COL>!

forms.name: Explosive Kabeira
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Powderkeg Brewer
forms.text:
The Explosive Kabeira's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Powderkeg Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Explosive Kabeira</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Blaster
forms.text:
A Gunlance made of
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Cannon
forms.text:
The Cloaked Blaster's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Gloaming
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Blaster</COL>!

forms.name: Mumyo Joya
forms.text:
A Gunlance made of
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Ajimura Sekimori
forms.text:
The Mumyo Joya's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Ajimura Chinju
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mumyo Joya</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Rook
forms.text:
A Gunlance made of Boltreaver
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Revolt Chariot
forms.text:
The Zephra Rook's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Zilvolt Rook
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Rook</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Bombadier
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Gunlance's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Broadside
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Gunlance</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Ordnance
forms.text:
The Massacre Gunlance's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Krommell
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Gunlance</COL>!

forms.name: Genenam Lance
forms.text:
A magnificent Gunlance
befitting a great general
with a vast army.

forms.name: V Crest
forms.text:
The Genenam Lance's final form.
Its presence alone is enough to
bring an empire to its knees.

forms.name: V Garland
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Genenam Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Fiore Nulo (R)
forms.text:
The maroon barrel on this
Gunlance calls to mind
flower buds.

forms.name: Fiore Unu (R)
forms.text:
Shots from the Fiore Nulo
(R)'s final form can make
fields bloom crimson.

forms.name: Fiore Du (R)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fiore Nulo (R)</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance forged from an
ebon fossil. The past has never
felt so alive.

forms.name: Lustrous Oldoba
forms.text:
The Obsidian Gunlance's final
form. The weight of history
sits in your hands.

forms.name: Ethereal Oldoba
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Shattershot
forms.text:
A broad Gunlance reminiscent of a
Volvidon's forelegs. More suited to
clubbing foes than stabbing them.

forms.name: Shatter God
forms.text:
The Shattershot's final form.
Able to give monsters an express
ticket to meet their maker.

forms.name: Shattercannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shattershot</COL>.

forms.name: Full Voltage
forms.text:
A Gunlance that uses a built-
in generator to add elemental
properties. Bulky as a result.

forms.name: High Volt Gunlance
forms.text:
The Full Voltage's final
form is made of conductive
materials for max voltage.

forms.name: Giga Volt Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Full Voltage</COL>.

forms.name: Lagomberator
forms.text:
A Gunlance fusing cutting-edge
weaponry and exotic design. Ice
properties are found in the tip.

forms.name: Lagomberatrix
forms.text:
The Lagomberator's final
form is made to freeze prey
before it can even blink.

forms.name: Lagombalanche
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagomberator</COL>.

forms.name: Lagomberastrophe
forms.text:
A traditional border tribe
weapon whose blast rends the
sky and causes avalanches.

forms.name: Lagombergeddon
forms.text:
The Lagomberastrophe's final
form is etched in legend. Its
shots can sunder mountains.

forms.name: Lagombavalanga
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagomberastrophe</COL>.

forms.name: Volcano Gunlance
forms.text:
This product of Lavasioth
research shoots flames so fierce,
you might be mistaken for one.

forms.name: Lavasioth Gunlance
forms.text:
The Volcano Gunlance's
final form literally erupts
with every shot.

forms.name: Lava Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Volcano Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Blue Devil Uberlance
forms.text:
A classic Gunlance with
a modified barrel for
superior shelling power.

forms.name: Blue Devil Opus
forms.text:
The Blue Devil Uberlance's
final form. A fireworks show
with each and every shot.

forms.name: Blue Devil Draco
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blue Devil Uberlance</COL>.

forms.name: Flamethrower
forms.text:
A Gunlance patterned after an
Agnaktor's crimson armor. It seems
to glow with wicked hellfire.

forms.name: Agna Magma
forms.text:
The Flamethrower's final
form turns everything to
ash within seconds.

forms.name: Agna Lavaflow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flamethrower</COL>.

forms.name: Seadiver
forms.text:
A Gunlance made of metal and
organic parts from the icy
reaches of the sea.

forms.name: Abyssdiver
forms.text:
Your aim will be forever
true with the Seadiver's
final form.

forms.name: Trenchdiver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seadiver</COL>.

forms.name: Deepbuster
forms.text:
A Gunlance with a reinforced
muzzle. Maximizes damage
when exploiting a weakness.

forms.name: Deep Gunbuster
forms.text:
The Deepbuster's final
form has a super sharp tip
for supreme accuracy.

forms.name: Megalo Mincer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Deepbuster</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance with a hardened
barrel. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Tamarod Sedition
forms.text:
Rise up and take what's
yours with the Seditious
Gunlance's final form.

forms.name: Sedition Buster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Silver Rook
forms.text:
A Gunlance made of Silver
Rathalos parts. The argent scales
on the body emit a noble shine.

forms.name: Chariot Gun
forms.text:
The Silver Rook's final
form can expel heat as hot
as a thousand suns.

forms.name: World's Demise
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silver Rook</COL>.

forms.name: Lagia Burst
forms.text:
A coiled Gunlance with the might
of a Lagiacrus. It fires lightning
against which nothing can stand.

forms.name: Exlagia Gunlance
forms.text:
The Lagia Burst's final
form pierces the heavens
with its thunderous fury.

forms.name: Electrolagia Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagia Burst</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance filled with glowing
Brachydios slime mold. Its power
is beyond human comprehension.

forms.name: Brachy Gunlance
forms.text:
Turn your enemies' kingdom
into a giant crater with the final
form of the Dios Gunlance.

forms.name: Explosive Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance that boasts the power
of a Brachydios. Naught but
tears are left in its wake.

forms.name: Zvolta Demolisher
forms.text:
Bring silence to the battlefield
with the Demolition Gunlance's
final form.

forms.name: Zvolta Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Ancient Gyrelance
forms.text:
A Gunlance made by excavating
an ancient lance and rebuilding
its shelling device.

forms.name: Ancient Gyresmite
forms.text:
The Ancient Gyrelance's final
form. Behold the true potential
of its ancient power.

forms.name: Progenesis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ancient Gyrelance</COL>.

forms.name: Type 62 Stormlance
forms.text:
A fearsome Gunlance made with
top-secret Guild technology.
It was designed to slay wyverns.

forms.name: Assault Stormlance
forms.text:
The Type 62 Stormlance's
final form. Pierces Wyvern
scales like they're butter.

forms.name: War Marshal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 62 Stormlance</COL>.

forms.name: Arya Gadda
forms.text:
A handsome Gunlance decorated
by an artisan clearly trained
somewhere abroad.

forms.name: Chali Riyati
forms.text:
The Arya Gadda's final form is
a beautiful weapon that only the
hands of a master could make.

forms.name: Dal Chali Riyati
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arya Gadda</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Artillery
forms.text:
A Gunlance imbued with the ire of
a Rajang. Its unforgiving thrusts
feel like lightning strikes.

forms.name: Demonlord Gunlance
forms.text:
The Demonlord Artillery's
final form unleashes the
wielder's inner fury.

forms.name: Demonlord Bombardier
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Artillery</COL>.

forms.name: Tiger Blast
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from Tigrex
materials. Its roar sends
wyverns running to roost.

forms.name: Tigrex Gunlance
forms.text:
The Tiger Blast's final form.
Roar into battle and seize the
day!

forms.name: GreatTigrexGunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tiger Blast</COL>.

forms.name: Queen's Panoply
forms.text:
A Queen's Gunlance that shines
like moonlight. Its fragile beauty
is the last thing foes ever see.

forms.name: Shining Ishtar
forms.text:
The Queen's Panoply's final
form. Foes become as pale as the
moon as their last breath exits.

forms.name: Shining Anaïtis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Queen's Panoply</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Roar
forms.text:
A Gunlance with the power of a
monarch. Its mighty roar heralds
the coming of the world conqueror.

forms.name: Despot's Phlogiston
forms.text:
The final form of the Usurper's
Roar. Conquered empires kneel
before its power.

forms.name: Oppressor's Skyfall
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Roar</COL>.

forms.name: Spine Blaster
forms.text:
A gunlance made from Uragaan
Shell. A weapon fit for the
harbinger of death.

forms.name: Vertebrae Blaster
forms.text:
The Spine Blaster's final form.
Enemies accept their death
in its presence.

forms.name: Zenith Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spine Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Hellsting
forms.text:
A Gunlance able to deal some
serious cold with the help
of its Blangonga parts.

forms.name: Hellstinger
forms.text:
With every thrust of the
Hellsting's final form, foes feel
the jaws of death closing in.

forms.name: Demonic Blizzard
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hellsting</COL>.

forms.name: Gerd Sting
forms.text:
Lay your enemies to rest
with the bitter cold of this
Gunlance's icy lullabies.

forms.name: Ice Jailer
forms.text:
The driven snow is bound to
turn red with the Gerd
Sting's final form.

forms.name: Ice Warden
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gerd Sting</COL>.

forms.name: Scissor Gunlance
forms.text:
Made of Daimyo for high
defense. Admirable all-
purpose weapon.

forms.name: Scissor Cannon
forms.text:
Fortress-like defense is packed
into the final form of the
Scissor Gunlance.

forms.name: Claw Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scissor Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Gunlance
forms.text:
An ebon Gunlance, black as night.
The normally prominent barrel is
hidden by fierce obsidian blades.

forms.name: Fading Night
forms.text:
The Hidden Gunlance's final
form. "Black as midnight, black
as pitch, blacker than the..."

forms.name: Avidya Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Fiore Nulo (G)
forms.text:
The thorn-like tip of this
Gunlance can cause Paralysis
with a single thrust.

forms.name: Fiore Unu (G)
forms.text:
One thrust with the Fiore Nulo
(G)'s final form is enough
to rob prey of freedom.

forms.name: Fiore Du (G)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fiore Nulo (G)</COL>.

forms.name: Madame Butcher
forms.text:
An advanced Gunlance that focuses
on improvements to the barrel's
durability and firepower.

forms.name: Seltas Fortitude
forms.text:
The Madame Butcher's final
form features refined internal
combustion.

forms.name: Seltas Butchery
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Madame Butcher</COL>.

forms.name: L'Onde
forms.text:
A weapon said to gun down
the very soul. The shield's
giant gem bewitches prey.

forms.name: Le Mur
forms.text:
The jewel on L'Onde's
final form lures prey
to a blissful end.

forms.name: La Forteresse
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>L'Onde</COL>.

forms.name: Consummate Gunlance
Doomlance "Greed"
forms.text:
The Consummate Gunlance's
final form. Decimates kingdoms
and enslaves monsters.

forms.name: Guiltlance "Avarice"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Consummate Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Astral Centaurus
forms.text:
A cosmic Gunlance that
sprays the night sky with
abundant stars.

forms.name: Anguished Centaurus
forms.text:
The Astral Centaurus's
final form fills the skies
with fiery brimstone.

forms.name: Star-Crossed Centaurus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astral Centaurus</COL>.

forms.name: Worn Gunlance
forms.text:
A worn Gunlance with unrealized
potential. It could perhaps be
restored...

forms.name: Weathered Gunlance
forms.text:
The Worn Gunlance's final
form. Why restore it, when
it blazes on just fine?

forms.name: Aged Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Obelisk
forms.text:
A Gunlance that was once used in
ceremonies honoring the sun god.
Modern tech has given it new life.

forms.name: Deus Obelisk
forms.text:
The Obelisk's final form
bestows its owner with the
sun's mighty power.

forms.name: Atum-Ra Obelisk
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obelisk</COL>.

forms.name: Icesteel Gunlance
forms.text:
The lion's stalwart shield
cows the valiant; its four
claws ravage at point blank.

forms.name: Daora's Brigia
forms.text:
The Icesteel Gunlance's final
form. Freezes the battlefield in
permanent winter.

forms.name: Daora's Tempest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icesteel Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Puregunlance
forms.text:
The ideal Yukumo Gunlance.
Its inner workings have been
greatly improved.

forms.name: Mystic Gunlance
forms.text:
The Yukumo Puregunlance's
final form. Even forest
gods are wary of it.

forms.name: Ageless Gunlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Puregunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Gunlance
forms.text:
A Gunlance whose every blast of
light harnesses Brachydios force
as it rocks heaven's foundation.

forms.name: Lightbreak Volta
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Gunlance's final form.
Its terrifying explosive shots hit
like the hammer of the gods.

forms.name: Lightbreak Vowbreaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Gunlance</COL>.

forms.name: Roscasludge
forms.text:
An extremely sturdy Gunlance
capable of withstanding the
harshest of climates.

forms.name: Roscascarp
forms.text:
The Roscasludge's final form.
Any one of its multiple shots will
scorch the earth where it lands.

forms.name: Roscazatan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Roscasludge</COL>.

forms.name: Noble Gunbird
forms.text:
Sturdy from ample use of
shell parts, but still quite
light -- and flashy, too.

forms.name: Highborn Gunbird
forms.text:
The Noble Gunbird's final form.
The special weapon of a unit which
served an empress in many battles.

forms.name: Royal Gunbird
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Noble Gunbird</COL>.

forms.name: Agna Vulcan
forms.text:
A Gunlance made from tempered
Agnaktor parts. Anything touched
by it vaporizes on contact.

forms.name: Causta Agnavulcan
forms.text:
The Agna Vulcan's final form. It emits
an ultra-high-temperature blast that
can melt an iceberg in an instant.

forms.name: Causta Agnakhnua
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Agna Vulcan</COL>.

forms.name: Eine Wahrheit
forms.text:
A proud knight's Gunlance,
brimming with the Silver King's
trust and the Gold Queen's love.

forms.name: Letzte Wahrheit
forms.text:
The Eine Wahrheit's final form.
It shimmers with royal majesty,
at the apex of purity.

forms.name: Endgültige Wahrheit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eine Wahrheit</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Axe
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from
the Wycademy. The default
Switch Axe for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Axe
forms.text:
The Petrified Axe's final form.
A product of the Wycademy's
tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Axe
forms.text:
A simple Switch Axe that serves
as the basis for most Switch
Axes. Has limitless potential.

forms.name: Araxxis
forms.text:
The Iron Axe's final iteration.
It has been carefully upgraded
to give it outstanding durability.

forms.name: Alter Araxxis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Axe
forms.text:
A standard bone-based Switch
Axe, it is the latest advancement
in desert-based weaponry.

forms.name: Daidalos Axe
forms.text:
The Bone Axe's final form, it
has been upgraded by a master
craftsman to deal extra damage.

forms.name: Ikaros Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Wild Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe akin to a blunt
weapon. Lighter than it looks,
it can be wielded with ease.

forms.name: Ground Dasher
forms.text:
The Wild Axe's final form.
It uses the tusks of wild
beasts to cut down its prey.

forms.name: Giganto-Dasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wild Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Arzuros Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe that combines an
iron blade with Arzuros plate.
It boasts Sharpness and strength.

forms.name: Arzuros Revelax
