forms.text:
The Arzuros Axe's final form.
It can easily knock aside its prey
with the strength of an Arzuros.

forms.name: Arzuros Jubilax
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arzuros Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Switch Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made of high quality
wood and metal. Hunters love its
strength and versatility.

forms.name: Yukumo Axe
forms.text:
The Yukumo Switch Axe's final
form. Using the finest materials, it
has been greatly improved.

forms.name: Hot Spring Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Axe
forms.text:
An axe made from Royal Ludroth
parts. Switching between modes
is as smooth as flowing water.

forms.name: Splish Splax
forms.text:
The Ludroth Axe's final form.
It unleashes a torrent of water
that floods all around it.

forms.name: Ludroth Drencher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Grim Cat
forms.text:
A Switch Axe depicting a cat
with an eerie grin. It smiles
even when its Sharpness drops.

forms.name: Grimmige Katze
forms.text:
The Grim Cat's final form.
Even if one tries to destroy the
blade, the cat merely grins.

forms.name: Felyne Fatality
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grim Cat</COL>.

forms.name: Rough Edge
forms.text:
A stone axe made of ancient
ore, and an embodiment of
the unyielding human spirit.

forms.name: Soulbreaker
forms.text:
The Rough Edge's final form.
The rage of the ancient spirit
within gives its blade strength.

forms.name: Helios Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rough Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Arctic Ledge
forms.text:
The grand prize for a sled race in
the Arctic Ridge. Its design
is based on last year's winner.

forms.name: Ledge Axe
forms.text:
The final form of the Arctic
Ledge. Its red and white design
is from last year's winner's outfit.

forms.name: Axledge Icerunner
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arctic Ledge</COL>.

forms.name: Gouda Axe
forms.text:
Using only the best quality cheese,
this Switch Axe looks great, tastes
great, and is quite Sharp!

forms.name: Aged Gouda Axe
forms.text:
The Gouda Axe's final form.
So much cheesy goodness,
it just has to be shared.

forms.name: Boerenkaas Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gouda Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Power Gasher
forms.text:
A basic Switch Axe with
few visual differences but
a more capable construction.

forms.name: Maximal Gasher
forms.text:
The Power Gasher's final form.
Incremental improvements have
improved it beyond measure.

forms.name: Powerhouse Gasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Power Gasher</COL>.

forms.name: Dragonmaiden Axe
forms.text:
An axe bestowed to a bold,
beautiful battle maiden whom
no bloodstain could sully.

forms.name: Gríðr's Landmaker
forms.text:
The Dragonmaiden Axe's final
form makes maidens beautiful
even if they're bathed in blood.

forms.name: Gríðr's Landforger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragonmaiden Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Bolt Axe
forms.text:
An axe that channels the
Lagiacrus's power. With each
slash, azure light blooms.

forms.name: High Bolt Axe
forms.text:
The Bolt Axe's final form. Its
electric currents have reached
their highest voltage.

forms.name: Extreme Bolt Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bolt Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Fond Farewell
forms.text:
An elegant Switch Axe left behind
by a beautiful maiden. The sound
made by its slice is terrifying.

forms.name: Parting Slice
forms.text:
The Fond Farewell's final form.
Cries from its victims echo in the
night as it welcomes the dawn.

forms.name: Leave-Taker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fond Farewell</COL>.

forms.name: Voltaic Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from Astalos
materials. Its attacks are charged
with electrical energy.

forms.name: Voltaic End
forms.text:
The Voltaic Axe's final form.
Its might can bring even the
kingdom of hell to its knees.

forms.name: Voltaic Load
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Voltaic Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe once used by a
mountain maiden. A maker of
miracles and mover of spirits.

forms.name: Colossus's Axe
forms.text:
The final form of the Giant's
Axe. It serves as a call to arms
from the mountain maidens.

forms.name: Behemoth's Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Scorching Drafa
forms.text:
The flames that shoot forth
when this Switch Axe transforms
terrifies its unfortunate foes.

forms.name: Glavenus's Grimace
forms.text:
The Scorching Drafa's final form,
it uses the flames of the Glavenus
to incinerate its enemies.

forms.name: Glavenus's Grimanova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scorching Drafa</COL>.

forms.name: Eisenleib
forms.text:
A wicked axe favored by the
grimmest of reapers. Its dark
flash tears apart the light.

forms.name: Eisengeist
forms.text:
The Eisenleib's final form.
The flash of its blade is an
invitation to the gates of hell.

forms.name: Eisenherz
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eisenleib</COL>.

forms.name: Aksa Switch
forms.text:
A vicious Seregios Switch Axe.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Baran Defiance
forms.text:
The Aksa Switch's final form.
It is wielded by those with an
unquenched spirit of rebellion.

forms.name: Baran Rebellion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aksa Switch</COL>.

forms.name: Rex Slasher
forms.text:
A fine Switch Axe that makes
daring use of Tigrex parts
in its delicate mechanisms.

forms.name: Rex Gnasher
forms.text:
The Rex Slasher's final form
enables the battle roar of its user
to be heard throughout the land.

forms.name: Rex Thrasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rex Slasher</COL>.

forms.name: Peal
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from Kirin
spoils. It makes a valuable
weapon AND display item.

forms.name: Kirin Thunderpeal
forms.text:
The Peal's final form strikes
down opponents with bolts of
divine judgment.

forms.name: Archbeast Kirin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Peal</COL>.

forms.name: Daora's Farasa
forms.text:
A Switch Axe with wings of steel.
Its deep cold is said to drink
the life force of the wielder.

forms.name: Daora's Janah
forms.text:
The final form of Daora's
Farasa. Its cold steel wings can
freeze even the inferno of hell.

forms.name: Daora's Ajniha
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daora's Farasa</COL>.

forms.name: Waxglare Wand
forms.text:
A Switch Axe with twitching eyes.
The hungry tongue darts at prey
faster than desert air changes.

forms.name: Balor's Mirage
forms.text:
The Waxglare Wand's final
form. A demonic axe, it takes
the life of all who enter its gaze.

forms.name: Zariella's Phantasm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Waxglare Wand</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Axe
forms.text:
A terrifying Switch Axe whose
blades decimate those foolish
enough to stand before it.

forms.name: Wicked Thorns
forms.text:
The Skeletal Axe's final
form. Its wielders are driven
mad by the ecstasy of carnage.

forms.name: Antares Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Wycademy Axe
forms.text:
Bearing the name of the Wycademy,
it's known for its contribution
to monster "research."

forms.name: Versa Veil Axe
forms.text:
The Wycademy Axe's final
form. Its power will rip monsters
a new one...for science.

forms.name: Granversa Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wycademy Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Infernal Axe
forms.text:
An axe based on a cruel and
merciless demon. The fierce
tip reaps the souls of its foes.

forms.name: Hellish Edge
forms.text:
The Infernal Axe's final form.
It continues to take countless
lives with merciless glee.

forms.name: Calamitous Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Infernal Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Axe
forms.text:
The culmination of blood and
sweat shed in the arena. It
has overcome many dangers.

forms.name: Shihan Axe
forms.text:
The Black Belt Axe's final
form. It contains the souls
taken from many battles.

forms.name: Grandmaster Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Black Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe that harbors a
dark force that controls the
wielder with fear and anxiety.

forms.name: Onyx Axe
forms.text:
The Black Axe's final form.
It sews a path of fear across the
world, until all is chaos.

forms.name: Fatalis End
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Axe</COL>.

forms.name: General's Strongaxe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe given to hunters who
do great deeds for the Guild. Its
gold emblem is a badge of honor.

forms.name: Conqueress
forms.text:
The final form of the General's
Strongaxe, it is proof of a warrior
who has fought in many battles.

forms.name: Reconqueress
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>General's Strongaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Notched Doom
forms.text:
An axe with an edge sanded
as even as possible for
equal power and durability.

forms.name: Notched Legion
forms.text:
The final form of Notched
Doom. It can hit with the force
of a Zamtrios bite.

forms.name: Notched Rout
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Notched Doom</COL>.

forms.name: Beak Axe
forms.text:
A weapon made from a Yian
Kut-Ku's beak, polished to
a wicked sharpness.

forms.name: Sawbill Axe
forms.text:
The Beak Axe's final form. Like the
raging Yian Kut-Ku, it slashes through
all in its path, leaving ash in its wake.

forms.name: Terror Bird Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Beak Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Assault Axe
forms.text:
A versatile hunting axe. In
Sword Mode, it pumps paralyzing
agents into targets.

forms.name: Blitzkrieg
forms.text:
The Assault Axe's final form.
Its overwhelming power
dominates any hunting ground.

forms.name: Bastion Blitz
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Assault Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Golba Vandal
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from Congalala
spoils. A supremely tough weapon,
and smells absolutely divine.

forms.name: Gundava Vandal
forms.text:
The Golba Vandal's final form.
Veteran of a thousand battles,
neither its strength nor scent fade.

forms.name: Gundar Sangram
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Golba Vandal</COL>.

forms.name: Amber Slash
forms.text:
A lovely hunting axe made
from the tri-color Barioth.
Cold enough to freeze blood.

forms.name: Amber Hoarfrost
forms.text:
The Amber Slash's final form is cold
enough to beckon death, and
caresses its prey with crimson ice.

forms.name: Amber Permafrost
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Amber Slash</COL>.

forms.name: Undying Axe
forms.text:
A black Switch Axe with untold
strength. It resembles a Rajang
horn piercing the heavens.

forms.name: Undying Light
forms.text:
The Undying Axe's final form.
The unleashed soul of the Rajang
rends all darkness.

forms.name: Undying Purity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Undying Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Tyrannos
forms.text:
A Switch Axe that embodies a
voracious Deviljho. Scars from
past battles line the surface.

forms.name: Terror Tyrannos
forms.text:
The Tyrannos's final form.
The embodiment of evil, greed,
and murderous intent.

forms.name: Nero's Tyrannos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tyrannos</COL>.

forms.name: Axe Semper Tyrannis
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from the
spiked armor of a Diablos. It
rends flesh right off the bone.

forms.name: Grand Chaos
forms.text:
The Axe Semper Tyrannis's final
form attacks without mercy. Its
wielder will rule the desert.

forms.name: Axe of Gaia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axe Semper Tyrannis</COL>.

forms.name: Research Axe
forms.text:
This Switch Axe serves as scissors.
Useful for when the Soaratorium air
sacs are being serviced.

forms.name: Discovery Axe
forms.text:
The Research Axe's final form.
It follows that those with a keen
mind also possess a keen blade.

forms.name: Authority Shears
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Switch Fox
forms.text:
A special Famitsu weapon,
its impressive fox design is
mysteriously alluring.

forms.name: Special Corps Axe
forms.text:
The Switch Fox's final form.
Its morphing blade mirrors
the changes in the world.

forms.name: Shapeshifter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Switch Fox</COL>.

forms.name: Raikou Works
forms.text:
A gold and blue axe from a
foreign land. Its blade strikes
with pulsing lightning.

forms.name: Raiden Works
forms.text:
The Raikou Works's final
form. The blade's charge can
tear the heavens asunder.

forms.name: Dengeki Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raikou Works</COL>.

forms.name: Pirate Axe J
forms.text:
The flag used by the master
of the seven seas. His pride
lives on in the left eye.

forms.name: Buccaneer Axe J
forms.text:
The Pirate Axe J's final form.
Dreams, volition, pride... This
blade forges its own legend.

forms.name: Pirate King Axe J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pirate Axe J</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Switch Axe
forms.text:
An axe whose dark, divine
passenger shall rule in the
fallen world's second life.

forms.name: Akantor Divider
forms.text:
The Akantor Switch Axe's final
form. It spills into this world the
chaos of an ancient land.

forms.name: Akantor Fissure
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Murkham Axe
forms.text:
Embodiment of the white god's
thirteenth power: an axe that
can split the world.

forms.name: Muronkham Axe
forms.text:
The Murkham Axe's final
form. The axe was used by the
gods to carve out a new world.

forms.name: Murkhanomi Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Murkham Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Cloudburst Axe
forms.text:
An axe wielded by the gods.
It calls the rain of judgment
to pour from the skies.

forms.name: Heavenly Rain
forms.text:
The Cloudburst Axe's final
form. Its shower of light washes
away the sins of the masses.

forms.name: Celestial Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloudburst Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Dark Switch Axe
forms.text:
A dreadful Switch Axe shaped
after an Alatreon horn, dark
as the primordial dawn.

forms.name: Black Harvest
forms.text:
The Dark Switch Axe's final
form. When its true master is
found, a night of dragons awaits.

forms.name: Altheos Voracion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Switch Axe
forms.text:
One swing from the Argent Comet's
axe and all that remains is stardust
and the ashes of your enemies.

forms.name: Dragonstar Dunat
Magnastar Batis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe from the Soaratorium
for hunters breaking new ground.
Boasts stunning destructive power.

forms.name: Sage Axe
forms.text:
The Elder Axe's final form.
Tears prey thoroughly to pieces
with its exceptionally sharp blade.

forms.name: Philosopher Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Gorgonzola Axe
forms.text:
Get a taste of the finest blue
cheese! A pungently refined
luxury to thrill true connoisseurs.

forms.name: Aged Gorgonzola Axe
forms.text:
The Gorgonzola Axe's final form.
Go on, treat yourself to a bite!
You've earned it, Hunter!

forms.name: Gorgonzola Piccante
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gorgonzola Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Inceadeus
forms.text:
A legendary Switch Axe
carved from a Ceadeus horn.
It glows white from within.

forms.name: Great Inceadeus
forms.text:
The Great Inceadeus's final form.
Attacks with the sea-lord's rage,
splitting land and sea alike.

forms.name: Ceadeed Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Inceadeus</COL>.

forms.name: Körper/Esprit
forms.text:
A Switch Axe whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Fleisch/Ame
forms.text:
The Körper/Esprit's final form. Shows
its true potential only to those who
would overcome their mortal limits.

forms.name: Frevel/Sursis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Körper/Esprit</COL>.

forms.name: Dragon Ripper
forms.text:
Only those who have defeated
the great Lao-Shan Lung are
permitted to touch this Switch Axe.

forms.name: Dragonfire Axe
forms.text:
The Dragon Ripper's final form
has dragons falling like autumn
leaves from the sky.

forms.name: Dragon Eater
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragon Ripper</COL>.

forms.name: Goldaxe
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a mighty
war machine that led an army.

forms.name: Inscribed Astarte
forms.text:
The Goldaxe's final form.
Wielded by a goddess on
horseback. Ride on to battle!

forms.name: Anat Karnaim
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner's Bane
forms.text:
Despair was fated to return
to the world, as was the
fabled axe to be used again.

forms.name: True Ruiner's Bane
forms.text:
The Ruiner's Bane's final form reveals
a world where despair lies beside
hope. Eternal peace is impossible.

forms.name: Absolute Ruiner's Bane
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner's Bane</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Force
forms.text:
A demonic Switch Axe used long
ago in ritual sacrifice. Its edge
glows as life fills it.

forms.name: Fatalis Finesse
forms.text:
The Fatalis Force's final form
manifests itself using the bodies
of the slain as an offering.

forms.name: Fatalis Feint
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Force</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Redhelm parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Redhelm Axe
forms.text:
The Crimson Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Redhelm Arzuros.

forms.name: Red Cloudscraper Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Blackhare Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Snowbaron parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Snowbaron Axe
forms.text:
The Blackhare Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Snowbaron Lagombi.

forms.name: Snowbaron Aurispada
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blackhare Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Pincher Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Axe
forms.text:
The Pincher Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Gigantaxe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pincher Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Royal Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Axe
forms.text:
The Royal Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Cleaver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Pierce Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Drilltusk parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Drilltusk Axe
forms.text:
The Pierce Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Tetsucabra Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pierce Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Axe
forms.text:
The Nightfall Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Daybreak Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Geode Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystalbeard Axe
forms.text:
The Geode Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Geode Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Tomb Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Axe
forms.text:
The Tomb Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Firewaltz Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tomb Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Raiden Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Axe
forms.text:
The Raiden Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thunderlord Shocker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raiden Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Seize Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Axe
forms.text:
The Seize Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Chopper
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seize Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Magma Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Hellblade Axe
forms.text:
The Magma Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Glaverno Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magma Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Kaleidos
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Somnolus
forms.text:
The Cloaked Kaleidos's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Somnolence
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Kaleidos</COL>!

forms.name: Deep Yearning
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Lanternlight Banner
forms.text:
Deep Yearning's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Lanternlight Grave
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Deep Yearning</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Boltreaver Astalos parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Zephra Halberd
forms.text:
The Zephra Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Zilvolt Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Switch Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Gasher
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Switch Axe's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Unleasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Switch Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Hatchet
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Axe
forms.text:
The Massacre Hatchet's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Scipio
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Hatchet</COL>!

forms.name: The Shredder
forms.text:
A mechanical Switch Axe made
using the latest technology. It
generates incredible power.

forms.name: The Power Shredder
forms.text:
The Shredder's final form.
Its power source has been juiced
for maximum shredding potential.

forms.name: The Lightning Shredder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>The Shredder</COL>.

forms.name: Bruiser Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe put together from
Jaggi and Ioprey parts. Inspires
one to explore new frontiers.

forms.name: Chief Bruiser Axe
forms.text:
The Bruiser Axe's final form.
It is the perfect tool for forging
new paths into the unknown.

forms.name: Emperor Bruiser Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bruiser Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Vavoom Axe
forms.text:
Supple Kecha Wacha material
in the joints enables smooth
morphs and lethal attacks.

forms.name: Vavoom Verdict
forms.text:
The Vavoom Axe's final form.
It uses fluid movements to deceive
its prey before cutting them down.

forms.name: Vavoom Victory
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vavoom Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Axe
forms.text:
An axe made from a beautiful
fossil. The refined stone has
been reborn as a shiny axe.

forms.name: Relic Axe
forms.text:
The Obsidian Axe's final form.
Capable of unleashing a powerful
attack that clears a path.

forms.name: Ethereal Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Heavy Divider
forms.text:
A Switch Axe designed to remove
a flying wyvern's head from its
neck. It's stronger than steel.

forms.name: Grunhart
forms.text:
The Heavy Divider's final form,
it is known for its ability to smash
mountains with its heavy blows.

forms.name: Grunfest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Heavy Divider</COL>.

forms.name: Volt Axe
forms.text:
An axe mantled in lightning.
A weapon worthy of the Lord
of the Seas.

forms.name: Megavolt Axe
forms.text:
The Volt Axe's final form, it
channels the anger of the Lord
of the Seas to summon lightning.

forms.name: Gigavolt Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Volt Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Reckless Hatchet
forms.text:
A Tetsucabra Switch Axe that
summons forth the waves, and
leaves beautiful trails of water.

forms.name: Vine Splitter
forms.text:
The Reckless Hatchet's final
form. Sword and Axe combine
to devastate the enemy.

forms.name: Audacious Hatchet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Reckless Hatchet</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Axe
forms.text:
An explosive Switch Axe. High-
tech construction allows the slime
inside to move where it's needed.

forms.name: Grand Slasher
forms.text:
The Dios Axe's final form.
The slime inside is capable of
attacking with explosive force.

forms.name: Magnificent Slasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Axe
forms.text:
An explosive Switch Axe with a
Brachydios's power. Foes suffer
twice before they hit the ground.

forms.name: Brisant Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Axe's final
form, it can create an explosion
capable of leveling an entire city.

forms.name: Brisant Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Motor Burst
forms.text:
A broad Switch Axe requiring
great strength to use. One
swing sends foes flying.

forms.name: Gigant Burst
forms.text:
The final form of the Motor
Burst. The massive blade can
be used to topple mountains.

forms.name: Giganceladus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Motor Burst</COL>.

forms.name: Elite Switch Axe
forms.text:
An official Guild Switch
Axe. This standard model is
often used by outriders.

forms.name: Czar Switch Axe
forms.text:
The Elite Switch Axe's final
form. Its sharpened blade has
seen many bloody battles.

forms.name: Valor Switch Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elite Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Notched Tyrant
forms.text:
An axe liberally lined with
Zamtrios fangs. Bores into
the very bones of prey.

forms.name: Notched Oppressor
forms.text:
A Switch Axe designed to look
like a Zamtrios fang, it is the
Notched Tyrant's final form.

forms.name: Notched Ice Autarch
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Notched Tyrant</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made for slaughter.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Baraq Sedition
forms.text:
The final form of the Seditious
Axe, an emblem of strength for
those who choose to rebel.

forms.name: Sedition Splitter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Golden Crescent
forms.text:
The golden rays of moonlight
contained in this axe illuminated
a queen's march into darkness.

forms.name: Lune Shredder
forms.text:
The Golden Crescent's final form.
Its moonbeams split the dark
and purify the bloodstained.

forms.name: Harvest Moon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Golden Crescent</COL>.

forms.name: Dream Captor
forms.text:
A Switch Axe based on Malfestio
talons, it uses its three talons to
trap prey in a living nightmare.

forms.name: Somniferous Talon
forms.text:
The Dream Captor's final form.
Swipes from this axe can easily
bend both dreams and reality.

forms.name: Hypnotic Talon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dream Captor</COL>.

forms.name: Scissor Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made of Hermitaur
materials. It can change form
freely and sounds like the surf.

forms.name: Megatalon Shears
forms.text:
The Scissor Axe's final form
features twin blades resembling
Hermitaur claws that rip into prey.

forms.name: Colossoclaw Shears
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scissor Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Exoskeleton Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from insect
materials that feature hardened
shells and a paralytic agent.

forms.name: Exoskeleton Chopper
forms.text:
The Exoskeleton Axe's final form.
Its blade shines brightly due to
its use of high quality materials.

forms.name: Exoskeleton Hacker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Exoskeleton Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Downpour
forms.text:
A Switch Axe born from the finest
hunter in history. Its lightning
heralds the return of the king.

forms.name: Despot's Cloudburst
forms.text:
The final form of the Usurper's
Downpour, it is for those that
believe might makes right.

forms.name: Oppressor's Deluge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Downpour</COL>.

forms.name: Vavoom Vengeance
forms.text:
A redesign focused on power
and rigidity. Extra weight
punches it up even more.

forms.name: Vavoom Vindication
forms.text:
The Vavoom Vengeance's final
form. The sharpened blade easily
cuts through wyvern hide.

forms.name: Weird Wacha Nakha
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vavoom Vengeance</COL>.

forms.name: Rath Flame Splitter
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Rathalos materials.
Facilitates igniting attacks.

forms.name: Rath Blaze Splitter
forms.text:
The Rath Flame Splitter's
final form turns its user
into the king of hellfire.

forms.name: Rath Inferno Splitter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rath Flame Splitter</COL>.

forms.name: Rathsplicer
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from rare
and precious materials.
Ignites with more force.

forms.name: Rathlagration
forms.text:
The Rathsplicer's final form.
It floods the land with the fires
of a Silver Rathalos's vengeance.

forms.name: Rathscension
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rathsplicer</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Axe
forms.text:
An ebon Switch Axe, dark as
night. So fast, its swings are
nearly invisible.

forms.name: Night's Crescent
forms.text:
The Hidden Axe's final form.
Its light brings death to its victims
as it illuminates the night sky.

forms.name: Avidya Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Finslash
forms.text:
An elegant Switch Axe made from
a Plesioth. Its brilliant fins can
slice adversaries to ribbons.

forms.name: Mega Rhipidon
forms.text:
The Finslash's final form, it
attacks the enemy with Poison
and its sharpened blade.

forms.name: Cascade Rhipidon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Finslash</COL>.

forms.name: Fire Tempest
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from the
beak of the Agnaktor, which
resides in a sea of magma.

forms.name: Flame Tempest
forms.text:
The Fire Tempest's final form.
Those struck down by this blade
are instantly turned to dust.

forms.name: Helstrong Firebath
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fire Tempest</COL>.

forms.name: Flickaxe
forms.text:
The arched Najarala neck
makes prey freeze in terror
long before they can resist.

forms.name: Flick Helix
forms.text:
The Flickaxe's final form,
its repulsive gaze sends victims
into the depths of despair.

forms.name: Flick Angriff
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flickaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Flicker Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made with the soul
of a Najarala. Touching the blade
traps one in eternal nightmares.

forms.name: Paraflick Axe
forms.text:
The final form of the Flicker
Axe, its victims' souls can never
wake from endless nightmare.

forms.name: Paracrux Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flicker Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Binding Roller
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from the
tough, elastic shell of a Volvidon.
It's surprisingly flexible.

forms.name: Vermilingua
forms.text:
The Binding Roller's final form.
As it cuts down foes, its vermilion
blade pulses ever darker.

forms.name: Vermilion Bloodaxe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Binding Roller</COL>.

forms.name: La Guillotine
forms.text:
A Switch Axe said to be used by
the one that guides souls to the
afterlife. It cuts through darkness.

forms.name: Le Sursis
forms.text:
The final form of La Guillotine,
its divine guiding light dispels evil
and darkness from the land.

forms.name: La Conclusion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>La Guillotine</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe harboring demonic
fury. The cosmos cowers before
its golden bursts of lightning.

forms.name: Demonlord Edge
forms.text:
The Demonlord Axe's final
form. It is the manifestation of
pure rage that engulfs the land.

forms.name: Demonlord Earthshaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Saligia Vileaxe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe forged with blood
from a brutal Deviljho. Leads
wielders to a life of butchery.

forms.name: Saligia Enderaxe
forms.text:
The Saligia Vileaxe's final
form brings nothingness and
sheer devastation.

forms.name: Doomaxe "Downpour"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Saligia Vileaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Polaris Skalvia
forms.text:
This Switch Axe brings about a
rebirth as each swing shines
with the light of the cosmos.

forms.name: Cosmic Skalve
forms.text:
The Polaris Skalvia's final form.
The light of the cosmos gives
new life to the restless dead.

forms.name: Starfire Skalve
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Polaris Skalvia</COL>.

forms.name: Worn Switch Axe
forms.text:
A worn Switch Axe with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be restored...

forms.name: Weathered Switch Axe
forms.text:
The Worn Switch Axe's final
form. Unwavering in its strength,
it will never be restored.

forms.name: Aged Switch Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Mundus Altus
forms.text:
A transcendent ancient edge
that once parted heaven. The
final severance package.

forms.name: Mundus Regius
forms.text:
The final form of the Mundus
Altus. A weapon reborn from
ancient myths.

forms.name: Mundus Divinus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mundus Altus</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Arx
forms.text:
A fiery fang in the Flame
Emperor's arsenal. On scarlet
wings, it races through the sky.

forms.name: Teostra's Castle
forms.text:
The final form of Teostra's
Arx, its dragon fire incinerates
the Flame Emperor's enemies.

forms.name: Teostra's Hellebarde
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Arx</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Pure Axe
forms.text:
This Switch Axe utilizes wood
of uncanny hardness to give it
both strength and lightness.

forms.name: Yukumo Spirit Axe
forms.text:
The Yukumo Pure Axe's final
form. It has been refined to give
maximum destructive capacity.

forms.name: Yukumo Aura Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Pure Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe whose glare evokes a
Brachydios's wrath. The mechanism
triggers a whole wave of blasts.

forms.name: Lightbreak Intent
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Axe's final form.
Its mechanism has been pushed to
the limits of explosive power.

forms.name: Lightbreak Target
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Galefrost
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from superior
Barioth fangs. All who meet it
suffer the grave's cold embrace.

forms.name: Giga Galefrost
forms.text:
The Galefrost's final form boasts a
blade chilled to absolute zero.
One swish extinguishes life's flame.

forms.name: Amberfang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Galefrost</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Strongarm
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Charge
Blade for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Strongarm
forms.text:
The Petrified Strongarm's final
form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless efforts.

forms.name: Sophos Strongarm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Elite Blade
forms.text:
A well-forged steel Charge Blade.
It was once used by a champion
in countless battles.

forms.name: Kaiser Blade
forms.text:
The Elite Blade's final form.
It is a high-class weapon, made
from only the finest materials.

forms.name: Kaiser Kommandant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elite Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Blade
forms.text:
A simple Charge Blade carved
from a monster bone that is the
basis of similarly styled weapons.

forms.name: Bonesilt Veil
forms.text:
The Bone Blade's final form.
Its upgrades have given rise to
a harsh and heroic weapon.

forms.name: Bonebreaker Veil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Rogue Axe
forms.text:
A blade with a striking red and
green pattern, the Maccao scales
are a sign of a veteran hunter.

forms.name: Dashing Rogue
forms.text:
The Rogue Axe's final form. It
retains the flashy design, but ups
performance across the board.

forms.name: Dashing Bandit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rogue Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Desertfall
forms.text:
A Cephadrome Charge Blade, it
uses a paralytic agent as well as
a fin for offense and defense.

forms.name: Desert Sidefin
forms.text:
The final form of Desertfall. A
storm generated by its slashes can
swallow all that stand before it.

forms.name: Desert Death
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Desertfall</COL>.

forms.name: Blackguard
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made for the
general public. Casuals love
the heavy, stately design.

forms.name: Full Blackguard
forms.text:
The Blackguard's final form.
It retains its casual appearance
while greatly increasing power.

forms.name: Schwarzschild
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blackguard</COL>.

forms.name: Guardian Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade worn by the guard
of a ruler. It switches between
offense and defense effortlessly.

forms.name: Nadegiri
forms.text:
The Guardian Blade's final
form. It strikes down any who
threaten the wielder's master.

forms.name: Ceanataur Nadegiri
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guardian Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Cuddly Cat
forms.text:
Don't be fooled by this cat-based
blade. The hairs on its back are
able to cut through wyvern hide.

forms.name: Felyne Fancy
forms.text:
The Cuddly Cat's final form.
It has been continually refined,
almost as if its hair was petted.

forms.name: Ominous Puss
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cuddly Cat</COL>.

forms.name: Pizzaxe
forms.text:
This versatile Charge Blade is
perfect for slicing up delicious
pizza or vicious monsters.

forms.name: Pizza Wheel
forms.text:
Made for pizza lovers of all ages,
this is the final form of the
Pizzaxe. Buon Appetito!

forms.name: Deluxe Pizzaxe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pizzaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Chameleos C. Blade
forms.text:
A blade based on a mysterious
status and designed to worship
the fascinating Chameleos.

forms.name: Chameleos Edge
forms.text:
The Chameleos C. Blade's final
form. This blade is a divine force,
paralyzing foes with its dance.

forms.name: Chameleos Miasma
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chameleos C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Dear Lutemis
forms.text:
A Rathian Charge Blade, it houses
an uncommon evil. Its thorns are
a sign of the queen's personality.

forms.name: Dear Lutemia
forms.text:
The final form of Dear
Lutemis. Its beauty is sublime
yet severe at the same time.

forms.name: Dear Lutemineva
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dear Lutemis</COL>.

forms.name: Axelion Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Rathalos materials.
Facilitates igniting attacks.

forms.name: Bardichion Blade
forms.text:
The Axelion Blade's final form.
The face carved into the shield is
a representation of pure rage.

forms.name: Amgalion Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axelion Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Mizuniya Drill
forms.text:
An elegant Charge Blade known
for its tendency to stain its foes'
clothing a deep blood red.

forms.name: Final Fieldblade
forms.text:
The Mizuniya Drill's final form.
It generates a sea of crimson, with
none left standing in its wake.

forms.name: Divine Fieldblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mizuniya Drill</COL>.

forms.name: Axela Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from Astalos
materials. It is capable of using
Thunder attacks.

forms.name: Harbarex Blade
forms.text:
The Axela Blade's final form.
The image carved into its shield is
a sign of the Astalos's electric rage.

forms.name: Amagarex Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axela Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade said to have been
used by an ancient warrior. It is
even capable of razing mountains.

forms.name: Colossus's Edge
forms.text:
The final form of the Giant's
Edge. A lone warrior once used
it to overcome impossible odds.

forms.name: Behemoth's Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Scorching Demander
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that combines
the flames of a Glavenus as its
shield, and the tail as its sword.

forms.name: Glavenus Bardred
forms.text:
The Scorching Demander's final
form. It attacks with the force of
hellfire and brimstone.

forms.name: Glavenus Bardnova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scorching Demander</COL>.

forms.name: Elendskraft
Leidenskraft
forms.text:
The final form of Elendskraft.
It invites its victims to journey to
dark and hellish depths.

forms.name: Unheilskraft
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elendskraft</COL>.

forms.name: Aslat Charger
forms.text:
A lovely Seregios Charge Blade.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Rebellious Charger
forms.text:
The Aslat Charger's final
form. A spirit of revolution lies
within its golden blade.

forms.name: Aslat Revolution
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aslat Charger</COL>.

forms.name: Daora's Casca
forms.text:
A Kushala Daora Charge Blade
from the distant north. Its
divine shape repels disasters.

forms.name: Daora's Thwartoise
forms.text:
Daora's Casca's final form.
It is referred to as a tool of the
gods by northern mythology.

forms.name: Daora's Worldbearer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daora's Casca</COL>.

forms.name: Wicked Edge
forms.text:
A hideous Charge Blade that
reaps its victims' souls with a
single sweep of its tail.

forms.name: Malevolent Blade
forms.text:
The Wicked Edge's final
form. It exists to strike down all
in the name of desolation.

forms.name: Menkar Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wicked Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Vaik Veil
forms.text:
A blade that uses an incredibly
tough shell to cut through the
thickest wyvern hide.

forms.name: Shieldraad
forms.text:
The Vaik Veil's final form.
This blade more than earns its
keep when hunting in the field.

forms.name: Armordraad
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vaik Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Mandible Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from the
tough jaws of a Butterfly Beetle.
Its spines rip into flesh and bone.

forms.name: Maxilla Edge
forms.text:
The Mandible Blade's final
form. It has been sharpened to
the limit without losing strength.

forms.name: Skull Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mandible Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Black Strongarm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that harbors a
dark power inside, its shield
reveals its wielder's true form.

forms.name: Onyx Strongarm
forms.text:
The Black Strongarm's final
form, this blade has sacrificed
countless souls to the darkness.

forms.name: Fatalis Charger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Sentinel Blade
forms.text:
A standard Charge Blade with
a classy design and elemental
properties worked into it.

forms.name: Noblest of Lieges
forms.text:
The Sentinel Blade's final
form. Its refined looks hide the
powerful blasts it is able to fire.

forms.name: Noblest of Victories
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sentinel Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Schildsect
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that uses the
rigidity of a shell for powerful
offense and robust defense.

forms.name: Galvanisect
forms.text:
The Schildsect's final form. Its
refined shell adds further
strength and Sharpness.

forms.name: Excelsisect
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Schildsect</COL>.

forms.name: Barroth Anchor
forms.text:
An earthy Charge Blade made from
a Barroth. Its hardness offers both
protection and smashing ability.

forms.name: Rugged Anchor
forms.text:
The Barroth Anchor's final form.
The shield is hardened further to
provide unrivaled protection.

forms.name: Barroth Reanchor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barroth Anchor</COL>.

forms.name: Arachnoscale
forms.text:
A blade that uses its Nerscylla
parts to good visual effect. Has
a unique anti-friction mechanism.

forms.name: Arachnoscythe
forms.text:
The Arachnoscale's final form.
Can cut through the hardest shells
like a hot knife through butter.

forms.name: Belobog's Scythe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arachnoscale</COL>.

forms.name: Lava's Veil
forms.text:
A Lavasioth Charge Blade imbued
with pure magma. When its crater
opens, foes don't stand a chance.

forms.name: Crater Blade
forms.text:
The final form of the Lava's
Veil, it summons forth a hellfire
that douses the land in flames.

forms.name: Volclatero Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lava's Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Blade
forms.text:
A brawny Rajang Charge Blade.
Its golden trails symbolize power
that even gods and monsters fear.

forms.name: Demonlord Supersurge
forms.text:
The Demonlord Blade's final
form. A Rajang soul inside it can
transform into pure demonic rage.

forms.name: Demonlord Eradicator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Hero Strongarm
forms.text:
A weapon that has always gone
forth in search of new opponents
since ancient times.

forms.name: Master Strongarm
forms.text:
The Hero Strongarm's final
form. It disappeared for a time
before its rebirth.

forms.name: Legend Strongarm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hero Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Strongarm
forms.text:
A desert tyrant that kicks up
clouds of sand with each
cataclysmic strike.

forms.name: Cera Strongarm
forms.text:
The Diablos Strongarm's final form.
Smashes life with an explosion of
uncontainable anger.

forms.name: Cera Cediment
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Research Blade
forms.text:
A handy Charge Blade put together
by the Soaratorium eggheads to
navigate the skies during the night.

forms.name: Discovery Blade
forms.text:
The Research Blade's final form.
As a wise man once said, the
answers are written in the stars.

forms.name: Authority Teleblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Charge Fox
forms.text:
A special Famitsu weapon, its
splendid fox design can look
like either sword or shield.

forms.name: Press Corps Axe
forms.text:
The Charge Fox's final form,
designed with a breath-
taking interplay of color.

forms.name: Confidante
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Charge Fox</COL>.

forms.name: Legendary Anchor J
forms.text:
An anchor used by the master
of the seven seas. It carved
the path to a new world.

forms.name: Legendary Legacy J
forms.text:
The Legendary Anchor J's final
form. The anchor is heavy
with the hopes for the future.

forms.name: Legendary Strongarm J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Legendary Anchor J</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor C. Blade
forms.text:
A blade that houses a black-
hearted god. Its searing heat
begs to be unleashed and conquer.

forms.name: Akantor Severance
forms.text:
The Akantor C. Blade's final
form, it openly declares one's
ambition to conquer the land.

forms.name: Akantor Supremacy
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Altostratus Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade belonging to the
sun god. It will return the earth
to dust when it shines its light.

forms.name: Celestial Vortex
forms.text:
The Altostratus Blade's final
form. It showers the masses in
the light of hope and salvation.

forms.name: Universal Vortex
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Altostratus Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Edge
forms.text:
Shines with the Argent Comet's
silvery hue. As dense as an iron star,
its shredding attacks are merciless.

forms.name: Dragonstar Tenag
forms.text:
The Silverwing Edge's final form.
"Fear me, the star-cruncher; thus do
mighty supergiants become dust."

forms.name: Magnastar Tobah
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Strongarm
forms.text:
A Soaratorium Charge Blade for
hunters breaking new ground.
Solid both in defense and attack.

forms.name: Sage Strongarm
forms.text:
The Elder Strongarm's final form.
The strong blade fends off dragons,
punching through their tough hide.

forms.name: Philosopher Strongarm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Chili Axe
forms.text:
Want to breathe fire for real?
You'll need something spicy! Help
yourself to some spicing and slicing!

forms.name: Jalapeno Axe
forms.text:
The Chili Axe's final form.
The king of spiciness is here!
Now with spicier flame breath!

forms.name: Scotch Bonnet Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chili Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Elends/Essor
forms.text:
A Charge Blade whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Gefunden/Ruine
forms.text:
The Elends/Essor's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would stop decay.

forms.name: Friede/Désastre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elends/Essor</COL>.

forms.name: Vermilion Veil
forms.text:
Only dragon slayers are allowed
to use this weapon, but those who
do can wipe out dragons easily.

forms.name: Draconic Veil
forms.text:
The Vermilion Veil's final form.
One hit can separate the heavens
from the earth.

forms.name: Sealed Dragonveil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vermilion Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Gold Edge
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of night, clad
in a soulless robe.

forms.name: Inscribed Nephthys
forms.text:
The Gold Edge's final form.
Created by the bringer of night and
death's mistress, Nephthys.

forms.name: Nebethetepet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gold Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that houses an
Alatreon spirit. Its dark power brings
madness and self-destruction.

forms.name: Alatreon Morphblade
forms.text:
The Alatreon Edge's final form. Raw
madness rouses the Alatreon's spirit,
awakening the darkness within.

forms.name: Altheos Transmutation
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Reaver
forms.text:
The crimson dragon's ruinous
power, which the Guild has
secretly learned to harness.

forms.name: True Ruiner Reaver
forms.text:
The Ruiner Reaver's final form.
It takes strength and courage to
wield a weapon that brings despair.

forms.name: Absolute Ruiner Dawn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Reaver</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Mien
forms.text:
An ancient Fatalis blade that
ascends from hell with brutal
force in search of a sacrifice.

forms.name: Fatalis Demeanor
forms.text:
The Fatalis Mien's final form. No
matter how much it is drenched in
gore, the blade still shimmers.

forms.name: Fatalis Countenance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Mien</COL>.

forms.name: Dear Regina
forms.text:
A blade made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dearest Regina
forms.text:
The final form of Dear Regina.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dear Regina Nobis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dear Regina</COL>!

forms.name: Dreaded Blade
forms.text:
A blade made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking's Path
forms.text:
The Dreaded Blade's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Darkflame Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dreaded Blade</COL>!

forms.name: Rudra Divide
forms.text:
A blade made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Rider
forms.text:
The Rudra Divide's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Biter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rudra Divide</COL>!

forms.name: Ashen Demander
forms.text:
A blade made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Ashen Bardredd
forms.text:
The Ashen Demander's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Ashen Bardredd Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ashen Demander</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made of
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Gloom
forms.text:
The Cloaked Edge's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Twilight
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Slasher
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Relentless Slasher
forms.text:
The Razor Slasher's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Slasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Slasher</COL>!

forms.name: Fugitive Hours
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Red-Clad Rebellion
forms.text:
The Fugitive Hours's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Adoration Unwound
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fugitive Hours</COL>!

forms.name: Axebolt Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Boltreaver parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Axebolt Cleaver
forms.text:
The Axebolt Edge's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Maxbolt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axebolt Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Warder
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Edge's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Animosity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Strongarm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Enforcer
forms.text:
The Massacre Strongarm's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Column Buster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Strongarm</COL>!

forms.name: Snowy Veil
forms.text:
A Charge Blade affixed with
monster hide, its stripes
providing it with camouflage.

forms.name: Frosted Veil
forms.text:
The Snowy Veil's final form.
With its dull shine, the assassin's
blade greets its doomed prey.

forms.name: Pure Veil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Snowy Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Strongarm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from a
beautiful fossil. The stone is
still shiny despite its age.

forms.name: Relic Blade
forms.text:
The Obsidian Strongarm's final
form. Its ancient power razes the
earth as it attacks the enemy.

forms.name: Ethereal Statera
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Strongarm
forms.text:
A Brachydios Charge Blade whose
sturdy, blast-proof materials
make it a potent weapon.

forms.name: Volatile Blade
forms.text:
The Dios Strongarm's final
form. It channels even more
explosive force into its strikes.

forms.name: Explosive Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Blade
forms.text:
A Brachydios Charge Blade whose
innate heat cuts into prey and
makes its blood burst.

forms.name: Fulgent Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Blade's final
form. It uses its intense internal
heat to cover the land in flames.

forms.name: Fulgent Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Type 31 Wyvernslayer
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made of tough
Nibelsnarf materials. Its blade
brings a swift end to opponents.

forms.name: Reactive Border
forms.text:
The Type 31 Wyvernslayer's
final form. It is a highly
refined version of the original.

forms.name: Composite Border
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 31 Wyvernslayer</COL>.

forms.name: Poison Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that incorporates
the poison sac of a Gypceros to
quickly eliminate its prey.

forms.name: Venom's Kiss
forms.text:
The final form of the Poison
Blade, its poisonous edge is an
utter nightmare for opponents.

forms.name: Hell Venom Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poison Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Guardsqual
forms.text:
Forbidden jaws open when
shield becomes axe and drag
prey into a hopeless abyss.

forms.name: Squaliarma
forms.text:
The Guardsqual's final form.
When the Zamtrios's jaws open,
its prey meets a painful death.

forms.name: Squaliarmada
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guardsqual</COL>.

forms.name: Serrated Glace
forms.text:
A blade with a special mechanism
that creates a garden of razors
which blossom along the edge.

forms.name: Trios Tristesse
forms.text:
The Serrated Glace's final
form is a beautiful blood-soaked
blade that sows seeds of despair.

forms.name: Tristesse Durera
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Serrated Glace</COL>.

forms.name: K. Captain's Blade
forms.text:
A dignified Charge Blade bearing
the sigil of a knight-captain who
charged foes with electric force.

forms.name: Die Walküre
forms.text:
The K. Captain's Blade's final
form. Named for a mighty female
warrior, it has won many battles.

forms.name: Tristan and Isolde
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>K. Captain's Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Tigrex Divide
forms.text:
A Tigrex Charge Blade, its sharp
fangs and talons wait for an
opportunity to strike at its prey.

forms.name: Tigrex Blade
forms.text:
The Tigrex Divide's final form.
It opens its mouth and lets out
cruel laughter, taunting foes.

forms.name: Huge Tigrex Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tigrex Divide</COL>.

forms.name: Luna Eostre
forms.text:
A Charge Blade housing the golden
Moon Goddess, who opens her gate
in the sky to shine down mercy.

forms.name: Glimmering Eostre
forms.text:
The Luna Eostre's final form.
It rises like the moon to bathe
the earth in purifying flame.

forms.name: Luna Crucible
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Luna Eostre</COL>.

forms.name: Horror Zofar
forms.text:
A blade with a Malfestio-inspired
design. Sword and shield pair to
form wings that spirit away prey.

forms.name: Dormant Wings
forms.text:
The Horror Zofar's final form.
A dreamy sky endlessly unfolds
as the Malfestio spreads its wings.

forms.name: Zofar Wings
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Horror Zofar</COL>.

forms.name: Poisonous Veil
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that features a
poisonous sac. Its dark blade
instills dread in the enemy.

forms.name: Infected Veil
forms.text:
The Poisonous Veil's final
form. Its deadly toxin creates
chaos that knows no end.

forms.name: Malefico Veil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poisonous Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Hellsire Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
rare and precious materials.
Ignites with more force.

forms.name: Hellspawn Blade
forms.text:
The Hellsire Blade's final form.
It emits rays of silvery sun that
punish foes with godly fury.

forms.name: Rathflame Ubernova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hellsire Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Lagia Storm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made of Lagiacrus
materials. Signals the start of a
hunt with the roar of thunder.

forms.name: Vankrom Blade
forms.text:
The final upgrade of Lagia
Storm. It features the power of
a Lagiacrus, ruler of the seas.

forms.name: Vankrom Voltblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagia Storm</COL>.

forms.name: Dominisect
forms.text:
A blade recognizable by its
sharp, red horns, which serve as
a dire warning and direr weapon.

forms.name: Maximinsect
forms.text:
The Dominisect's final form,
its red horns instill fear as
they pulverize the enemy.

forms.name: Apex Predator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dominisect</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Blade
forms.text:
An implement of beauty and death.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Garuda Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Blade's final
form. Its blade pointed skyward
signals the time for rebellion.

forms.name: Sedition Severer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Blade</COL>.

forms.name: L'Oppresseur
L'Essor
forms.text:
The final form of L'Oppresseur.
It cleanses the soul by bringing
the light of life to the darkness.

forms.name: Le Salut
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>L'Oppresseur</COL>.

forms.name: Gant Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that serves as
a guide in the night sky once
its tail appears.

forms.name: Cosmic Edge
forms.text:
The Gant Blade's final
form, it ushers in a desolate
wind to cover the land.

forms.name: Sirius Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gant Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Worn C. Blade
forms.text:
A worn Charge Blade with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be restored...

forms.name: Weathered C. Blade
forms.text:
The Worn C. Blade's final form.
Further altering this incomparable
masterwork would be abominable.

forms.name: Aged C. Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Chrono Gear
forms.text:
An ancient Charge Blade that
has had its gears restored via
modern technology and parts.

forms.name: Ionian Gear
forms.text:
The Chrono Gear's final form.
Its gears of destiny count down
to the end of days.

forms.name: Tourbillon Gear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chrono Gear</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Striker
forms.text:
A Charge Blade whose power blasts
hell's gates off their hinges
with the Flame Emperor's ire.

forms.name: Teostra's Nova
forms.text:
The final form of Teostra's
Striker. It serves as the gates
to purgatory, expelling evil.

forms.name: Teostra's Redeemer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Striker</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak C. Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade whose inner fire
begs for freedom so that it might
set its rage upon the world.

forms.name: Lightbreak Vent
forms.text:
The Lightbreak C. Blade's final form.
Its inner anger explodes with
limitless power, destroying all.

forms.name: Lightbreak Unleasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Blossomauler
forms.text:
A Charge Blade imbued with the
fire wyverns' brilliance. Gold
and silver fire bloom within.

forms.name: Propensity
forms.text:
The Blossomauler's final form.
A bright blast of profusive flames
reduces everything to ashes.

forms.name: Cornucopia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blossomauler</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Rod
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Insect
Glaive for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Rod
forms.text:
The Petrified Rod's final form.
A product of the Wycademy's
tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Rod
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Bayonet
forms.text:
A glaive made of iron. Simple,
but it possesses all the features a
hunter could ask for.

forms.name: Hiten Blade
forms.text:
The Iron Bayonet's final iteration.
Outwardly, it looks the same, but it
has received some hefty upgrades.

forms.name: Hiten Blade Kai
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Bayonet</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Staff
forms.text:
A simple bone Insect Glaive.
Its latent power can be tapped
if upgraded correctly.

forms.name: Aerial Glaive
forms.text:
The Bone Staff's final form. It
retains the simplicity, but
boasts numerous upgrades.

forms.name: Volant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Staff</COL>.

forms.name: Hortadent
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made to look just
like a beetle. Its wriggling jaws are
not for the squeamish.

forms.name: Hortadent Brada
forms.text:
The Hortadent's final upgrade.
Its improved jaws are capable of
ripping its prey to shreds.

forms.name: Altaroth Trident
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hortadent</COL>.

forms.name: Azure Bayonet
forms.text:
A bayonet-style Insect Glaive with
added Velociprey materials. It
whizzes across fields in pursuit of prey.

forms.name: General's Bayonet
forms.text:
The Azure Bayonet's final form.
Made for even more mobile pursuit
forces, it tracks targets with ease.

forms.name: Assault Serpent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Azure Bayonet</COL>.

forms.name: Wardance Cudgel
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made of Blangonga
parts. The faces of warriors from
many snowy regions are carved into it.

forms.name: Warparty Cudgel
forms.text:
The Wardance Cudgel's final form
is said to be able to call forth mighty
snowstorms with a single swing.

forms.name: Warfeast Cudgel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wardance Cudgel</COL>.

forms.name: Fader Rod
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive known for its
light yellow feathers. Loved by
many for its ease of use.

forms.name: Scale Fader
forms.text:
The Fader Rod's final form.
Its vivid Maccao feathers cut
down those in their way.

forms.name: Escama Fader
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fader Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Sand Anchor
forms.text:
A Cephadrome Insect Glaive. It
attacks like tusks bursting forth
from the sand.

forms.name: Dune Anchor
forms.text:
The Sand Anchor's final form.
Its hardened fin glistens in the
sun as it flies through the air.

forms.name: Desert Anchor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sand Anchor</COL>.

forms.name: Acorn Rod
forms.text:
A weapon created by a Felyne,
inspired by the sharp edges of
an acorn.

forms.name: Meownster Club
forms.text:
The Acorn Rod's final iteration.
Monsters will stop in their tracks
upon seeing this weaponized nut!

forms.name: Meownster Masher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Acorn Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Magia Pitareen
forms.text:
A glaive made following ardent
requests from female hunters. The
perfect blend of form and function.

forms.name: Magia Crescent
forms.text:
The Magia Pitareen's final form.
Guaranteed to be the hottest
item for this hunting season.

forms.name: Magia Finale
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magia Pitareen</COL>.

forms.name: Sturdy Glaive
forms.text:
This bone Insect Glaive has been
crafted from bone with legendary
skill and superior quality materials.

forms.name: Sturdy Glaive Redux
forms.text:
The Sturdy Glaive's final form.
Made from the highest quality bone
for excellent Sharpness and damage.

forms.name: Stalwart Glaive
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sturdy Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Fox Halberd
forms.text:
A glaive owned by a warrior
that served his lord to the death.
Its blade dances like the wind.

forms.name: Curved Naganagi
forms.text:
The Fox Halberd's final form. It
