forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Binary Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Moofire Cannon
forms.text:
This Heavy Bowgun shows what
happens when normally docile
Moofah go on the attack!

forms.name: Mooflame Cannon
forms.text:
The burning spirit of the Moofah
has evolved the Moofire Cannon
into its final form.

forms.name: Mooflare Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Moofire Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Lunastra's Zeal
forms.text:
Based on a mysterious Lunastra
statue, this Bowgun was built
to honor the fiery beast.

forms.name: Lunastra's Roar
forms.text:
The final form of the Lunastra's
Zeal. It attacks with the divine power
of a Lunastra's mighty howl.

forms.name: Lunastra's Charge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lunastra's Zeal</COL>.

forms.name: Felyne Bowgun
forms.text:
A wooden Bowgun made in the
image of a Felyne. It makes for
one of the cutest weapons ever.

forms.name: Felyne Cannon
forms.text:
The damage caused by this
purrfected version of the Felyne
Bowgun makes foes hiss-tory.

forms.name: Felyne Artillery
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Felyne Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Lagia Blitz
forms.text:
A weapon made of Lagiacrus parts.
The electrified barrel prevents
bullets from losing velocity.

forms.name: Thunderblitz Cannon
forms.text:
The Lagia Blitz's final upgrade.
Concentrated electrical energy
gives it great destructive force.

forms.name: Thundercrash Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagia Blitz</COL>.

forms.name: Cirrus Blaster
forms.text:
A Bowgun created by an honorable
warrior tribe. Its blast can
dispel the thickest of dark fogs.

forms.name: Mountainous Roar
forms.text:
The Cirrus Blaster's final form.
It leaves a watery trail behind its
shots that can reach the moon.

forms.name: Mountainous Torrent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cirrus Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Blaster
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from conductive
Astalos materials. Hunters love
the shocking damage it can inflict.

forms.name: Wyvern Shocker
forms.text:
Final upgrade of the Wyvern
Blaster. The latest technology is
packed into its slender barrel.

forms.name: Wyvern Crasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Cannon
forms.text:
An ancient Bowgun said to have
been used by a mighty warrior.
Its mighty roar can crush boulders.

forms.name: Giant's Rocket
forms.text:
The final form of the Giant's
Cannon. Used by the last warrior
to challenge an evil god to battle.

forms.name: Giant's Mega Rocket
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Burning Igna
forms.text:
This Bowgun covered in a Glavenus
shell is capable of incinerating
its targets with fiery precision.

forms.name: Glavenus Scorcher
forms.text:
The final form of the Burning
Igna. It has been tested and
forged in the fires of battle.

forms.name: Glavenus Scorchanova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Burning Igna</COL>.

forms.name: Sayyad Cannon
forms.text:
A Seregios Heavy Bowgun. Evading
with the weapon out auto-loads
one round of the selected ammo.

forms.name: Insurrection Cannon
forms.text:
The Sayyad Cannon's final form.
It will continue firing as long as
the revolutionary spirit survives.

forms.name: Anarchy Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sayyad Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Tigrex Howl
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun that looks
like a Tigrex head and has
just as much bite.

forms.name: Tigrex Skull
forms.text:
The Tigrex Howl's final form.
Built from tough Tigrex parts, it
emits a loud roar with each blast.

forms.name: Huge Tigrex Skull
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tigrex Howl</COL>.

forms.name: Tödlicher Abzug
forms.text:
A Gore Magala Heavy Bowgun that
pronounces black curses upon
prey, devouring them from within.

forms.name: Ableben Abzug
forms.text:
Final form of the tenebrous
Tödlicher Abzug. Its black curses
have doomed countless opponents.

forms.name: Gemetzel Abzug
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tödlicher Abzug</COL>.

forms.name: Daora's Delphinidae
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made of
strong Daora parts and fitted
with experimental features.

forms.name: Daora Grande
forms.text:
The final upgrade for Daora's
Delphinidae. The parts used add
to its already immense power.

forms.name: Daora's Ceti
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daora's Delphinidae</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Cannon
forms.text:
A Bowgun that has measured the
worth of many an individual before
sending them to the afterlife.

forms.name: Total Absolution
forms.text:
The final form of the Skeletal
Cannon. Ensures that victims pay
for the sins of this life in the next.

forms.name: Zubenelgenubi Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Aquamatic "Needler"
forms.text:
A rare Heavy Bowgun from a
foreign land. Prized by hunters
who prefer to use gunpowder.

forms.name: Aquamatic "Firelash"
forms.text:
The final form of the Aquamatic
"Needler" is perfect for "sewing"
a wide path of destruction.

forms.name: Aquamatic "Ashmaker"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aquamatic "Needler"</COL>.

forms.name: Black Cannon
forms.text:
Giant Bowgun that holds a
dark power. Fires death from
the abyss of its barrel.

forms.name: Onyx Cannon
forms.text:
The Black Cannon's final form.
Any who face its powerful blast
will meet with certain death.

forms.name: Fatalis Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Straw Drumcannon
forms.text:
Firework canister technology
adapted for a Heavy Bowgun.
Great power if used safely.

forms.name: Shirabeo
forms.text:
Final upgrade of the Straw
Drumcannon. It rains deadly
shots down on unsuspecting prey.

forms.name: Ratatat Drumcannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Straw Drumcannon</COL>.

forms.name: Carrozza Bazooka
forms.text:
A weapon modeled on a pumpkin
carriage from a fairy tale. Made
on a whim, yet oddly popular.

forms.name: Cendrillon
forms.text:
The final form of the Carrozza
Bazooka. Granted the wishes
of a young girl, long, long ago.

forms.name: Bibidi Babidi Boom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Carrozza Bazooka</COL>.

forms.name: Rock Eater
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Basarios parts. It's pretty heavy,
so make sure you don't skip leg day.

forms.name: Earth Eater
forms.text:
The Rock Eater's final form. Its
improved firepower can turn your
surroundings into scorched earth.

forms.name: Gaia Eater
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rock Eater</COL>.

forms.name: Ner Bustergun
forms.text:
A weapon whose ample elastic
Nerscylla parts make it both
wieldy and devastating.

forms.name: Buster Blaster
forms.text:
This upgraded form of the Ner
Bustergun boasts improved stopping
power and precision.

forms.name: Buster Lancera
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ner Bustergun</COL>.

forms.name: Shooting Star
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from fine
crystals. Its heavenly shape
resembles a falling star.

forms.name: Great Meteor
forms.text:
The Shooting Star's final form.
The shots it fires leave comet-like
trails on their way to their targets.

forms.name: Mighty Asteroid
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shooting Star</COL>.

forms.name: Ladybug Cannon
forms.text:
Made of giant insect shell,
its beautiful exterior
hides great power.

forms.name: Ladybug Mortar
forms.text:
A Bowgun that has used a giant
insect shell to upgrade the Ladybug
Cannon to its final form.

forms.name: Great Ladybug Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ladybug Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Power Stinger
forms.text:
A mid-range weapon that can
fire Pierce shots. Can hold
its own in a melee fight.

forms.name: Wild Stinger
forms.text:
The Power Stinger's final form.
This all-rounder even works as a
melee weapon. That's versatility!

forms.name: Fatal Stinker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Power Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Guerrera Cannon
forms.text:
This weapon is well insulated from
the bitter cold, so it's great for
low-temperature environments.

forms.name: Thorn Cannon
forms.text:
The Guerrera Cannon's final form.
Based on the Bowgun of a legend
who fought under cover of snow.

forms.name: Valía Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guerrera Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Gravios Howl
forms.text:
A large caliber weapon in
the shape of a White Gravios.
Its shots shake the earth.

forms.name: Gravios Gigahowl
forms.text:
The Gravios Howl's final form. Its
powerful shots are as loud as
they are destructive.

forms.name: Gravios Gigascream
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gravios Howl</COL>.

forms.name: Magnificent El Dora Gun
forms.text:
Made by peddlers based on relics
they found on their travels.
It's worth a pretty penny.

forms.name: Invaluable Lost Cannon
forms.text:
The Magnificent El Dora Gun's final
form. Gives the impression of being
made of very valuable materials.

forms.name: Shamballa's Treasure
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magnificent El Dora Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Gluttonous Cannon
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from Deviljho parts
that rips prey to shreds. Even its
barrel can be used as a weapon.

forms.name: Dark Devourer
forms.text:
The final form of the Gluttonous
Cannon. Countless souls have been
sacrificed by its punishing impact.

forms.name: Nero's Worldeater
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gluttonous Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Hero Blaster
forms.text:
Its techniques have been handed
down through the ages, waking
and giving form to the unknown.

forms.name: Master Blaster
forms.text:
Over time, long-faded relics of
the past have upgraded the
Hero Blaster to its final form.

forms.name: Legend Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hero Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Dual Threat
forms.text:
A dueling weapon fashioned with
two large horns. Don't get cute
and cut yourself on it!

forms.name: Diablazooka
forms.text:
The Dual Threat's final form is
made to destroy enemies on sight.
Its firepower is beyond compare.

forms.name: Diablastazooka
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dual Threat</COL>.

forms.name: Research Cannon
forms.text:
This Soaratorium staple also works
as a microscope. It's not clear if the
Wyventurer knows it's a weapon...

forms.name: Discovery Cannon
forms.text:
The Research Cannon's final form.
Some researchers use it just to
monitor subjects through the scope.

forms.name: Authority Macroscope
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Arbahefty
forms.text:
A remodeled (and heavier) version
of the Arbalest. Want to use it?
Can you do 500 push-ups in a row?

forms.name: Arbaheftier
forms.text:
The Arbahefty's final form. Feel
that burn! The firing mechanism
gets pretty hot too.

forms.name: Arbaheftiest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arbahefty</COL>.

forms.name: Pirate Cannon J
forms.text:
The Bowgun of a legendary
pirate. It can be counted on
to blow away one's rivals.

forms.name: Buccaneer Cannon J
forms.text:
The Pirate Cannon J's final
form. It blasts apart anything
that stands in its way.

forms.name: Pirate King Cannon J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pirate Cannon J</COL>.

forms.name: Kamaeleon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun that vanishes into
the fog, but, like the Chameleos,
is always ready to pounce.

forms.name: Veiled Kamaeleon
forms.text:
The Kamaeleon's final upgrade.
This Bowgun punishes any
unsuspecting prey it finds.

forms.name: Invisible Kamaeleon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kamaeleon</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Artillery
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made of
burning Teostra parts. Its
beauty hides a raging inferno.

forms.name: Teostra's Flames
forms.text:
This Heavy Bowgun is the final
form of Teostra's Artillery. Emits
dancing flames upon reloading.

forms.name: Teostra's Firestorm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Artillery</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Cannon
forms.text:
An infernal weapon with the
power of the black god. Its howl
rips the life from prey.

forms.name: Akantor Skysounder
forms.text:
The Akantor Cannon's final
form. Descends upon the land as
a vessel of the dark gods.

forms.name: Akantor Descent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Cannon
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's eleventh power: tears
that oppress the soul.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skyblaster
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Cannon's final form.
When the snow god's tears fell,
sinners repented.

forms.name: Ukanlos Rising
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Ill Omen
forms.text:
The fate of those who face
this weapon is like time itself --
there is no turning back.

forms.name: Celestial Tempest
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the
Ill Omen. Can control the
fate of those around it.

forms.name: Endless Sky
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ill Omen</COL>.

forms.name: Chaos Wing
forms.text:
An onyx Heavy Bowgun born from
anger and chaos. Unknown energy
flickers around the barrel.

forms.name: Altheos Aetheria
forms.text:
Final upgrade for the Chaos Wing,
it converts sorrow, despair, and
fear into a source of strength.

forms.name: Altheos Aeterna
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chaos Wing</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Cannon
forms.text:
A glistening silver Bowgun. Like
the Argent Comet, its bullets smash
through anything in their way.

forms.name: Dragonstar Denig
forms.text:
The Silverwing Cannon's final form.
"Fear me, the nebula-nixer; watch
as I rid the sky of stars."

forms.name: Magnastar Fujik
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Cannon
forms.text:
A Soaratorium Heavy Bowgun
for hunters breaking new ground.
Marvellous firing power.

forms.name: Sage Cannon
forms.text:
The Elder Cannon's final form.
One shot from this powerful weapon
reduces the surroundings to ash.

forms.name: Philosopher Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Cannonissimo
forms.text:
The Questender carries this Bowgun
while on active duty. It requires
a very special set of skills to use.

forms.name: Llave de Libertad
forms.text:
The Cannonissimo's final form.
It represents hunters who put their
lives on the line for others.

forms.name: Vive La Libération
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cannonissimo</COL>.

forms.name: Verrat/Foi
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Sicherheit/Risque
forms.text:
The Verrat/Foi's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who can bear suffering.

forms.name: Ursprung/Mort
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verrat/Foi</COL>.

forms.name: Lao-Shan Lung Cannon
forms.text:
This Heavy Bowgun combines
the power and huge defensive
power of Lao-Shan Lung.

forms.name: Grand Lao-Shan Cannon
forms.text:
The final form of the Lao-Shan Lung
Cannon packs so much firepower it
could be used as coastal defense.

forms.name: True Lao-Shan Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lao-Shan Lung Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Goldcannon
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a hawk
design used to identify royalty.

forms.name: Inscribed Haroeris
forms.text:
The Goldcannon's final form.
Borne by a god as he ascended to
the heavens, it is now reborn.

forms.name: Ra-Horakhty
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldcannon</COL>.

forms.name: Vor Cannon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun containing a
Fatalis soul. Unimaginable
power and performance.

forms.name: Vor Buster
forms.text:
The Vor Cannon's final form. Users
swear they can hear a Fatalis's evil
reaching out to claim them.

forms.name: Vor Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vor Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Destiny's Hand
forms.text:
Built from a plan glossed from
ancient texts. This weapon's
workings are a mystery.

forms.name: Destiny's Arm
forms.text:
The Destiny's Hand's final form.
Its howl brings death and
despair to all who hear it.

forms.name: Destiny's Shoulder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Destiny's Hand</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Enslaver
forms.text:
A crude Heavy Bowgun that
harnesses divine, white-golden
light and devours the world.

forms.name: Fatalis Subjugator
forms.text:
The Fatalis Enslaver's final form.
Take care not to awaken its spirit,
for its roar will end the world.

forms.name: Fatalis Transformer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Enslaver</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Bowgun
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Redhelm parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crimson Cannon
forms.text:
The Crimson Bowgun's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Redhelm Arzuros.

forms.name: Crimson Crasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Bowgun</COL>!

forms.name: Eeostopen Burst
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Snowbaron parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Eeostopen Cannon
forms.text:
The Eeostopen Burst's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Snowbaron Lagombi.

forms.name: Eeostopen Avalanche
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eeostopen Burst</COL>!

forms.name: Stonefist Buster
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Ebon Stonefist Buster
forms.text:
Final form of the Stonefist
Buster. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stonefist Buster</COL>!

forms.name: Dreadqueen Shot
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Blaster
forms.text:
The Dreadqueen Shot's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Crasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dreadqueen Shot</COL>!

forms.name: Demonic Cannon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Drilltusk parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Chthonic Cannon
forms.text:
The Demonic Cannon's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Chthonic Mortar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonic Cannon</COL>!

forms.name: Silverwind Sniper
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dawn's Rage
forms.text:
The Silverwind Sniper's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Dawn's Torment
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwind Sniper</COL>!

forms.name: Grobo Shot
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grobo Barzeta
forms.text:
The Grobo Shot's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Grobo Shot Diamante
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grobo Shot</COL>!

forms.name: Cahoe Shot
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Cahoe
forms.text:
The Cahoe Shot's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Combustion Cahoe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cahoe Shot</COL>!

forms.name: Lord's Shot
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Lord's Roar
forms.text:
The Lord's Shot's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Lord's Bellow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lord's Shot</COL>!

forms.name: Rudra's Howl
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Cannon
forms.text:
Final form of Rudra's Howl.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Howl
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rudra's Howl</COL>!

forms.name: Ashen Blaster
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Ashen Eclipse
forms.text:
The Ashen Blaster's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Ashen Sky Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ashen Blaster</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Horror
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Nightmare
forms.text:
The Cloaked Horror's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Night Terror
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Horror</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Piercer
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Daredevil Piercer
forms.text:
The Razor Piercer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Piercer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Piercer</COL>!

forms.name: Bitter Breeze
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Priestess in Red
forms.text:
The Soulseer Gust's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: A Marriage Divine
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bitter Breeze</COL>!

forms.name: Boltreaver Cannon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Boltreaver parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Boltreaver Blaster
forms.text:
The Boltreaver Cannon's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Boltreaver Assault
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Boltreaver Cannon</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Boom
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Kaboom
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Boom's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Kablast
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Boom</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Cannon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Blaster
forms.text:
The Massacre Cannon's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Ivanus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Cannon</COL>!

forms.name: Anteka Burst
forms.text:
A Bowgun that fires pieces of
Anteka horn. The fur lining
on its barrel absorbs shock.

forms.name: Anteka Blaster
forms.text:
The Anteka Burst's final form.
The flexible horns it fires carve
the air with deadly precision.

forms.name: Anteka Shatterblast
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Anteka Burst</COL>.

forms.name: Queen's Longfire
forms.text:
A weapon made of Fire-resistant
Rathian parts. Much beloved by
hunters for its reliability.

forms.name: Queen's Farflier
forms.text:
The final form of the Queen's
Longfire. Its elongated barrel
provides both form and function.

forms.name: Queen's Scionfire
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Queen's Longfire</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Cannon
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from a beautiful
fossil. One can feel its history
with a single touch.

forms.name: Relic Cannon
forms.text:
The Obsidian Cannon's final
form. Its powerful volleys leave
countless felled in its wake.

forms.name: Ethereal Carbonifer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Griffin's Charge
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from Seltas parts.
Shots fired from its rough-edged
barrel easily pierce enemy hides.

forms.name: Seltas Cannon
forms.text:
The final form of the Griffin's
Charge. Its penetrating ability lays
waste like a rampaging Seltas.

forms.name: Heroic Seltas Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Griffin's Charge</COL>.

forms.name: Crab Buster
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun crafted from
Daimyo Hermitaur materials.
Strong and upgradeable.

forms.name: Heavy Crab Buster
forms.text:
The Crab Buster's final form.
Veteran hunters appreciate its
tough Hermitaur shell frame.

forms.name: Immovable Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crab Buster</COL>.

forms.name: Piercing Crab
forms.text:
A Bowgun with a menacing-looking
exterior, it can fire long distance
support rounds that shred enemies.

forms.name: Ceanataur Blaster
forms.text:
The Piercing Crab's final form.
Like its namesake, the rounds
it fires are inescapable.

forms.name: Master Shooter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Piercing Crab</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Gambit
forms.text:
A Bowgun for assassins that live in
shadows. Its silent strikes can take
a life before the prey even realizes.

forms.name: Baleful Night
forms.text:
The final iteration of the Hidden
Gambit. It delivers death from
the shadows of a moonless night.

forms.name: Avidya Gambit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Gambit</COL>.

forms.name: Rapidcaster
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun designed for rapid
reloads, veteran hunters love it
for its ease of operability.

forms.name: Cyclecaster
forms.text:
The Rapidcaster's final form. It
unleashes a torrent of rapid fire
ammo that deals potent damage.

forms.name: Torrentcaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rapidcaster</COL>.

forms.name: Agnaboom
forms.text:
A crimson Heavy Bowgun made of
Agnaktor parts. Flame-blessed,
it boasts superior performance.

forms.name: Agna Hellblazer
forms.text:
The Agnaboom's final version.
It uses an Agnaktor's rage to
generate waves of crimson flames.

forms.name: Agna Hellraiser
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Agnaboom</COL>.

forms.name: Pressurized Plaser
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun shaped like
a Plesioth torso. Its water-
clad ammo tracks its prey.

forms.name: Pluripotent Plaser
forms.text:
The Pressurized Plaser's final
form. Fires powerful blasts with
the strength of a raging tide.

forms.name: Phalanx Plaser
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pressurized Plaser</COL>.

forms.name: Yian Kut-Ku Cannon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun with a large bore
and the power to match. Cleverly
crafted from Kut-Ku parts.

forms.name: Super Kut-Ku Cannon
forms.text:
The Yian Kut-Ku Cannon's final
form. Its output is maximized to
incinerate foes instantly.

forms.name: Gigantic Kut-Ku Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yian Kut-Ku Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Raven Heirloom
forms.text:
Black Heavy Bowgun made from
Yian Garuga. A single shot
can shatter a shield.

forms.name: Wolf Heirloom
forms.text:
The final iteration of the Raven
Heirloom. Its rage is not satiated
until every foe is laid to waste.

forms.name: Crow Heirloom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raven Heirloom</COL>.

forms.name: Icethrower
forms.text:
Blangonga fur covers this
strong, Normal S-centered
Bowgun. Scary stuff.

forms.name: Iceblaster
forms.text:
The Icethrower's final upgrade.
It fires in a wide spread as it
blasts the enemy to pieces.

forms.name: Icelauncher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icethrower</COL>.

forms.name: Quickcaster
forms.text:
Heavy Bowgun made from the
beautiful Kirin. As powerful
as it is precious.

forms.name: Quick Quiver
forms.text:
The Quickcaster's final form.
Sends out powerful lightning
that smashes into foes.

forms.name: Quick Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Quickcaster</COL>.

forms.name: Injector Cannon
forms.text:
A unique-looking Heavy Bowgun. It
fires powerful shells from a barrel
made of an Altaroth's abdomen.

forms.name: Zect Injector
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the Injector
Cannon. Harnesses an Altaroth's
rage to exterminate dragons.

forms.name: Trypophobia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Injector Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Flechette Gun
forms.text:
A powerful Heavy Bowgun shaped
like an Altaroth. Its dart-like
projectiles strike straight and true.

forms.name: Honeycomber
forms.text:
Final upgrade for the Flechette
Gun. Its victims can be struck
multiple times in mere seconds.

forms.name: Waspstinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flechette Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Meteor Buster
forms.text:
Heavy Bowgun sporting a
simple structure for speed
and high firepower.

forms.name: Meteor Shower
forms.text:
The Meteor Buster's final form.
Its clever design fires shots that
hit with the force of a falling star.

forms.name: Meteor Storm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Meteor Buster</COL>.

forms.name: Striker's Bowgun
forms.text:
A Bowgun built on the concept of
dynamic performance. It boasts
a rich assortment of features.

forms.name: Elite Bowgun
forms.text:
Final upgrade for the Striker's
Bowgun. Its heavy barrel looses
blasts of terrific speed and power.

forms.name: Imperial Bowgun
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Striker's Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Bite Blaster
forms.text:
The Najarala-reinforced
barrel stabilizes trajectory
so ammo rips through targets.

forms.name: Biting Blast
forms.text:
The final version of the Bite
Blaster. Its ammo harbors the
destructive malice of a Najarala.

forms.name: Ravager Blast
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bite Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Cannon
forms.text:
The bane of whole armies. Evading
with the weapon out auto-loads
one round of the selected ammo.

forms.name: Furia Sedition
forms.text:
The final form of the Seditious
Cannon, this Heavy Bowgun can
overturn the heavens themselves.

forms.name: Sedition Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Cannon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun filled with
explosive Brachydios slime.
Its shots have matchless force.

forms.name: Atom Cannon
forms.text:
The Dios Cannon's final form.
The slime inside boosts its
ammo's speed and power.

forms.name: Fission Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Cannon
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from Brachydios
parts. Explosive slime inside can
propel shots through steel.

forms.name: Haize Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Cannon's final
form. Its numerous upgrades
make it a terrifying weapon.

forms.name: Haize Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Type 46 Gunflage
forms.text:
A basic Heavy Bowgun wielded by
desert mercenaries. It's been
refined over countless battles.

forms.name: Nibelflage Prototype
forms.text:
The Type 46 Gunflage's final
form. Mercenaries lovingly refer
to it as the Great Snake.

forms.name: Final Nibelflage
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 46 Gunflage</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Tremor
forms.text:
A weapon that converts will into
power. A true monarch can push
it beyond its limits.

forms.name: Despot's Paroxysm
forms.text:
The final form of the Usurper's
Tremor. With each bullet fires an
intense urge to overcome evil.

forms.name: Oppressor's Making
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Tremor</COL>.

forms.name: Arzuros Gun
forms.text:
A weapon used to hunt mountain
beasts. Basic construction makes
upkeep easy and aids firepower.

forms.name: Arzuros Fishergun
forms.text:
Final upgrade for the Arzuros
Gun. The power of the large caliber
shots it fires is the stuff of legend.

forms.name: Arbearalest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arzuros Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Monteverde
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun with a
Duramboros shell on its
barrel for extra power.

forms.name: Peaksmasher
forms.text:
Final form of the Monteverde.
A Heavy Bowgun capable of
cutting through mountains.

forms.name: Bergbasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Monteverde</COL>.

forms.name: Le Désastre
forms.text:
An iridescent Shagaru Magala
Bowgun that brings light to the
earth with each heavenly peal.

forms.name: La Foi
forms.text:
Final form of the luminous
Le Désastre. Its light can
end the world's darkness.

forms.name: Le Déluge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Le Désastre</COL>.

forms.name: Cosmic Cannon
forms.text:
A Bowgun that has weighed the
value of planets across the known
universe and judged accordingly.

forms.name: Vizvi Cannon
forms.text:
The Cosmic Cannon's final form.
Its deafening report is the last
thing sinning targets hear.

forms.name: Viznak Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cosmic Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Endless Famine
forms.text:
A terrifying Bowgun stained
black with the blood of its
many sacrificial victims.

forms.name: Dark Famine
forms.text:
Endless Famine's final form.
It constantly searches for victims
to slake its thirst for new souls.

forms.name: Sheer Starvation
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Endless Famine</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Puregun
forms.text:
The true form of the Yukumo
Bowgun. Its various modifications
make it a different weapon entirely.

forms.name: Yukumo Spiritgun
forms.text:
The Yukumo Puregun's final
form. It is reserved for only the
best mountain-based hunters.

forms.name: Yukumo Auragun
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Puregun</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Cannon
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun with Brachydios
blast force. Its explosive light
can shatter the very stars.

forms.name: Lightbreak Eruption
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Cannon's final form.
Its bullets emit a fantastic blaze of
light, disintegrating everything.

forms.name: Lightbreak Starshatter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Loyal Thunder
forms.text:
A peerless bowgun that feeds
on willpower to furnish
strength to a would-be king.

forms.name: Oppressor's Wedge
forms.text:
The Loyal Thunder's final form.
Its blast is a roar that conquers
the heavens themselves.

forms.name: Orcus Quarcus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Loyal Thunder</COL>.

forms.name: Agna Magnum
forms.text:
A Heavy Bowgun reminiscent of
a volcano lord. Its salvos sound
like colossal eruptions.

forms.name: Agna Scorpion
forms.text:
The Agna Magnum's final form.
Its blast can send a wave of flame
to incinerate an entire continent.

forms.name: Agna Arbalest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Agna Magnum</COL>.

forms.name: Super Trench Snarfer
forms.text:
Created by desert bandits for
desert bandits, it somehow became
a common fixture on battlefields.

forms.name: Hyper Trench Snarfer
forms.text:
The Super Trench Snarfer's final
form's upgraded power can turn the
tide of the most hopeless battles.

forms.name: Brutal Trench Snarfer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Super Trench Snarfer</COL>.

forms.name: Petrified Bow
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from
the Wycademy. The default
Bow for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Bow
forms.text:
The Petrified Bow's final form.
A product of the Wycademy's
tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Hunter's Bow
forms.text:
A cheap, introductory Bow for
novice hunters. It comes with
arrows and a quiver.

forms.name: Master Hunter's Bow
forms.text:
The final form of the Hunter's
Bow. It is a symbol of a veteran
hunter who means business.

forms.name: Sharpshooter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hunter's Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Hunter's Stoutbow
forms.text:
The forerunner of iron bows. It was
designed from the ground up
to be easy to handle.

forms.name: Hunter's Proudbow
forms.text:
The final iteration of the
Hunter's Stoutbow. It features
top class power and performance.

forms.name: Hunter's Bravebow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hunter's Stoutbow</COL>.

forms.name: Arko Nulo (Y)
forms.text:
An elegant Bow made from
Bnahabra parts. Its built-in Thunder
properties inspire shock and awe.

forms.name: Arko Unu (Y)
forms.text:
The final iteration of the Arko
Nulo (Y). Its beauty strikes those
who see it, like a bolt of lightning.

forms.name: Arko Du (Y)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arko Nulo (Y)</COL>.

forms.name: Blango Fur Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Blango parts.
Contains traces of ice inside,
making it incredibly cold.

forms.name: Scarfskin Bow
forms.text:
The Blango Fur Bow's final
upgrade. The thick ice covering
lends an extra blast of cold fury.

forms.name: Fullpelt Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blango Fur Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Plume Bow
forms.text:
A Bow that features a massive
decoration made from the
feathers of a Great Maccao.

forms.name: Grand Plume Bow
forms.text:
The Plume Bow's final upgrade.
Its arrows fly straight and true,
coldly piercing their targets.

forms.name: Archfeather Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plume Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Bow
forms.text:
A Bow beloved by the hunters of
Yukumo Village. The warmth of
its materials soothes the soul.

forms.name: Yukumo Strongbow
forms.text:
The final Yukumo Bow, refined
and lovingly crafted from the finest
wood and iron.

forms.name: Hot Spring Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Morsel Bowfish
forms.text:
An eco-friendly Bow designed
to make use of old swordfish
leftovers.

forms.name: Ample Bowfish
forms.text:
Final upgrade of the Morsel
Bowfish. It honors the swordfish's
spirit by leaving nothing to waste.

forms.name: Viand Bowfish
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Morsel Bowfish</COL>.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Stave
forms.text:
A fire-breathing hunting Bow
made from Yian Kut-Ku parts.
Said to be user friendly.

forms.name: Strange Kut-Ku Stave
forms.text:
The Kut-Ku Stave's final form.
Flaming arrows soar through the
skies and shoot down wyverns.

forms.name: Great Kut-Ku Stave
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kut-Ku Stave</COL>.

forms.name: Daimyo's Warbow
forms.text:
A unique Bow modeled on
Daimyo Hermitaur pincers.
A sharp and steady weapon.

forms.name: Chelae Warbow
forms.text:
The Daimyo's Warbow's final
upgrade. Its pincer-sharp arrows
pierce even the toughest hides.

forms.name: Kingpincer Warbow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daimyo's Warbow</COL>.

forms.name: Khezu Bow
forms.text:
A Bow with a unique design
that electrifies arrows when
fired.

forms.name: Galvanized Core
forms.text:
The rather odd-looking final
iteration of the Khezu Bow. Its
electrified arrows tear into foes.

forms.name: Khezu Que C'est
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Khezu Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Queen Blaster
forms.text:
A deep green bow with a frame of
Rathian shell. Its elegant form
resembles the Queen herself.

forms.name: Queen's Melody
forms.text:
The final iteration of the
Queen Blaster. Its dangerous
beauty grabs hold of the soul.

forms.name: Queen's Rhapsody
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Queen Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Type 64 Multibow
forms.text:
A high-tech Bow designed for
fighting flying wyverns. The Guild
invested heavily in its R&D.

forms.name: Scorpion Zinger
forms.text:
The final iteration of the Type
64 Multibow. It pierces dragon
scales and castle walls with ease.

forms.name: Scorpion Perforator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 64 Multibow</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Bow
forms.text:
An ebon Bow, black as night.
Nargacuga fur absorbs light,
making it perfect for snipers.

forms.name: Night Flight
forms.text:
The Hidden Bow's final iteration.
Its victims fall to the darkness of
death before they even realize.

forms.name: Avidya Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Bamboo Taketori
forms.text:
A fine and pliant bow used in
Yukumo Village. It overflows with
its creator's sense of humor.

forms.name: Bamboo Okina
forms.text:
The Bamboo Taketori's final
iteration. It took forever and a day
for the creator to master its design.

forms.name: Bamboo Kaguya
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bamboo Taketori</COL>.

forms.name: Ivory Bow
forms.text:
A Bow of incredible purity. White
as the driven snow, it was crafted
for the use of innocent maidens.

forms.name: Frozen Bow
forms.text:
The Ivory Bow's final form.
Finely crafted, it's in the shape
of a frost-kissed flower.

forms.name: Frozen Solstice
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ivory Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Chaos Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from a tree that
grows odd mushrooms. Blurs the
line between dreams and reality.

forms.name: Chaotic Rapture
forms.text:
The final Chaos Bow. Those
under its spell forget themselves
and go in search of wyverns.

forms.name: Chaotic Thrall
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chaos Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Felyne Bow
forms.text:
A very cute Bow, crafted in the
shape of a Felyne head. It opens
its mouth when it's ready to fire.

forms.name: Felyne Trickbow
forms.text:
The final Felyne Bow.
Enough power to send any monster
running in fear...hopefully!

forms.name: Hoodwynk
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Felyne Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Arachnid Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from a Toxic Kumori
shell. The high-tensile bowstring
gives its arrows incredible thrust.

forms.name: Arachnid Silverstring
forms.text:
Final form of the Arachnid Bow.
Arrows fired from its tough, tensile
shell are incredibly powerful.

forms.name: Arachnid Silksong
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arachnid Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Prominence Bow
forms.text:
This marvel of technology
can slice through shell and
tear through flesh.

forms.name: Dark Filament
forms.text:
The Prominence Bow's final
upgrade. Its arrows engulf
targets in hellfire.

forms.name: Rubescent Saule
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Prominence Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Voltsender
forms.text:
A Bow made from supple Lagiacrus
parts. The coils do wonders for
arrow velocity.

forms.name: High Voltsender
forms.text:
The Voltsender's final evolution.
Its generator fires bolts of
electricity as well as arrows.

forms.name: Max Voltsender
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Voltsender</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Rumble
forms.text:
A Bow made from the shell of a
peerless monarch. Its arrows are
like fangs that sunder enemies.

forms.name: Despot's Earlybolt
forms.text:
Final upgrade of the Usurper's
Rumble. Its arrows can take down
the sun itself.

forms.name: Oppressor's Answer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Rumble</COL>.

forms.name: Blessed Rain
forms.text:
The elegant Bow of a princess who
fought for love. Showers waves
of arrows like a spring rain.

forms.name: Heaven's Manna
forms.text:
The final form of Blessed Rain,
its arrows meld into a sea of
black, blotting out the moon itself.

forms.name: Elysian Manna
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blessed Rain</COL>.

forms.name: Lightning Bow
forms.text:
This marvel of technology features
powerful arrows that slice through
shell and tear through flesh.

forms.name: Dark Lightning
forms.text:
Final form of the Lightning Bow.
Wrapped in cruel, green light, it
fires arrows like rolling thunder.

forms.name: Perkunas
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightning Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Bow
forms.text:
An ancient Bow said to have been
used by a mighty warrior. Its holy
light brings justice to its enemies.

forms.name: Colossus's Bow
forms.text:
Final iteration of the Giant's
Bow. Its arrows echo loudly,
ringing in the chaos to come.

forms.name: Behemoth's Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Ashen Wrath
forms.text:
This Bow embodies an inferno,
and blasts flaming arrows at
enemies without remorse.

forms.name: Ashen Pride
forms.text:
Final evolution of the Ashen
Wrath. It engulfs its prey in a
sea of crimson flames.

forms.name: Ashen Vainglory
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ashen Wrath</COL>.

forms.name: Entbehrung
forms.text:
A Bow as imposing as the
Gore Magala. Its arrows rend
the light and sow despair.

forms.name: Verzweiflung
forms.text:
The Entbehrung's final form.
Its arrows extinguish all light,
swallowing the land in darkness.

forms.name: Untergang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Entbehrung</COL>.

forms.name: Shalya Bow
forms.text:
A bow as limber as the Seregios.
The arrows it looses cut through
prey like a thousand blades.

forms.name: Insurgent Bow
forms.text:
Final form of the Shalya Bow.
Renowned for firing the arrow
that brought down a horrid tyrant.

forms.name: Renegade Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shalya Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Tigrex Archer
forms.text:
A dreadful Bow made from
sharp yet flexible Tigrex parts.
Strong enough to pierce stone.

forms.name: Tigrex Whisker
forms.text:
The Tigrex Archer's final form.
Made of durable Tigrex parts,
it rains death like its namesake.

forms.name: Tigrex Vibrissa
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tigrex Archer</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Flier
forms.text:
A formidable Bow. Its arrows
are doused with slime that
explodes inside enemies.

forms.name: Tsali Flier
forms.text:
Final evolved form of the Dios
Flier. Its slime-covered arrows
bore into the enemy and explode.

forms.name: Tsali Arisen
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Flier</COL>.

forms.name: Bow of Hope & Valor
forms.text:
A mighty Bow fit only for
heroes who survive their
ordeals with the Teostra.

forms.name: Bow of Light & Courage
forms.text:
Final form of the Bow of Hope
& Valor. Only heroes deemed
worthy by a dragon may wield it.

forms.name: Bow of Want & Blood
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bow of Hope & Valor</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Bow
forms.text:
A ghastly Bow that defies fate
in favor of ushering in a
dark and eternal loneliness.

forms.name: Infernal Bow
forms.text:
Final form of the Skeletal Bow.
Its previous owner's soul is bound
to the sorrowful arrows it fires.

forms.name: Hamal Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Onyx Bow
forms.text:
Darker than a bottomless
pit, prey cannot escape the
arrows this Bow fires.

forms.name: Benighted Bow
forms.text:
The final Onyx Bow, it harbors
an ominous force that pierces
the very souls of its targets.

forms.name: Fatalis Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Onyx Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Kelbi Stingshot
forms.text:
An extremely rare Bow made of
Kelbi horns. It fires steel
pellets rather than arrows.

forms.name: Kelbi Strongshot
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the Kelbi
Stingshot. A dynamic Bow, its steel
pellets can rip enemies to shreds.

forms.name: Great Kelbi Deershot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kelbi Stingshot</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Helm Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from the shell of a
Tetsucabra, it is tough yet pliant.
A warrior's spirit sleeps within.

forms.name: Archfiend's Roar
forms.text:
The Demon Helm Bow's final
upgrade. The sound of its string
strikes fear into hell's minions.

forms.name: Gehenna's Roar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Helm Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Blue Alighter
forms.text:
A Bow as wide as the maw of
a Zamtrios. Bites back in the
hands of the inexperienced.

forms.name: Cobalt Fire
forms.text:
The Blue Alighter's final upgrade.
Only the most experienced hunters
can wield its incredible power.

forms.name: Cobalt Wildfire
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blue Alighter</COL>.

forms.name: Arca Raptora
forms.text:
A Bow made from rare crystal that
forms on ancient wyvern bone.
This weapon lacks for nothing.

forms.name: Amnis
forms.text:
An Arca Raptora that's evolved
to this final form. Its
arrows fly true as time itself.

forms.name: Fluctus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arca Raptora</COL>.

forms.name: Wild Bow
forms.text:
Easy-to-use Bow made from
sturdy Congalala materials.
Adorable design.

forms.name: Wildwood Falde
forms.text:
The Wild Bow's final form. Highly
technical, but some hunters value
its particularly cute design.

forms.name: Wildwood Falderol
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wild Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Scylla Fist
forms.text:
Uses the Nerscylla's strong
and pliant materials to put
ruinous force in each arrow.

forms.name: Nershock
forms.text:
The Scylla Fist's final form.
Its pliant parts are now fully
optimized for ideal curvature.

forms.name: Shadow Nerscope
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scylla Fist</COL>.

forms.name: Seahorse Harp
forms.text:
A divine Bow. Wyverian minstrels
used it for war, and occasionally
plucking out catchy tunes.

forms.name: Reignhorse Harp
forms.text:
The final Seahorse Harp. Its
powerful melodies are used for both
prayer and preventing calamity.

forms.name: Aquasteed Harp
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seahorse Harp</COL>.

forms.name: Ice Crest
forms.text:
A Bow plated with Barioth scales.
Boasts a relatively high critical
attack rate and Ice damage.

forms.name: Edelweiss
forms.text:
The Ice Crest's final form, which uses
a spike as a stabilizer. See the white
petals bloom, inviolate and noble.

forms.name: Amber Arc Valanga
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ice Crest</COL>.

forms.name: Beast Thunderbow
forms.text:
An extraordinary bow wrapped in
flame-like Rajang pelt. Only
the mighty can draw its string.

forms.name: Beastking Thunderbow
forms.text:
Final upgrade for the Beast
Thunderbow. Those that can wield
it are destined to be great heroes.

forms.name: Beastczar Thunderbow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Beast Thunderbow</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Coilbender
forms.text:
A bow made from Diablos's resilient
horns. It takes an absurd amount of
strength to pull back the bowstring.

forms.name: Tyrant Bow
forms.text:
The Diablos Coilbender's final form.
Give a tyrant power and his
ruthlessness will know no bounds.

forms.name: The Terrible
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Coilbender</COL>.

forms.name: Research Bow
forms.text:
A Bow created at the Soaratorium,
normally used as a weather vane
to gauge wind speeds.

forms.name: Discovery Bow
forms.text:
The Research Bow's final form.
Open your mind to the possibilities
and the wind will bend to your will.

forms.name: Authority Anemoi
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Hero's Bow
forms.text:
The Hero of Hyrule's trusty
bow, equipped with arrows
imbued with sacred light.

forms.name: Sacred Bow
forms.text:
The final form of the Hero's
Bow can pierce evil with its
sacred arrows.

forms.name: Sacred Bow G
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hero's Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Pirate Bow J
forms.text:
The bow of a pirate who
shook the seas. Take the
helm and seize the treasure!

forms.name: Buccaneer Bow J
forms.text:
Pirate Bow J's final form.
Its arrows fly with wild
abandon, leading to riches.

forms.name: Pirate King Bow J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pirate Bow J</COL>.

forms.name: Ancient Bow
forms.text:
The beloved Bow of a
certain Hylian. A strange,
ancient power lies within.

forms.name: Ancient Bow X
forms.text:
The Ancient Bow's final
form. Contains the power
of an ancient civilization.

forms.name: Ancient Bow XX
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of
the <COL FF0000FF>Ancient Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Genie's Grimoire
forms.text:
A forbidden implement said to
summon demons. Death's maw
opens wide for all who meet it.

forms.name: Demon's Guidance
forms.text:
The final form of the Genie's
Grimoire. Retrieved from a fallen
demon, it is fear incarnate.

forms.name: Devil's Counsel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Genie's Grimoire</COL>.

forms.name: Hyperion
forms.text:
A fiery Bow of menacing make
and mystic materials that
pierces shell and flesh.

forms.name: Uranus Herald
forms.text:
Hyperion's final upgrade.
A godly bow that inescapably
alters one's destiny.

forms.name: Clearsky Eos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hyperion</COL>.

forms.name: Selene Moonbroken
forms.text:
A Bow befitting the hero who stole
the heart of a golden goddess.
It is radiant beyond compare.

forms.name: Artemis Moonmaker
forms.text:
Selene Moonbroken's final form.
Inlaid with gold, it gleams with the
spirit of the moon goddess herself.

forms.name: Hecate Moonsculptor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Selene Moonbroken</COL>.

forms.name: Archbeast Thunderbow
forms.text:
A Rajang Bow that requires
peerless strength to draw and
sets loose blazing bolts.

forms.name: Archbeast Paragon
forms.text:
Final upgrade of the Archbeast
Thunderbow. Its arrows pierce the
heavens with flame and lightning.

forms.name: Archbeast Avatar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Archbeast Thunderbow</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Bow
forms.text:
A dreadful Bow with the power of
Akantor. Overwhelming strength
can be felt in its dark shine.

forms.name: Akantor Chaos Bow
forms.text:
Final form of the Akantor Bow.
Given to the one who can master
life and death, order and chaos.

forms.name: Akantor Mutilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Bow
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white god's
second power: its glare, which
pierces the heavens.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skyflier
forms.text:
Final form of the Ukanlos Bow.
Its glare blankets the stars
themselves in utter darkness.

forms.name: Ukanlos Worldreaver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Tempest Nightbow
forms.text:
A Bow that can blot out the sun.
The gale formed by its drawstring
can bring the world to its knees.

forms.name: Heavenly Storm
forms.text:
The Tempest Nightbow's final
evolution. It silences chaos and
replaces it with love and mercy.

forms.name: Unlimited Daybreak
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tempest Nightbow</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Bow
forms.text:
A Bow that enraptures all who
see it. It has long passed from
one bloody hand to the next.

forms.name: Alatreon Commandment
forms.text:
The Alatreon Bow's final form.
Offers the type of power that
births a lust for even more.

forms.name: Altheos Incanonis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Bow
forms.text:
The silvery Bow of the Argent
Comet. Its shots hurtle like shooting
stars, piercing all cosmic matter.

forms.name: Dragonstar Hubar
forms.text:
The Silverwing Bow's final form.
"Fear me, the galaxy-piercer; my
wicked arrows skewer the stars."

forms.name: Magnastar Wil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Bow
forms.text:
A Bow from the Soaratorium for
hunters breaking new ground.
Its arrows pierce foes in a flash.

forms.name: Sage Bow
forms.text:
The Elder Bow's final form. Once
an arrow is let fly, nothing can stop
it from finding its mark.

forms.name: Philosopher Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Kayamcha Slinger
forms.text:
What started off as a simple toy
evolved through the years into this
tried-and-tested hunting tool.

forms.name: Kayachacha Slinger
forms.text:
Keep out of reach of Shakalaka.
The Kayamcha Slinger's final form
is just that dangerous!

forms.name: Maskbow Kayachacham
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kayamcha Slinger</COL>.

forms.name: Ala Victoria
forms.text:
An angelic Bow described in
ancient texts. It fires arrows
that herald a great victory.

forms.name: Prayerful Victoria
forms.text:
Ala Victoria's final form is a true
symbol of glory -- the spread wings
of a goddess who promises victory.

forms.name: Heedful Elizabeth
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ala Victoria</COL>.

forms.name: Gewinn/Perte
forms.text:
A Bow whose Affinity changes
when its wielder overcomes
the Frenzy.

forms.name: Verzweiflung/Désir
forms.text:
The Gewinn/Perte's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who cling to hope.

forms.name: Auftauchen/Disparition
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gewinn/Perte</COL>.

forms.name: Kingdomfall
forms.text:
A Bow crafted from the core of a
Lao-Shan Lung horn. Drawing it is a
matter of soul, not power.

forms.name: Mountainfall
forms.text:
The Kingdomfall's final form. The
wind from its arrows can bring
down the mountains.

forms.name: Heavensfall
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kingdomfall</COL>.

forms.name: Goldbow
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a scarlet-
crowned king who carried a bow.

forms.name: Inscribed Neith
forms.text:
The Goldbow's final form,
a corporeal manifestation of the
hunting goddess in her shroud.

forms.name: Wepwawet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldbow</COL>.

forms.name: Bow of Toil & Turmoil
forms.text:
A black Bow that harnesses Fatalis's
power. A single shot loosed from its
string unleashes a ruinous whirlwind.

forms.name: Bow of Rack & Ruin
forms.text:
The Bow of Toil & Turmoil's final
form. The whir of its wicked arrows
sing a prelude to destruction.

forms.name: Bow of Vice & Violence
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bow of Toil & Turmoil</COL>.

forms.name: Bow of Ire & Anguish
forms.text:
A bloodstained bow imbued with
the power of a crimson Fatalis that
drives the user into a brutal rage.

forms.name: Bow of Jinx & Jeopardy
forms.text:
The Bow of Ire & Anguish's final
form. Its dire arrows are a preface
to the coming rage and calamity.

forms.name: Bow of Fury & Perfidy
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bow of Ire & Anguish</COL>.

forms.name: Glory and Grandeur
forms.text:
A divine Bow forged from the soul
of an old Fatalis. The pure of heart
will be blessed with many victories.

forms.name: Might and Marvel
forms.text:
Glory and Grandeur's final form.
Arrows in flight from this hallowed
bow forge the way to conquest.

forms.name: Triumph and Testament
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Glory and Grandeur</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Redhelm
parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crimson Greatbow
forms.text:
The final Crimson Bow.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Redhelm Arzuros.

forms.name: Crimson Nirvana
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Stonefist Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Stonefist
parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Greatbow
forms.text:
The final Stonefist Bow.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Gigantbow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stonefist Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Royal Blaster
forms.text:
A Bow made from Dreadqueen
parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Royal Melody
forms.text:
The final Royal Blaster. Only
for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Royal Concerto
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Blaster</COL>!

forms.name: Demonic Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Drilltusk
parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Chthonic Greatbow
forms.text:
The final Demonic Bow.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Chthonic Maelstrom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonic Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Silverwind Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Silverwind
parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Moonless Dawn
forms.text:
Final form of the Silverwind
Bow. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Sunlight Gale
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwind Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Grobo Arc
forms.text:
A Bow made from Crystalbeard
parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Gilded Grobo Arc
forms.text:
Final form of the Grobo Arc.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Arc
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grobo Arc</COL>!

forms.name: Wicked Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Deadeye
parts. Wielding it fills the
Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Greatbow
forms.text:
Final form of the Wicked Bow.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Deadeye Tragedy
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wicked Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Dread Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Dreadking
parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Nera's Flight
forms.text:
Final form of the Dread Bow.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Firewaltz Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dread Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Rumble Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Thunderlord
parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Rolling Thunder
forms.text:
Final form of the Rumble Bow.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thundercrash
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rumble Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Rudra Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Grimclaw
parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Bow
forms.text:
Final form of the Rudra Bow.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Roar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rudra Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Hellish Wrath
forms.text:
A Bow made from Hellblade
parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Hellish Pride
forms.text:
The Hellish Wrath's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Hellish Virtue
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hellish Wrath</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Striker
forms.text:
A Bow made from Rustrazor
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Madcap Striker
forms.text:
The Razor Striker's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Striker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Striker</COL>!

forms.name: Perennial Winter
forms.text:
A Bow made from Soulseer
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Resplendent Corona
forms.text:
Perennial Winter's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Beyond the Firmaments
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Perennial Winter</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Boltreaver
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Zephra Gust
forms.text:
The Zephra Bow's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Zilvolt Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Elderfrost
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Kisser
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Bow's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Marksman
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from Bloodbath
parts. Wielding it fills the Arts
Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Flurry
forms.text:
The Massacre Bow's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Houyi
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Bow</COL>!

forms.name: Arko Nulo (W)
forms.text:
An elegant Bow made from
Bnahabra parts. Arrows fired
from it can freeze prey solid.

forms.name: Arko Unu (W)
forms.text:
The final iteration of the Arko
Nulo (W). Its frozen prey reflect
its unrivaled artistry.

forms.name: Arko Du (W)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arko Nulo (W)</COL>.

forms.name: Savage Wildbow
forms.text:
A prized hunting Bow that really
packs a punch. You've got to put
your back into it to move this one!

forms.name: Wildwood Kalifa
forms.text:
The Savage Wildbow's final form.
Its arrows can splinter trees and
still find their mark with ease.

forms.name: Wildwood Kalifabra
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Savage Wildbow</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Bow
forms.text:
A Bow made from a beautiful fossil.
Arrows fired from it leave a shining
trail along the path to their target.

forms.name: Ediacca Bow
forms.text:
The Obsidian Bow's final
form. An ancient power stops
any impediment to its arrows.

forms.name: Ethereal Ediacca
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Sonic Bow
forms.text:
A surprisingly light Thunder
Bow made from Hornetaur.
Capable of raining arrows.

forms.name: Sonic Resonator
forms.text:
The final form of the Sonic
Bow. Even lighter, with
unique rapid fire ability.

forms.name: Ultrasonic
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sonic Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Heat Haze
forms.text:
A sturdy Bow made of ample
Seltas parts. Emits an
insect-like whir when fired.

forms.name: Hulking Haze
forms.text:
The final evolution of the
Heat Haze. It is extra-rigid for
extra-powerful shots.

forms.name: Caraphaze
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Heat Haze</COL>.

forms.name: Feminine Haze
forms.text:
A Bow reinforced where it
counts. The membrane is for
show, not to reduce sound.

forms.name: Formidable Haze
forms.text:
The Feminine Haze's final
form. Arrows fired from it are as
deadly as a Seltas Queen's charge.

forms.name: Absolute Deviance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Feminine Haze</COL>.

forms.name: Bear Blade Bow
forms.text:
An acutely angled Bow. Letting
loose some non-elemental
shafts is easy with this.

forms.name: Showroom Model
forms.text:
The final form of the Bear
Blade Bow. Its expertly crafted
arrows can pierce solid rock.

forms.name: Ursa Major
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bear Blade Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Yekla Arc
forms.text:
A large Bow that is beautiful to
behold. It is said to have been
wielded by great rulers of old.

forms.name: Herald's Battlebow
forms.text:
The final form of the Yekla Arc.
Its arrows proclaim the advent of
a new king and the coming of war.

forms.name: Harbinger's Battlebow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yekla Arc</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Arrow
forms.text:
The sturdy Bow of a desert
people. Its arrows leave deep
wounds no champion can survive.

forms.name: Kama Sedition
forms.text:
Final form of the Seditious Arrow.
Its arrows topple regimes and
cause wounds that never heal.

forms.name: Sedition Piercer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Arrow</COL>.

forms.name: Brazencord
forms.text:
A heavy, sturdy Bow made from
Uragaan parts. Formidable on its
own, it also has Fire properties.

forms.name: Gigacles
forms.text:
A heavy Bow crafted in the shape
of an Uragaan body. The final
iteration of the Brazencord.

forms.name: Gigantomachy
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Brazencord</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Bow
forms.text:
A mechanical Bow infused with a
Brachydios's anger. Arrows fired
from it tear enemies apart.

forms.name: Warflare Demolisher
forms.text:
The pinnacle of a Brachydios's fury.
It can level entire civilizations. The
Demolition Bow's final form.

forms.name: Warflare Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Crystalline Flower
forms.text:
A Bow encrusted in crystal. By the
time foes look past its arrows'
icy filigree, it's too late.

forms.name: Heaven's Glaze
forms.text:
The final form of the Crystalline
Flower. It encases enemies in a
heavenly blossom-like crystal.

forms.name: Heaven's Breath
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crystalline Flower</COL>.

forms.name: Ice Cold Alighter
forms.text:
An advanced Zamtrios Bow.
Even harder to wield now,
but yields power to match.

forms.name: Freezing Alighter
forms.text:
The powerful final iteration of
the Ice Cold Alighter. Mishandling
its icy frame can spell death.

forms.name: Hailstorm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ice Cold Alighter</COL>.

forms.name: Crow Bow
forms.text:
A Yian Garuga hunting Bow
with venom-enhancing traits.
Compact, wieldy, powerful.

forms.name: Wolf Bow
forms.text:
The final iteration of the Crow
Bow. Poisons its arrows with the
blackened soul of a Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Jinx Bow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crow Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Vile Bow
forms.text:
